## Pre-Imputation Code

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 7: PRE-IMPUTATION DIAGNOSTICS & OPTIMIZATION
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Comprehensive diagnostics before multiple imputation
# Outputs: Statistically-derived m and maxit, optimized imputation parameters
#
# KEY METHODS:
#   m     → Von Hippel (2020) two-stage FMI-based quadratic rule
#             DOI: 10.1177/0049124117747303
#             Package: howManyImputations (Errickson, CRAN)
#   maxit → Empirical convergence experiment (m=5, maxit=10/20/30/40)
#             Gelman-Rubin PSRF < 1.1 criterion
#             Gelman & Rubin (1992); Brooks & Gelman (1998)
#
# OUTCOME: freq_dich (0/1 = stoppers, 2 = continuers)
#   NOT imputed (method = "") but RETAINED in df_imputation_ready.rds
#   as a passive predictor. Including the outcome in the imputation model
#   preserves predictor-outcome associations in imputed data; excluding it
#   attenuates regression coefficients and corrupts variable-importance
#   signals for VSURF (Donders et al., 2006 J Clin Epidemiol;
#   van Buuren, 2018 §6.3.1).
#   freq_dich has complete data (0 NAs) so it is safe to use as a predictor
#   without imputing it. Its row in the predictor matrix is all zeros
#   (it does not need predictors itself); its column is set to 1 for all
#   variables with missingness.
#
# CHANGES FROM PREVIOUS VERSION:
#   • Outcome updated to freq_dich
#   • freq_dich now RETAINED in df_imp (passive predictor) rather than
#     removed; method["freq_dich"] = "" and predictor column activated
#   • Dropped: benefit_dep, safety_1:4, stop_rate_dc, med_burden vars,
#              desires_3, all reasons variables
#   • Variable type assignments updated:
#       - All Likert items (benefits, side effects, adls, dependence,
#         motivation, capability, desires, inf_hcp) → PMM
#       - fall2 → ordered (polr)
#       - wdl_symptom_count → continuous (PMM)
#       - stop_wdl_exp_combined → unordered factor, imputed with polr
#             NOW 3 LEVELS: 0=No withdrawal, 1=Insomnia only,
#             2=Other withdrawal symptoms
#             (collapsed from original 6 levels; levels 2-5 were too
#              sparse for reliable estimation, combined n ≈ 14)
#             Stored as UNORDERED factor so downstream REGRESSION uses
#             dummy coding, not polynomial contrasts. Imputation uses polr
#             under a defensible monotone burden gradient (none < insomnia
#             only < other/multiple symptoms); see NOTE in Part D.
#   • BZRA dose variable: bzra_daily_diazepam_eq (mg/day, true diazepam-mg
#       equivalent). Single dose variable — the weekly version was dropped
#       in Chunk 5+6 (unused downstream; perfectly collinear with daily).
#       Imputed via PMM like any other continuous variable.
#   • adverse_effects list replaced with explicit item vectors
#   • mincor = 0.07 to achieve 20-25 predictors per model
#   • pilot_imp initialised before tryCatch to prevent scoping error
#   • VIF note added for stop_wdl_exp_combined / wdl_symptom_count
#==============================================================================

library(mice)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(car)
library(coda)
library(howManyImputations)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PRE-IMPUTATION DIAGNOSTICS & OPTIMIZATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load prepared dataset from Chunk 5+6
if (file.exists("SIMOA_analysis.rds")) {
  SIMOA_analysis <- readRDS("SIMOA_analysis.rds")
  analysis_vars  <- readRDS("analysis_variable_lists.rds")
  cat("✓ Loaded SIMOA_analysis.rds\n")
  cat("  Dimensions:", nrow(SIMOA_analysis), "rows ×",
      ncol(SIMOA_analysis), "columns\n\n")
} else {
  stop("ERROR: SIMOA_analysis.rds not found. Please run Chunk 5+6 first.")
}

# Verify reverse coding
cat("VERIFICATION: Checking reverse coding from Chunk 5+6\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
if (!is.null(analysis_vars$bfi_reversed) &&
    length(analysis_vars$bfi_reversed) > 0) {
  cat("✓ BFI items reversed:", length(analysis_vars$bfi_reversed), "\n")
  cat("  Items:", paste(analysis_vars$bfi_reversed, collapse = ", "), "\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️  No BFI reverse coding detected\n")
}
if (!is.null(analysis_vars$surps_reversed) &&
    length(analysis_vars$surps_reversed) > 0) {
  cat("✓ SURPS items reversed:", length(analysis_vars$surps_reversed), "\n")
  cat("  Items:", paste(analysis_vars$surps_reversed, collapse = ", "), "\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️  No SURPS reverse coding detected\n")
}
cat("\n")

# Verify stop_wdl_exp_combined is 3-level unordered factor
cat("VERIFICATION: stop_wdl_exp_combined coding\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
if ("stop_wdl_exp_combined" %in% names(SIMOA_analysis)) {
  wdl_class  <- class(SIMOA_analysis$stop_wdl_exp_combined)
  wdl_levels <- levels(SIMOA_analysis$stop_wdl_exp_combined)
  cat(sprintf("  Class:   %s\n", paste(wdl_class, collapse = "/")))
  cat(sprintf("  Levels:  %s\n", paste(wdl_levels, collapse = ", ")))
  cat(sprintf("  N levels: %d (expected: 3)\n", length(wdl_levels)))
  if ("ordered" %in% wdl_class)
    cat("  ⚠️  WARNING: still ordered — should be unordered factor\n")
  else
    cat("  ✓ Confirmed unordered factor\n")
  cat("  Distribution:\n")
  print(table(SIMOA_analysis$stop_wdl_exp_combined, useNA = "ifany"))
} else {
  cat("  ⚠️  stop_wdl_exp_combined not found\n")
}
cat("\n")

# Verify BZRA dose variable is present under its correct name
cat("VERIFICATION: bzra_daily_diazepam_eq present\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
if ("bzra_daily_diazepam_eq" %in% names(SIMOA_analysis)) {
  n_na_dose <- sum(is.na(SIMOA_analysis$bzra_daily_diazepam_eq))
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ Found | class: %s | %d missing (will be imputed via PMM)\n",
              paste(class(SIMOA_analysis$bzra_daily_diazepam_eq), collapse = "/"),
              n_na_dose))
} else {
  cat("  ⚠️  bzra_daily_diazepam_eq NOT found — check Chunk 5+6 output.\n")
  cat("      (Old names bzra_daily_dose_eq / bzra_weekly_dose_eq are retired.)\n")
}
cat("\n")

# ── OUTCOME HANDLING ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# freq_dich is RETAINED in df_imp as a passive predictor.
# It has complete data (no NAs), so it informs imputation of all other
# variables without needing to be imputed itself (method = "").
# Excluding the outcome attenuates predictor-outcome associations in
# imputed data and corrupts VSURF importance scores downstream.
# (Donders et al., 2006; van Buuren, 2018 §6.3.1)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
outcome <- analysis_vars$outcome  # freq_dich

cat("OUTCOME HANDLING:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
if (outcome %in% names(SIMOA_analysis)) {
  n_na_outcome <- sum(is.na(SIMOA_analysis[[outcome]]))
  cat(sprintf("  Outcome variable: %s\n", outcome))
  cat(sprintf("  Missing values:   %d (expected: 0)\n", n_na_outcome))
  if (n_na_outcome > 0) {
    stop(paste("ERROR:", outcome, "has", n_na_outcome,
               "NAs. Cannot use as passive predictor safely.",
               "Investigate before proceeding."))
  }
  cat("  ✓ Complete — retained in df_imp as passive predictor\n")
  cat("    method['freq_dich'] will be set to '' (not imputed)\n")
  cat("    Predictor matrix column will be activated for all imputed vars\n")
  cat("  Distribution (0/1=stoppers, 2=continuers):\n")
  print(table(SIMOA_analysis[[outcome]], useNA = "ifany"))
  cat("\n")
  # Keep freq_dich in df_imp — do NOT remove it
  df_imp <- SIMOA_analysis
  cat("  Imputation dataset:", nrow(df_imp), "rows ×",
      ncol(df_imp), "columns (includes", outcome, ")\n\n")
} else {
  df_imp <- SIMOA_analysis
  cat("  ⚠️  Outcome variable not found — proceeding without it\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART A: COMPREHENSIVE MISSINGNESS DIAGNOSTICS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART A: COMPREHENSIVE MISSINGNESS DIAGNOSTICS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

n_total        <- nrow(df_imp)
n_vars         <- ncol(df_imp)
missing_counts <- colSums(is.na(df_imp))
missing_pct    <- 100 * missing_counts / n_total
total_cells    <- n_total * n_vars
total_missing  <- sum(missing_counts)
pct_missing_overall <- 100 * total_missing / total_cells

cat("OVERALL MISSINGNESS:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  Total observations:", n_total, "\n")
cat("  Total variables:  ", n_vars,   "\n")
cat("  Total cells:      ", total_cells, "\n")
cat("  Missing cells:    ", total_missing,
    "(", round(pct_missing_overall, 2), "%)\n")
cat("  Complete cases:   ", sum(complete.cases(df_imp)),
    "(", round(100 * sum(complete.cases(df_imp)) / n_total, 1), "%)\n\n")

vars_with_missing <- names(missing_counts[missing_counts > 0])
vars_complete     <- names(missing_counts[missing_counts == 0])

cat("VARIABLE-LEVEL MISSINGNESS:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  Variables with missing data:", length(vars_with_missing), "\n")
cat("  Variables complete:         ", length(vars_complete),     "\n")
cat(sprintf("  NOTE: %s is complete by design (passive predictor)\n\n", outcome))

miss_cats <- cut(missing_pct,
                 breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 25, 40, 100),
                 labels = c("Minimal (<5%)", "Low (5-10%)",
                            "Moderate (10-25%)", "High (25-40%)",
                            "Very High (>40%)"),
                 include.lowest = TRUE)

cat("MISSINGNESS SEVERITY:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat(sprintf("  Minimal (<5%%):      %3d variables\n",
            sum(miss_cats == "Minimal (<5%)",      na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  Low (5-10%%):        %3d variables\n",
            sum(miss_cats == "Low (5-10%)",        na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  Moderate (10-25%%):  %3d variables\n",
            sum(miss_cats == "Moderate (10-25%)",  na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  High (25-40%%):      %3d variables\n",
            sum(miss_cats == "High (25-40%)",      na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  Very High (>40%%):   %3d variables\n\n",
            sum(miss_cats == "Very High (>40%)",   na.rm = TRUE)))

cat("TOP 20 VARIABLES BY MISSINGNESS:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
# Exclude outcome from missingness ranking (it is complete by design)
miss_pct_excl_outcome <- missing_pct[names(missing_pct) != outcome]
top_missing <- head(sort(miss_pct_excl_outcome[miss_pct_excl_outcome > 0],
                         decreasing = TRUE), 20)
for (i in seq_along(top_missing)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %2d. %-30s: %5.1f%% (%4d obs)\n",
              i, names(top_missing)[i], top_missing[i],
              round(top_missing[i] * n_total / 100)))
}
cat("\n")

miss_summary <- data.frame(
  variable    = names(missing_pct),
  n_missing   = missing_counts,
  pct_missing = missing_pct,
  category    = miss_cats
) %>% arrange(desc(pct_missing))

write.csv(miss_summary, "pre_imputation_missingness_summary.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: pre_imputation_missingness_summary.csv\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART B: VARIABLE VALIDATION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART B: VARIABLE VALIDATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# B1. Constant and near-zero variance
cat("B1. Checking for constant/near-zero variance variables\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

constant_vars <- character()
nzv_vars      <- character()

for (var in names(df_imp)) {
  if (var == outcome) next  # skip — complete by design, not a concern
  if (is.numeric(df_imp[[var]])) {
    non_na   <- na.omit(df_imp[[var]])
    n_unique <- length(unique(non_na))
    if (n_unique <= 1) {
      constant_vars <- c(constant_vars, var)
      cat("  ⚠️  Constant:", var, "(", n_unique, "unique value)\n")
    } else if (length(non_na) > 0) {
      var_val <- var(non_na)
      if (var_val < 1e-10) {
        nzv_vars <- c(nzv_vars, var)
        cat("  ⚠️  Near-zero variance:", var,
            "(SD =", round(sqrt(var_val), 6), ")\n")
      }
    }
  } else if (is.factor(df_imp[[var]])) {
    non_na   <- na.omit(df_imp[[var]])
    n_unique <- length(unique(non_na))
    if (n_unique <= 1) {
      constant_vars <- c(constant_vars, var)
      cat("  ⚠️  Single-level factor:", var, "\n")
    }
  }
}
if (length(constant_vars) == 0 && length(nzv_vars) == 0)
  cat("  ✓ No constant or near-zero variance variables detected\n")
cat("\n")

# B2. Minimum sample size
cat("B2. Checking minimum sample size (non-missing observations)\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

low_n_vars <- character()
for (var in names(df_imp)) {
  if (var == outcome) next
  n_obs <- sum(!is.na(df_imp[[var]]))
  if (n_obs < 10 && n_obs < n_total) {
    low_n_vars <- c(low_n_vars, var)
    cat("  ⚠️  Low sample size:", var, "(n =", n_obs, ")\n")
  }
}
if (length(low_n_vars) == 0)
  cat("  ✓ All variables have adequate sample size (n ≥ 10)\n")
cat("\n")

# B3. Separation check — factor variables only
cat("B3. Checking for separation in binary/categorical variables\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  Note: restricted to factor variables (logreg/polr targets).\n")
cat("  Numeric Likert items excluded — sparse counts are not a\n")
cat("  separation risk for PMM.\n\n")

separation_vars <- character()
for (var in names(df_imp)) {
  if (var == outcome) next
  if (is.factor(df_imp[[var]])) {
    non_na <- na.omit(df_imp[[var]])
    if (length(non_na) > 0) {
      freq_table <- table(non_na)
      if (any(freq_table < 5)) {
        separation_vars <- c(separation_vars, var)
        cat("  ⚠️  Sparse levels:", var,
            "(min count =", min(freq_table), ")\n")
      }
    }
  }
}
if (length(separation_vars) == 0)
  cat("  ✓ No separation issues detected\n")
cat("\n")

# B4. Derived variables
cat("B4. Handling derived/composite variables\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

derived_vars <- c("n_health_conditions")

# Raw sex-specific alcohol variables — replaced by combined alc_use in Chunk 5+6.
alc_raw_vars    <- c("alc_use_wmn", "alc_use_men")
alc_raw_present <- alc_raw_vars[alc_raw_vars %in% names(df_imp)]
if (length(alc_raw_present) > 0) {
  df_imp <- df_imp %>% select(-all_of(alc_raw_present))
  cat("  ✓ Removed raw alcohol variables (replaced by alc_use):",
      paste(alc_raw_present, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
if (any(derived_vars %in% names(df_imp))) {
  for (var in derived_vars) {
    if (var %in% names(df_imp)) {
      df_imp <- df_imp %>% select(-all_of(var))
      cat("  ✓ Removed:", var,
          "(sum of components — recalculated post-imputation)\n")
    }
  }
  cat("  Remaining variables:", ncol(df_imp), "\n\n")
  cat("  POST-IMPUTATION: n_health_conditions =\n")
  cat("    n_physical_conditions + n_ment_conditions + n_sleep_conditions\n\n")
} else {
  cat("  ✓ No derived variables to remove\n\n")
}

problematic_vars <- unique(c(constant_vars, nzv_vars, low_n_vars, derived_vars))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART C: MULTICOLLINEARITY CHECK (VIF)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART C: MULTICOLLINEARITY CHECK (VIF)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("PURPOSE: High multicollinearity can cause imputation instability.\n")
cat("  • VIF < 5:   Acceptable\n")
cat("  • VIF 5-10:  Moderate concern\n")
cat("  • VIF > 10:  High multicollinearity (consider removing)\n\n")

cat("NOTE: stop_wdl_exp_combined and wdl_symptom_count are correlated\n")
cat("  by construction. With stop_wdl_exp_combined now collapsed to\n")
cat("  3 levels (0/1/2), wdl_symptom_count distinguishes symptom burden\n")
cat("  within the 'Other withdrawal symptoms' category (count 1-4).\n")
cat("  Both are complete variables — neither is imputed — and\n")
cat("  stop_wdl_exp_combined has been zeroed as a predictor column\n")
cat("  in Part D5. No action needed.\n\n")

# Exclude outcome from VIF — it is not an analysis predictor
numeric_complete <- df_imp %>%
  select(-all_of(outcome)) %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  select(where(~ sum(is.na(.)) == 0))

cat("ELIGIBLE VARIABLES FOR VIF (complete numeric only, outcome excluded):\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
if (ncol(numeric_complete) > 0) {
  for (i in seq_len(ncol(numeric_complete)))
    cat(sprintf("  %2d. %s\n", i, names(numeric_complete)[i]))
  cat("\nTotal eligible:", ncol(numeric_complete), "variables\n\n")
} else {
  cat("  No complete numeric variables found\n\n")
}

redundant_predictors <- character()

if (ncol(numeric_complete) >= 3) {
  vif_result <- tryCatch({
    cor_matrix    <- cor(numeric_complete, use = "complete.obs")
    upper_tri_cor <- cor_matrix[upper.tri(cor_matrix)]
    max_cor       <- max(abs(upper_tri_cor))

    if (max_cor > 0.99) {
      cat("  ⚠️  Perfect/near-perfect correlation detected (r =",
          round(max_cor, 3), ")\n")

      perfect_pairs <- which(abs(cor_matrix) >= 0.99 &
                               upper.tri(cor_matrix), arr.ind = TRUE)

      if (nrow(perfect_pairs) > 0) {
        cat("     Perfectly correlated pairs:\n")
        seen_pairs <- character()
        for (i in seq_len(nrow(perfect_pairs))) {
          v1 <- rownames(cor_matrix)[perfect_pairs[i, 1]]
          v2 <- colnames(cor_matrix)[perfect_pairs[i, 2]]
          pair_key <- paste(sort(c(v1, v2)), collapse = "↔")
          if (!pair_key %in% seen_pairs) {
            cat(sprintf(
              "       • %s ↔ %s (r = %.4f — redundant as predictor: %s)\n",
              v1, v2,
              cor_matrix[perfect_pairs[i, 1], perfect_pairs[i, 2]], v2))
            redundant_predictors <- c(redundant_predictors, v2)
            seen_pairs <- c(seen_pairs, pair_key)
          }
        }
      }
      cat("     Skipping VIF due to perfect multicollinearity\n\n")
      NULL

    } else {
      vif_formula <- as.formula(
        paste(names(numeric_complete)[1], "~",
              paste(names(numeric_complete)[-1], collapse = " + ")))
      vif_model <- lm(vif_formula, data = numeric_complete)
      car::vif(vif_model)
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  ⚠️  VIF calculation failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n\n")
    NULL
  })

  if (!is.null(vif_result)) {
    vif_df <- data.frame(
      variable = names(vif_result),
      VIF      = as.numeric(vif_result)
    ) %>% arrange(desc(VIF))

    cat("VIF RESULTS:\n")
    cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(vif_df))) {
      status <- if (vif_df$VIF[i] < 5) "✓" else
        if (vif_df$VIF[i] < 10) "⚠️" else "✗"
      cat(sprintf("  %s %2d. %-30s: VIF = %6.2f\n",
                  status, i, vif_df$variable[i], vif_df$VIF[i]))
    }
    high_vif <- vif_df %>% filter(VIF > 10)
    mod_vif  <- vif_df %>% filter(VIF >= 5 & VIF <= 10)
    low_vif  <- vif_df %>% filter(VIF < 5)
    cat(sprintf("\n  ✓ Low VIF (<5):        %3d variables\n", nrow(low_vif)))
    cat(sprintf("  ⚠️ Moderate VIF (5-10): %3d variables\n", nrow(mod_vif)))
    cat(sprintf("  ✗ High VIF (>10):      %3d variables\n\n", nrow(high_vif)))

    if (nrow(high_vif) > 0) {
      cat("⚠️  VARIABLES WITH HIGH VIF — CONSIDER REMOVING:\n")
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(high_vif)))
        cat(sprintf("  %2d. %-30s: VIF = %.2f\n",
                    i, high_vif$variable[i], high_vif$VIF[i]))
      cat("\n")
    }

    if (nrow(mod_vif) > 0) {
      cat("NOTE ON MODERATE VIF VARIABLES:\n")
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(mod_vif)))
        cat(sprintf("  %-30s: VIF = %.2f\n",
                    mod_vif$variable[i], mod_vif$VIF[i]))
      cat("  stop_wdl_exp_combined and wdl_symptom_count are correlated\n")
      cat("  by construction. With stop_wdl_exp_combined collapsed to 3\n")
      cat("  levels, wdl_symptom_count adds information on symptom burden\n")
      cat("  within the 'Other withdrawal' category. Both are complete\n")
      cat("  variables — neither is imputed — and stop_wdl_exp_combined\n")
      cat("  has been zeroed as a predictor column in Part D5.\n\n")
    }

    write.csv(vif_df, "vif_analysis.csv", row.names = FALSE)
    cat("✓ Saved: vif_analysis.csv\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("ℹ️  Not enough complete numeric variables for VIF analysis\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART D: DEFINE VARIABLE TYPES FOR IMPUTATION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART D: DEFINING VARIABLE TYPES FOR IMPUTATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# ── Explicit item vectors ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
benefit_items     <- c("benefit_1","benefit_4","benefit_5","benefit_6")
side_effect_items <- paste0("side_effects_", 1:4)
adl_items         <- paste0("adls_", 1:2)
dependence_items  <- paste0("dependence_", 1:3)
motivation_items  <- paste0("motivation_", 1:3)
capability_items  <- c("capability_1","capability")
desires_items     <- c("desires_1","desires_2")
hcp_items         <- c("inf_hcp_1","inf_hcp_3")

# All Likert-scale belief/COM-B items → PMM
likert_items <- c(
  benefit_items, side_effect_items, adl_items, dependence_items,
  motivation_items, capability_items, desires_items, hcp_items
)

# ── Continuous (PMM) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
continuous_vars <- c(
  "age",
  "med_quant", "phq2_score", "osss_3_score",
  "n_physical_conditions", "n_ment_conditions", "n_sleep_conditions",
  "wdl_symptom_count",
  "bzra_daily_diazepam_eq",
  "c_lengthofuse",
  likert_items,
  if (!is.null(analysis_vars$dbas))  analysis_vars$dbas  else character(),
  if (!is.null(analysis_vars$bfi))   analysis_vars$bfi   else character(),
  if (!is.null(analysis_vars$surps)) analysis_vars$surps else character(),
  if (!is.null(analysis_vars$ciss))  analysis_vars$ciss  else character()
)

# ── Binary (logreg) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
binary_vars <- c("sex")

# ── Ordered categorical (polr) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
ordered_vars <- c(
  "education", "income", "employment", "driving_freq",
  "gen_health",
  "fall2",
  "alc_use",          # 0=Never, 1=Low, 2=Moderate, 3=High, 4=Very high
  if (!is.null(analysis_vars$sleep_aids)) analysis_vars$sleep_aids
  else character()
)

# ── Nominal category imputed with polr ────────────────────────────────────────
# stop_wdl_exp_combined: 3-level factor (collapsed from 6 levels).
#   0 = No withdrawal
#   1 = Insomnia only
#   2 = Other withdrawal symptoms (anxiety/MH/physical/multiple)
#
# STORAGE vs IMPUTATION — read this carefully, the two serve different ends:
#   • Stored as an UNORDERED factor so the downstream REGRESSION uses dummy
#     coding (coefficients for level 1 and level 2 vs reference 0), not
#     polynomial contrasts. That is an interpretability choice for analysis.
#   • IMPUTED with polr. polr assumes an ordinal response, so this imposes a
#     monotone ordering on the levels during imputation. That is defensible
#     here because the collapse yields a rough burden gradient
#     (none < insomnia only < other/multiple symptoms), and polr is far more
#     stable than polyreg given the sparse 'Other' cell (the same sparsity
#     that motivated the collapse). If a reviewer objects to imputing a
#     factor stored as unordered with an ordinal method, the fallback is
#     method = "polyreg" (multinomial), accepting some instability.
#   Do NOT describe this variable as "purely nominal" — the imputation model
#   treats it as ordinal by design.
polr_unordered_vars <- c("stop_wdl_exp_combined")
polr_unordered_vars <- polr_unordered_vars[polr_unordered_vars %in% names(df_imp)]

# ── Unordered categorical (polyreg) ───────────────────────────────────────────
unordered_categorical <- c("prov_terr")

# Filter to variables present in df_imp (excluding outcome — handled separately)
continuous_vars       <- continuous_vars[continuous_vars %in% names(df_imp)]
binary_vars           <- binary_vars[binary_vars %in% names(df_imp)]
ordered_vars          <- ordered_vars[ordered_vars %in% names(df_imp)]
unordered_categorical <- unordered_categorical[
  unordered_categorical %in% names(df_imp)]

# Guard: bzra dose variable must be present and assigned to a type vector.
# This catches the silent-drop failure mode where a renamed variable no
# longer matches any type vector and falls through to mice auto-detection.
if (!"bzra_daily_diazepam_eq" %in% continuous_vars &&
    "bzra_daily_diazepam_eq" %in% names(df_imp)) {
  warning("bzra_daily_diazepam_eq present in df_imp but not assigned to continuous_vars — check naming.")
}

# Check for unassigned variables (exclude outcome — it is handled as passive)
all_assigned <- c(continuous_vars, binary_vars,
                  ordered_vars, polr_unordered_vars, unordered_categorical,
                  outcome)
unassigned   <- setdiff(names(df_imp), c(all_assigned, derived_vars))
if (length(unassigned) > 0) {
  cat("⚠️  UNASSIGNED VARIABLES (defaulting to mice auto-detect):\n")
  for (v in unassigned) cat("  •", v, "\n")
  cat("\n")
}

cat("VARIABLE TYPE ASSIGNMENT:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat(sprintf("  Continuous / PMM (numeric + Likert): %d variables\n",
            length(continuous_vars)))
cat(sprintf("    Of which Likert belief/COM-B items: %d\n",
            sum(likert_items %in% continuous_vars)))
cat(sprintf("    Of which personality scale items:  %d\n",
            sum(c(analysis_vars$dbas, analysis_vars$bfi,
                  analysis_vars$surps, analysis_vars$ciss) %in%
                  continuous_vars)))
cat(sprintf("    Includes: bzra_daily_diazepam_eq (mg/day)\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Binary / logreg:                     %d variables\n",
            length(binary_vars)))
cat(sprintf("  Ordered categorical / polr:          %d variables\n",
            length(ordered_vars)))
cat(sprintf("    Includes: fall2 (0=none,1=minor,2=serious)\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Nominal storage / polr imputation:   %d variables\n",
            length(polr_unordered_vars)))
cat(sprintf("    stop_wdl_exp_combined — 3-level factor:\n"))
cat(sprintf("      0=No withdrawal, 1=Insomnia only,\n"))
cat(sprintf("      2=Other withdrawal symptoms\n"))
cat(sprintf("      Stored unordered (dummy-coded in regression);\n"))
cat(sprintf("      imputed with polr under a monotone burden gradient\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Unordered categorical / polyreg:     %d variables\n",
            length(unordered_categorical)))
cat(sprintf("  Outcome (passive predictor):          1 variable (%s)\n",
            outcome))
cat(sprintf("    method = '' (not imputed; complete; informs all other models)\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Total assigned:                      %d\n\n",
            length(continuous_vars) + length(binary_vars) +
              length(ordered_vars) + length(polr_unordered_vars) +
              length(unordered_categorical) + 1L))

# ── Force all Likert and personality items to numeric ─────────────────────────
cat("FORCING LIKERT AND PERSONALITY ITEMS TO NUMERIC:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  Rationale: Likert items treated as continuous (PMM).\n")
cat("  Forcing to integer prevents accidental ordered-factor encoding\n")
cat("  which triggers polr and sparse-level separation warnings.\n\n")

scale_vars_all <- c(
  likert_items,
  if (!is.null(analysis_vars$dbas))  analysis_vars$dbas  else character(),
  if (!is.null(analysis_vars$bfi))   analysis_vars$bfi   else character(),
  if (!is.null(analysis_vars$surps)) analysis_vars$surps else character(),
  if (!is.null(analysis_vars$ciss))  analysis_vars$ciss  else character()
)
scale_vars_all <- scale_vars_all[scale_vars_all %in% names(df_imp)]

n_converted <- 0L
n_already   <- 0L
for (var in scale_vars_all) {
  if (!is.numeric(df_imp[[var]])) {
    df_imp[[var]] <- as.integer(df_imp[[var]])
    n_converted   <- n_converted + 1L
  } else {
    n_already <- n_already + 1L
  }
}
cat(sprintf("  ✓ Converted to integer: %d items\n", n_converted))
cat(sprintf("  ✓ Already numeric:      %d items\n", n_already))
cat(sprintf("  Scales: DBAS (%d), BFI (%d), SURPS (%d), CISS (%d),\n",
            sum(analysis_vars$dbas  %in% scale_vars_all),
            sum(analysis_vars$bfi   %in% scale_vars_all),
            sum(analysis_vars$surps %in% scale_vars_all),
            sum(analysis_vars$ciss  %in% scale_vars_all)))
cat(sprintf("          Belief/COM-B Likert items (%d)\n\n",
            sum(likert_items %in% scale_vars_all)))

# ── Convert remaining variables to proper types ───────────────────────────────
cat("Converting remaining variables to proper types...\n")

for (var in continuous_vars)
  if (var %in% names(df_imp) && !is.numeric(df_imp[[var]]))
    df_imp[[var]] <- as.numeric(as.character(df_imp[[var]]))

for (var in binary_vars)
  if (var %in% names(df_imp))
    df_imp[[var]] <- as.numeric(df_imp[[var]])

# Ordered factors — polynomial contrasts in downstream models
for (var in ordered_vars)
  if (var %in% names(df_imp) && !is.ordered(df_imp[[var]]))
    df_imp[[var]] <- factor(df_imp[[var]], ordered = TRUE)

# Nominal category imputed with polr — stored as UNORDERED factor
for (var in polr_unordered_vars)
  if (var %in% names(df_imp))
    df_imp[[var]] <- factor(df_imp[[var]], ordered = FALSE)

for (var in unordered_categorical)
  if (var %in% names(df_imp) &&
      (!is.factor(df_imp[[var]]) || is.ordered(df_imp[[var]])))
    df_imp[[var]] <- factor(df_imp[[var]], ordered = FALSE)

# Verify stop_wdl_exp_combined is correctly set as unordered
if ("stop_wdl_exp_combined" %in% names(df_imp)) {
  swdl_class  <- class(df_imp[["stop_wdl_exp_combined"]])
  swdl_levels <- levels(df_imp[["stop_wdl_exp_combined"]])
  if ("ordered" %in% swdl_class) {
    warning("stop_wdl_exp_combined is still ordered after conversion — check upstream coding")
  } else {
    cat("  ✓ stop_wdl_exp_combined confirmed as unordered factor\n")
    cat("    class:", paste(swdl_class, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    cat("    levels:", paste(swdl_levels, collapse = " | "), "\n")
    cat("    n levels:", length(swdl_levels), "(expected: 3)\n")
  }
}

cat("✓ Variable type conversion complete\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Set up mice methods and predictor matrix
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

init   <- mice(df_imp, maxit = 0, print = FALSE)
method <- init$method

# ── Set outcome as passive predictor ──────────────────────────────────────────
# freq_dich: complete data, not imputed (method = ""), but its column in the
# predictor matrix will be set to 1 for all variables with missingness so
# that it informs every imputation model.
if (outcome %in% names(method)) {
  method[outcome] <- ""
  cat(sprintf("✓ %s: method set to '' (passive predictor — not imputed)\n\n",
              outcome))
} else {
  cat(sprintf("⚠️  %s not found in method vector — check df_imp\n\n", outcome))
}

# ── quickpred() ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("Building predictor matrix with quickpred()...\n")
cat("  mincor = 0.07 (minimum |r| to include as predictor)\n")
cat("  minpuc = 0.10 (minimum proportion of usable cases)\n")
cat("  Target: 20–25 predictors per model\n\n")

pred <- quickpred(df_imp, mincor = 0.07, minpuc = 0.10)

# ── Activate outcome column, zero outcome row ──────────────────────────────────
# Outcome column: set to 1 for all imputed variables (informs their models).
# Outcome row:    set to 0 (freq_dich is not itself imputed, needs no predictors).
if (outcome %in% colnames(pred) && outcome %in% rownames(pred)) {
  vars_being_imputed <- names(method[method != ""])
  vars_in_pred       <- vars_being_imputed[vars_being_imputed %in% rownames(pred)]
  pred[vars_in_pred, outcome] <- 1L   # outcome predicts all imputed vars
  pred[outcome, ]             <- 0L   # outcome row all zeros
  pred[outcome, outcome]      <- 0L   # no self-prediction
  n_active_outcome <- sum(pred[vars_in_pred, outcome])
  cat(sprintf("✓ Outcome predictor column activated for %d / %d imputed variables\n",
              n_active_outcome, length(vars_in_pred)))
  cat(sprintf("✓ Outcome row zeroed (freq_dich not imputed)\n\n"))
} else {
  cat(sprintf("⚠️  %s not found in predictor matrix rows/cols — check df_imp\n\n",
              outcome))
}

# Remove near-perfectly correlated predictors (|r| > 0.95)
cat("Removing near-perfectly correlated predictors (|r| > 0.95)...\n")
numeric_vars_for_cor <- names(df_imp)[sapply(df_imp, is.numeric)]
numeric_vars_for_cor <- setdiff(numeric_vars_for_cor, outcome)  # exclude outcome
if (length(numeric_vars_for_cor) >= 2) {
  cor_matrix     <- cor(df_imp[, numeric_vars_for_cor],
                        use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  high_cor_pairs <- which(abs(cor_matrix) > 0.95 & abs(cor_matrix) < 1,
                          arr.ind = TRUE)
  n_zeroed <- 0L
  if (nrow(high_cor_pairs) > 0) {
    for (k in seq_len(nrow(high_cor_pairs))) {
      row_var <- rownames(cor_matrix)[high_cor_pairs[k, 1]]
      col_var <- colnames(cor_matrix)[high_cor_pairs[k, 2]]
      if (col_var %in% colnames(pred) && col_var != outcome) {
        pred[row_var, col_var] <- 0
        n_zeroed <- n_zeroed + 1L
      }
    }
    cat(sprintf("  Zeroed %d high-correlation predictor slots\n\n", n_zeroed))
  } else {
    cat("  ✓ No near-perfect correlations found\n\n")
  }
}

# Remove perfectly correlated redundant predictors from Part C
if (length(redundant_predictors) > 0) {
  cat("Removing perfectly correlated redundant predictors...\n")
  for (var in redundant_predictors) {
    if (var %in% colnames(pred) && var != outcome) {
      pred[, var] <- 0
      cat(sprintf("  ✓ Zeroed column: %s (r = 1 — not used as predictor)\n",
                  var))
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
}

# Predictor matrix density
n_possible  <- nrow(pred) * (ncol(pred) - 1)
n_used      <- sum(pred)
pct_used    <- round(100 * n_used / n_possible, 1)
avg_per_var <- round(n_used / nrow(pred), 1)

cat("PREDICTOR MATRIX SUMMARY (after quickpred + outcome column):\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat(sprintf("  Possible predictor slots: %d\n", n_possible))
cat(sprintf("  Active predictor slots:   %d (%.1f%%)\n", n_used, pct_used))
cat(sprintf("  Avg predictors per model: %.1f\n", avg_per_var))
cat(sprintf("  freq_dich column active:  YES (passive predictor for all imputed vars)\n"))
if (avg_per_var > 25)
  cat("  ⚠️  Average > 25 — consider raising mincor to 0.10\n")
if (avg_per_var < 20)
  cat("  ⚠️  Average < 20 — consider lowering mincor further\n")
cat("\n")

# Remove sparse categorical variables from predictor matrix
cat("Checking sparse variables flagged in Part B...\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
if (length(separation_vars) > 0) {
  for (var in separation_vars) {
    if (var %in% colnames(pred)) {
      pred[, var] <- 0
      cat(sprintf("  ✓ Zeroed predictor column: %s (sparse factor)\n", var))
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
} else {
  cat("  ✓ No sparse factor variables to remove\n\n")
}

# Zero out problematic vars as predictors
for (var in problematic_vars)
  if (var %in% colnames(pred)) pred[, var] <- 0

prob_in_pred <- problematic_vars[problematic_vars %in% colnames(pred)]
if (length(prob_in_pred) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ Problematic variables zeroed as predictors: %s\n\n",
              paste(prob_in_pred, collapse = ", ")))
} else {
  cat("  ✓ No additional problematic variables in predictor matrix\n\n")
}

n_used_final      <- sum(pred)
avg_per_var_final <- round(n_used_final / nrow(pred), 1)
cat(sprintf("FINAL predictor matrix: %d active slots, avg %.1f predictors/model\n\n",
            n_used_final, avg_per_var_final))

# ── Assign imputation methods ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
for (var in continuous_vars)
  if (var %in% names(method) && var %in% vars_with_missing)
    method[var] <- "pmm"
for (var in binary_vars)
  if (var %in% names(method) && var %in% vars_with_missing)
    method[var] <- "logreg"
for (var in ordered_vars)
  if (var %in% names(method) && var %in% vars_with_missing)
    method[var] <- "polr"
for (var in polr_unordered_vars)
  if (var %in% names(method) && var %in% vars_with_missing)
    method[var] <- "polr"
for (var in unordered_categorical)
  if (var %in% names(method) && var %in% vars_with_missing)
    method[var] <- "polyreg"
for (var in problematic_vars)
  if (var %in% names(method)) method[var] <- ""

# Outcome stays "" (set above — confirm it has not been overwritten)
if (outcome %in% names(method) && method[outcome] != "") {
  method[outcome] <- ""
  cat(sprintf("⚠️  %s method was overwritten — reset to ''\n\n", outcome))
}

cat("METHOD SUMMARY:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  PMM:        ", sum(method == "pmm"),     "\n")
cat("  Logreg:     ", sum(method == "logreg"),  "\n")
cat("  Polr:       ", sum(method == "polr"),    "\n")
cat("  Polyreg:    ", sum(method == "polyreg"), "\n")
cat("  Not imputed:", sum(method == ""),
    " (includes outcome, derived, complete vars)\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART D5: LOGGED EVENTS DIAGNOSTIC & TARGETED REDUCTION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART D5: LOGGED EVENTS DIAGNOSTIC & TARGETED REDUCTION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

parse_logged_events <- function(mids_obj) {
  le <- mids_obj$loggedEvents
  if (is.null(le) || nrow(le) == 0) return(NULL)
  le$event_type <- dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("singular|rank.deficient|computationally singular",
          le$out, ignore.case = TRUE)                        ~ "singular_system",
    grepl("perfect predictor",  le$out, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "perfect_predictor",
    grepl("constant",           le$out, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "constant_predictor",
    le$meth %in% c("polr","polyreg") & le$out != ""         ~ "polr_separation",
    le$meth %in% c("polr","polyreg") & le$out == ""         ~ "polr_fit_failure",
    le$out != ""                                             ~ "dropped_predictor",
    TRUE                                                     ~ "other"
  )
  le
}

cat("PROBE 1: Baseline — running m=1, maxit=5 to surface logged events...\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

probe1 <- tryCatch(
  mice(df_imp, m = 1, maxit = 5, method = method,
       predictorMatrix = pred, seed = 99, printFlag = FALSE,
       ridge = 1e-3),
  error = function(e) {
    cat("  ⚠️  Probe failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    NULL
  }
)

n_events_before <- 0L

if (!is.null(probe1)) {
  le1 <- parse_logged_events(probe1)

  if (is.null(le1)) {
    cat("  ✓ No logged events in baseline probe\n\n")
  } else {
    n_events_before <- nrow(le1)
    cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  %d logged events detected\n\n", n_events_before))

    type_summary <- le1 %>%
      dplyr::count(event_type, name = "n") %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n))
    cat("  Event breakdown by type:\n")
    for (r in seq_len(nrow(type_summary)))
      cat(sprintf("    %-30s: %d\n",
                  type_summary$event_type[r], type_summary$n[r]))
    cat("\n")

    dep_summary <- le1 %>%
      dplyr::count(dep, event_type, name = "n") %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n)) %>%
      head(20)
    cat("  Top affected target variables:\n")
    for (r in seq_len(nrow(dep_summary)))
      cat(sprintf("    %-30s [%-20s]: %d events\n",
                  dep_summary$dep[r], dep_summary$event_type[r],
                  dep_summary$n[r]))
    cat("\n")

    out_summary <- le1 %>%
      dplyr::filter(out != "") %>%
      dplyr::count(out, name = "n") %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n)) %>%
      head(20)
    if (nrow(out_summary) > 0) {
      cat("  Most frequently problematic predictors:\n")
      for (r in seq_len(nrow(out_summary)))
        cat(sprintf("    %-30s: dropped/flagged %d times\n",
                    out_summary$out[r], out_summary$n[r]))
      cat("\n")
    }

    write.csv(le1, "logged_events_baseline.csv", row.names = FALSE)
    cat("  ✓ Saved: logged_events_baseline.csv\n\n")

    # FIX A: Remove problematic predictor columns
    n_fix_a <- 0L
    singular_preds_raw <- le1 %>%
      dplyr::filter(event_type %in% c("singular_system", "perfect_predictor",
                                       "constant_predictor",
                                       "dropped_predictor")) %>%
      dplyr::filter(out != "") %>%
      dplyr::count(out, name = "n") %>%
      dplyr::filter(n >= 3) %>%
      dplyr::pull(out)

    singular_preds <- unique(
      sub("\\.(L|Q|C|(\\^[0-9]+))$", "", singular_preds_raw))
    # Never zero out the outcome column — it must remain active
    singular_preds <- setdiff(singular_preds, outcome)

    if (length(singular_preds) > 0) {
      cat("  FIX A: Zeroing frequently-problematic predictor columns (≥3 events)\n")
      for (var in singular_preds) {
        if (var %in% colnames(pred)) {
          pred[, var] <- 0
          n_fix_a <- n_fix_a + 1L
          flagged_as <- singular_preds_raw[
            sub("\\.(L|Q|C|(\\^[0-9]+))$", "",
                singular_preds_raw) == var]
          cat(sprintf("    ✓ Zeroed: %-30s (flagged as: %s)\n",
                      var, paste(unique(flagged_as), collapse = ", ")))
        }
      }
      cat("\n")
    } else {
      cat("  FIX A: No columns meet ≥3 events threshold\n\n")
    }

    # FIX B: Switch polr failures to PMM
    polr_failures <- le1 %>%
      dplyr::filter(event_type %in% c("polr_fit_failure",
                                       "polr_separation")) %>%
      dplyr::pull(dep) %>%
      unique()

    n_fix_b <- 0L
    if (length(polr_failures) > 0) {
      cat("  FIX B: Switching polr failures to PMM\n")
      for (var in polr_failures) {
        if (var %in% names(method) && method[var] == "polr") {
          method[var] <- "pmm"
          n_fix_b <- n_fix_b + 1L
          cat(sprintf("    ✓ %s: polr → pmm\n", var))
        }
      }
      cat("\n")
    } else {
      cat("  FIX B: No polr-specific failures detected\n\n")
    }

    # Re-activate outcome column if FIX A inadvertently zeroed it
    if (outcome %in% colnames(pred)) {
      vars_being_imputed2 <- names(method[method != ""])
      vars_in_pred2       <- vars_being_imputed2[vars_being_imputed2 %in% rownames(pred)]
      pred[vars_in_pred2, outcome] <- 1L
      pred[outcome, ]              <- 0L
    }

    # PROBE 2: verify improvement
    if (n_fix_a > 0 || n_fix_b > 0) {
      cat("  PROBE 2: Re-running after fixes...\n")
      probe2 <- tryCatch(
        mice(df_imp, m = 1, maxit = 5, method = method,
             predictorMatrix = pred, seed = 99, printFlag = FALSE,
             ridge = 1e-3),
        error = function(e) {
          cat("  ⚠️  Probe 2 failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
          NULL
        }
      )
      if (!is.null(probe2)) {
        le2            <- parse_logged_events(probe2)
        n_events_after <- if (is.null(le2)) 0L else nrow(le2)
        cat(sprintf(
          "\n  LOGGED EVENTS: %d → %d  (reduction: %d, %.0f%%)\n\n",
          n_events_before, n_events_after,
          n_events_before - n_events_after,
          100 * (n_events_before - n_events_after) /
            max(n_events_before, 1)))
        if (!is.null(le2) && nrow(le2) > 0) {
          remaining_types <- le2 %>%
            dplyr::count(event_type, name = "n") %>%
            dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n))
          cat("  Remaining events after fixes:\n")
          for (r in seq_len(nrow(remaining_types)))
            cat(sprintf("    %-30s: %d\n",
                        remaining_types$event_type[r],
                        remaining_types$n[r]))
          cat("\n")
          write.csv(le2, "logged_events_after_fixes.csv", row.names = FALSE)
          cat("  ✓ Saved: logged_events_after_fixes.csv\n\n")
        }
      }
    } else {
      cat("  ℹ️  No structural fixes applied (ridge = 1e-3 active)\n\n")
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("  ℹ️  Probe skipped — ridge = 1e-3 applied in all imputations\n\n")
}

# Updated summary after D5
n_used_final      <- sum(pred)
avg_per_var_final <- round(n_used_final / nrow(pred), 1)

cat("UPDATED METHOD SUMMARY (after D5 fixes):\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  PMM:        ", sum(method == "pmm"),     "\n")
cat("  Logreg:     ", sum(method == "logreg"),  "\n")
cat("  Polr:       ", sum(method == "polr"),    "\n")
cat("  Polyreg:    ", sum(method == "polyreg"), "\n")
cat("  Not imputed:", sum(method == ""),
    " (outcome + derived + complete vars)\n")
cat(sprintf("  Predictor matrix: %d active slots, avg %.1f/model\n\n",
            n_used_final, avg_per_var_final))

cat("NOTE: ridge = 1e-3 applied in all subsequent mice() calls\n")
cat("  (van Buuren, 2018 §6.4.2 — stabilises near-singular systems)\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART E: STATISTICAL DERIVATION OF m — VON HIPPEL (2020)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART E: STATISTICAL DERIVATION OF m (NUMBER OF IMPUTATIONS)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("METHOD: Von Hippel (2020) two-stage FMI-based quadratic rule\n")
cat("  DOI: 10.1177/0049124117747303\n\n")

cat("STAGE 1: Pilot imputation with m=20, maxit=20\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  Running pilot imputation...\n")

pilot_imp <- NULL

pilot_imp <- tryCatch({
  mice(df_imp, m = 20, maxit = 20, method = method,
       predictorMatrix = pred, seed = 12345, printFlag = FALSE,
       ridge = 1e-3)
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("  ⚠️  Pilot imputation failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
  NULL
})

if (!is.null(pilot_imp)) {
  cat("  ✓ Pilot imputation complete\n\n")

  # Use highest-missingness variable among imputed vars (exclude outcome)
  miss_pct_imputed <- missing_pct[names(method[method != ""])]
  max_miss_var     <- names(which.max(miss_pct_imputed))
  max_miss_pct     <- max(miss_pct_imputed)

  cat("STAGE 2: FMI estimation\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  cat("  Variable:", max_miss_var,
      "(highest missingness:", round(max_miss_pct, 1), "%)\n\n")

  available_preds <- names(df_imp)[
    names(df_imp) != max_miss_var &
      sapply(df_imp, is.numeric) &
      colSums(is.na(df_imp)) == 0
  ]
  available_preds <- head(available_preds, 10)

  fmi_result <- tryCatch({
    if (length(available_preds) >= 2) {
      fmi_formula <- as.formula(
        paste(max_miss_var, "~",
              paste(available_preds, collapse = " + ")))

      fits <- lapply(seq_len(pilot_imp$m), function(i) {
        lm(fmi_formula, data = mice::complete(pilot_imp, action = i))
      })
      pooled_fit <- mice::pool(as.mira(fits))
      cat("  ✓ Model pooled across imputations\n\n")

      list(
        m_standard     = how_many_imputations(pooled_fit),
        m_conservative = how_many_imputations(pooled_fit, cv = 0.01),
        success        = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      cat("  ⚠️  Insufficient complete numeric predictors (need ≥ 2, found",
          length(available_preds), ")\n")
      list(success = FALSE)
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  ⚠️  FMI calculation failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    list(success = FALSE)
  })

  if (isTRUE(fmi_result$success)) {
    cat("FMI-BASED m CALCULATION:\n")
    cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
    cat(sprintf("  m for CV(SE) = 0.05 (5%% precision):  %d\n",
                fmi_result$m_standard))
    cat(sprintf("  m for CV(SE) = 0.01 (1%% precision):  %d\n",
                fmi_result$m_conservative))
    cat("\n")

    m_white_floor <- ceiling(max_miss_pct)
    m_vonhippel   <- fmi_result$m_standard
    optimal_m     <- max(m_vonhippel, m_white_floor, 20)
    if (optimal_m > 100) {
      cat(sprintf("  Initial calculation: %d (capped at 100)\n", optimal_m))
      optimal_m <- 100
    }

    cat("DECISION:\n")
    cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
    cat(sprintf("  Von Hippel (2020) quadratic rule:    m = %d\n",
                m_vonhippel))
    cat(sprintf("  White et al. (2011) floor (≥%% miss): m = %d\n",
                m_white_floor))
    cat(sprintf("  Minimum recommended:                 m = 20\n"))
    cat(sprintf("  → SELECTED m = %d\n\n", optimal_m))

  } else {
    cat("Falling back to White et al. (2011) rule\n\n")
    m_white_floor <- ceiling(max(miss_pct_imputed))
    optimal_m     <- max(m_white_floor, 20)
    if (optimal_m > 100) optimal_m <- 100
    cat(sprintf("  → SELECTED m = %d\n\n", optimal_m))
  }

} else {
  cat("  Pilot failed — using missingness-based fallback\n\n")
  miss_pct_imputed <- missing_pct[names(method[method != ""])]
  m_white_floor    <- ceiling(max(miss_pct_imputed))
  optimal_m        <- max(m_white_floor, 20)
  if (optimal_m > 100) optimal_m <- 100
  cat(sprintf("  → SELECTED m = %d (White et al., 2011)\n\n", optimal_m))
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART F: EMPIRICAL MAXIT DETERMINATION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART F: EMPIRICAL MAXIT DETERMINATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("METHOD: Gelman-Rubin PSRF < 1.1 across maxit = 10, 20, 30, 40\n")
cat("  Pilot m = 5 (convergence independent of m)\n\n")

maxit_candidates    <- c(10, 20, 30, 40)
convergence_results <- data.frame(
  maxit        = maxit_candidates,
  max_psrf     = NA_real_,
  mean_psrf    = NA_real_,
  n_above_1.1  = NA_integer_,
  converged    = NA,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("Running convergence experiment...\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

pilot_imps <- list()

for (i in seq_along(maxit_candidates)) {
  maxit_test <- maxit_candidates[i]
  cat(sprintf("Testing maxit = %d ...\n", maxit_test))

  pilot_imp_test <- tryCatch({
    mice(df_imp, m = 5, maxit = maxit_test, method = method,
         predictorMatrix = pred, seed = 12345, printFlag = FALSE,
         ridge = 1e-3)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  Failed: %s\n", conditionMessage(e)))
    NULL
  })

  if (!is.null(pilot_imp_test)) {
    pilot_imps[[as.character(maxit_test)]] <- pilot_imp_test

    psrf_result <- tryCatch({
      if (!requireNamespace("coda", quietly = TRUE))
        stop("coda package required")

      cm <- pilot_imp_test$chainMean
      if (is.null(cm) || length(dim(cm)) != 3)
        stop("chainMean has unexpected structure")

      n_imp_vars <- dim(cm)[1]
      n_chains   <- dim(cm)[3]

      cat(sprintf(
        "  Computing PSRF [%d vars × %d iters × %d chains]...\n",
        n_imp_vars, dim(cm)[2], n_chains))

      if (n_chains < 2)
        stop("Need m ≥ 2 chains for Gelman-Rubin")

      psrf_vec <- numeric(n_imp_vars)
      for (v in seq_len(n_imp_vars)) {
        chain_list <- lapply(seq_len(n_chains), function(j) {
          vals <- cm[v, , j]
          if (all(is.na(vals)) ||
              var(vals, na.rm = TRUE) < 1e-15) return(NULL)
          coda::mcmc(vals)
        })
        chain_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), chain_list)
        if (length(chain_list) < 2) { psrf_vec[v] <- 1.0; next }
        gd <- tryCatch(
          coda::gelman.diag(coda::mcmc.list(chain_list),
                            autoburnin = FALSE,
                            multivariate = FALSE),
          error = function(e) NULL
        )
        psrf_vec[v] <- if (!is.null(gd)) gd$psrf[1, 1] else NA_real_
      }

      psrf_vec <- psrf_vec[!is.na(psrf_vec) & is.finite(psrf_vec)]
      list(
        success   = TRUE,
        max_psrf  = round(max(psrf_vec),  4),
        mean_psrf = round(mean(psrf_vec), 4),
        n_above   = sum(psrf_vec > 1.1),
        n_vars    = length(psrf_vec),
        converged = max(psrf_vec) < 1.1
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      list(success = FALSE, error_msg = conditionMessage(e))
    })

    if (isTRUE(psrf_result$success)) {
      convergence_results$max_psrf[i]    <- psrf_result$max_psrf
      convergence_results$mean_psrf[i]   <- psrf_result$mean_psrf
      convergence_results$n_above_1.1[i] <- psrf_result$n_above
      convergence_results$converged[i]   <- psrf_result$converged
      status <- if (psrf_result$converged) "✓ CONVERGED" else
        "✗ NOT CONVERGED"
      cat(sprintf(
        "  %s | Max PSRF = %.4f | Mean = %.4f | N > 1.1: %d/%d\n",
        status, psrf_result$max_psrf, psrf_result$mean_psrf,
        psrf_result$n_above, psrf_result$n_vars))
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  PSRF failed: %s\n", psrf_result$error_msg))
      n_le <- if (!is.null(pilot_imp_test$loggedEvents))
        nrow(pilot_imp_test$loggedEvents) else 0
      convergence_results$converged[i] <- (n_le == 0)
    }
  } else {
    cat("  ✗ FAILED\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
}

cat("CONVERGENCE EXPERIMENT RESULTS:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
print(convergence_results[, c("maxit","max_psrf","mean_psrf",
                               "n_above_1.1","converged")],
      row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

converged_rows <- convergence_results[
  !is.na(convergence_results$converged) &
    convergence_results$converged == TRUE, ]

if (nrow(converged_rows) > 0) {
  optimal_maxit <- min(converged_rows$maxit)
  cat(sprintf("✓ Convergence first achieved at maxit = %d\n", optimal_maxit))
} else {
  cat("⚠️  No tested maxit achieved convergence — using maxit = 40\n")
  optimal_maxit <- 40
}
cat(sprintf("\n→ SELECTED maxit = %d\n\n", optimal_maxit))

selected_pilot <- pilot_imps[[as.character(optimal_maxit)]]
if (!is.null(selected_pilot)) {
  tryCatch({
    pdf("convergence_trace_plots_pilot.pdf", width = 12, height = 8)
    plot(selected_pilot,
         main = paste0("Pilot Trace Plots — maxit = ",
                       optimal_maxit, " (m=5)"))
    dev.off()
    cat("✓ Saved: convergence_trace_plots_pilot.pdf\n\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  ⚠️  Could not save trace plots:", conditionMessage(e), "\n\n")
  })
}

write.csv(convergence_results, "convergence_experiment_results.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: convergence_experiment_results.csv\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART G: SAVE OPTIMIZATION RESULTS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART G: SAVING OPTIMIZATION RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# df_imp now includes freq_dich as a passive predictor column
saveRDS(df_imp, "df_imputation_ready.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: df_imputation_ready.rds\n")
cat(sprintf("  Includes %s as passive predictor (method = '')\n", outcome))
cat(sprintf("  Dimensions: %d rows × %d columns\n\n", nrow(df_imp), ncol(df_imp)))

imputation_parameters <- list(
  optimal_m     = optimal_m,
  optimal_maxit = optimal_maxit,
  outcome       = outcome,
  optimal_m_justification = paste0(
    "Von Hippel (2020) two-stage FMI quadratic rule. ",
    "Pilot m=20. FMI from highest-missing imputed variable (",
    names(which.max(missing_pct[names(method[method != ""])])), ", ",
    round(max(missing_pct[names(method[method != ""])]), 1), "% missing). ",
    "Floor: White et al. (2011) m >= % missing = ",
    ceiling(max(missing_pct[names(method[method != ""])])), "."
  ),
  optimal_maxit_justification = paste0(
    "Empirical convergence experiment: m=5 at maxit=10,20,30,40. ",
    "Gelman-Rubin PSRF < 1.1. Convergence at maxit=", optimal_maxit, "."
  ),
  convergence_experiment           = convergence_results,
  method                           = method,
  predictor_matrix                 = pred,
  variable_types = list(
    continuous      = continuous_vars,
    binary          = binary_vars,
    ordered         = ordered_vars,
    polr_unordered  = polr_unordered_vars,
    unordered       = unordered_categorical
  ),
  likert_items_as_pmm              = likert_items,
  excluded_variables               = c(problematic_vars),  # outcome NOT excluded
  derived_variables_to_recalculate = derived_vars,
  redundant_predictors_zeroed      = redundant_predictors,
  ridge_penalty                    = 1e-3,
  logged_events_before_fixes       = n_events_before,
  n_observations                   = nrow(df_imp),
  n_variables                      = ncol(df_imp),
  n_vars_to_impute                 = sum(method != ""),
  max_missingness_pct              = max(missing_pct[names(method[method != ""])]),
  avg_missingness_pct              = mean(missing_pct[names(method[method != ""])][
    missing_pct[names(method[method != ""])] > 0]),
  mincor_used                      = 0.07,
  minpuc_used                      = 0.10,
  outcome_as_passive_predictor     = TRUE,
  outcome_rationale = paste0(
    "freq_dich retained in df_imp with method = '' and predictor column ",
    "activated. Excluding the outcome attenuates predictor-outcome ",
    "associations in imputed data and corrupts VSURF importance scores. ",
    "References: Donders et al. (2006) J Clin Epidemiol 59:1092-1101; ",
    "van Buuren (2018) Flexible Imputation §6.3.1."
  ),
  reverse_coding_done = list(
    bfi   = analysis_vars$bfi_reversed,
    surps = analysis_vars$surps_reversed
  ),
  withdrawal_coding_note = paste0(
    "stop_wdl_exp_combined collapsed from 6 levels to 3: ",
    "0=No withdrawal, 1=Insomnia only, 2=Other withdrawal symptoms. ",
    "Stored as unordered factor (dummy coding in regression). ",
    "Imputed with polr under a defensible monotone burden gradient ",
    "(none < insomnia only < other/multiple). wdl_symptom_count retained ",
    "as continuous."
  ),
  bzra_dose_note = paste0(
    "bzra_daily_diazepam_eq: average daily diazepam-equivalent dose (mg/day). ",
    "Single dose variable; the weekly version was dropped in Chunk 5+6 ",
    "(unused downstream and perfectly collinear with daily). Imputed via PMM. ",
    "Note: averaged rate (weekly total / 7), not a literal daily dose."
  )
)

saveRDS(imputation_parameters, "imputation_parameters_optimized.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: imputation_parameters_optimized.rds\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART H: FINAL SUMMARY
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("DIAGNOSTICS COMPLETE — SUMMARY\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("STATISTICALLY-DERIVED PARAMETERS:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat(sprintf("  m     = %d  (Von Hippel, 2020)\n", optimal_m))
cat(sprintf("  maxit = %d  (Gelman-Rubin PSRF convergence experiment)\n",
            optimal_maxit))
cat(sprintf("  Variables to impute: %d\n", sum(method != "")))
cat(sprintf("  Observations:        %d\n\n", nrow(df_imp)))

cat("IMPUTATION METHOD BREAKDOWN:\n")
cat(sprintf("  PMM (continuous + all Likert items): %d\n",
            sum(method == "pmm")))
cat(sprintf("    Likert belief/COM-B items:          %d\n",
            sum(likert_items %in% names(method)[method == "pmm"])))
cat(sprintf("    Personality scale items:            %d\n",
            sum(scale_vars_all %in% names(method)[method == "pmm"])))
cat(sprintf("    Includes: bzra_daily_diazepam_eq (mg/day)\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Logreg (binary):                     %d\n",
            sum(method == "logreg")))
cat(sprintf("  Polr (ordered):                      %d\n",
            sum(method == "polr")))
cat(sprintf("    Includes: fall2, alc_use, education, income,\n"))
cat(sprintf("              employment, driving_freq, gen_health, sleep aids\n"))
cat(sprintf("    Includes: stop_wdl_exp_combined (3-level factor stored\n"))
cat(sprintf("              unordered, imputed with polr, dummy-coded in regression)\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Polyreg (unordered):                 %d\n",
            sum(method == "polyreg")))
cat(sprintf("  Not imputed (method = ''):           %d\n",
            sum(method == "")))
cat(sprintf("    Includes: %s (passive predictor — complete, not imputed)\n",
            outcome))
cat(sprintf("    Includes: complete variables\n\n"))

cat("PREDICTOR MATRIX:\n")
cat(sprintf("  mincor = 0.07, minpuc = 0.10\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Final avg predictors/model: %.1f\n", avg_per_var_final))
cat(sprintf("  freq_dich column: ACTIVE for all %d imputed variables\n",
            sum(method != "")))
cat(sprintf("  freq_dich row:    ZEROED (not imputed itself)\n\n"))

cat("KEY DECISIONS:\n")
cat("  • Outcome (freq_dich): retained in df_imp as passive predictor\n")
cat("      method = '' (not imputed); predictor column activated\n")
cat("      Rationale: preserves predictor-outcome associations in imputed\n")
cat("      data; critical for VSURF importance scores downstream\n")
cat("      (Donders et al., 2006; van Buuren, 2018 §6.3.1)\n")
cat("  • All Likert items (belief/COM-B, 5-point) → PMM\n")
cat("  • wdl_symptom_count (0-4 count) → PMM\n")
cat("  • bzra_daily_diazepam_eq (mg/day) → PMM\n")
cat("  • fall2 (0=none, 1=minor, 2=serious) → polr (ordered)\n")
cat("  • stop_wdl_exp_combined (3-level) → polr; stored UNORDERED\n")
cat("      (dummy coding in regression), imputed ordinally under a\n")
cat("      defensible burden gradient\n")
cat("  • alc_use (0-4 ordinal) → polr\n")
cat("  • prov_terr → polyreg\n")
cat("  • n_health_conditions removed (derived — recalculated post-imputation)\n")
cat("  • mincor = 0.07 (target avg 20-25 predictors/model)\n")
cat("  • ridge = 1e-3 applied to all mice() calls\n\n")

cat("CONVERGENCE EXPERIMENT:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
print(convergence_results[, c("maxit","max_psrf","mean_psrf",
                               "n_above_1.1","converged")],
      row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("\n  → Convergence at maxit = %d\n\n", optimal_maxit))

cat("KEY CITATIONS:\n")

cat("  • Van Buuren (2018) Flexible Imputation §6.3.1          [outcome as predictor]\n")
cat("  • Von Hippel (2020) Sociol Methods Res 49(3):699-718   [m]\n")

cat("  • Brooks & Gelman (1998) J Comp Graph Stat 7(4):434    [maxit]\n")
cat("  • Van Buuren (2018) Flexible Imputation (2nd ed.)       [general]\n\n")

cat("FILES CREATED:\n")
```
