## Multiple Imputation

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 8: MULTIPLE IMPUTATION
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Perform multiple imputation using MICE with parameters optimized
#          in Chunk 7, then run comprehensive statistical verification
# Outputs: Imputed datasets + full diagnostic report
#
# CHUNK 7 PARAMETERS CARRIED FORWARD (all read from imp_params at run time —
# do NOT hard-code m/maxit/predictor counts in this script; they are printed
# from the loaded object so the text always matches the actual run):
#   m     = imp_params$optimal_m       (Von Hippel, 2020 FMI quadratic rule;
#                                        CV(SE) = 5% precision target;
#                                        White et al. 2011 floor = % missing,
#                                        min = 20)
#   maxit = imp_params$optimal_maxit   (Gelman-Rubin PSRF convergence
#                                        experiment; first maxit achieving
#                                        PSRF < 1.1 for all vars)
#   ridge = imp_params$ridge_penalty   (stability stabiliser, van Buuren §6.4.2)
#   mincor = 0.07, minpuc = 0.10       (predictor matrix)
#
# VARIABLE TYPE ASSIGNMENTS (from Chunk 7):
#   PMM (continuous + all Likert/COM-B items)
#       All continuous variables (age, med_quant, phq2_score, osss_3_score,
#       n_physical_conditions, n_ment_conditions, n_sleep_conditions,
#       wdl_symptom_count, bzra_daily_diazepam_eq, c_lengthofuse),
#       belief/COM-B Likert items (benefit_1/4/5/6, side_effects_1:4,
#       adls_1:2, dependence_1:3, motivation_1:3, capability_1/capability,
#       desires_1:2, inf_hcp_1/3),
#       DBAS, BFI, SURPS, CISS personality scale items
#   Logreg (1):   sex
#   Polr (ordered factors):
#       education, income, employment, driving_freq, gen_health, fall2,
#       alc_use, sleep_aids variables
#   Polr / unordered storage (1):
#       stop_wdl_exp_combined — 3-level factor (0=No withdrawal,
#       1=Insomnia only, 2=Other withdrawal symptoms), stored as UNORDERED
#       so downstream regression uses dummy coding (coefficients for
#       levels 1 and 2 vs reference 0), not polynomial contrasts;
#       imputed with polr under a monotone burden gradient (see Chunk 7 Part D).
#   Polyreg (1):  prov_terr
#   Not imputed:  n_health_conditions (derived: sum of components,
#                 recalculated in Part E),
#                 complete variables, outcome (freq_dich)
#
# BZRA DOSE VARIABLE:
#   bzra_daily_diazepam_eq (mg/day, true diazepam-mg equivalent) is the
#   single dose variable. It is imputed via PMM like any other continuous
#   variable. The weekly version was dropped in Chunk 5+6 (unused downstream
#   and perfectly collinear with daily) — there is NO weekly recalculation
#   in this chunk.
#
# OUTCOME:
#   freq_dich (0/1 = stoppers, 2 = continuers). In Chunk 7 it was retained
#   in df_imp as a passive predictor (method = ""). It is therefore already
#   present in the imputed data; Part F verifies it rather than re-attaching.
#
# DOWNSTREAM USAGE NOTE:
#   Two output objects are saved:
#     • mice_imputation_object.rds  — the raw mids object from mice().
#         n_health_conditions is NOT present (removed in Chunk 7 Part B4).
#         Use for mice::pool() on directly imputed variables.
#     • imputed_datasets_final.rds  — list of m complete data frames.
#         All derived variables recalculated (Part E).
#         This is the primary object for Chunk 9 onward.
#==============================================================================

library(mice)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(coda)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("MULTIPLE IMPUTATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load optimized parameters from Chunk 7
if (!file.exists("df_imputation_ready.rds") ||
    !file.exists("imputation_parameters_optimized.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: Required files not found. Please run Chunk 7 first.")
}

df_imp     <- readRDS("df_imputation_ready.rds")
imp_params <- readRDS("imputation_parameters_optimized.rds")

# Also load analysis_vars for scale item names (used in D7)
if (file.exists("analysis_variable_lists.rds")) {
  analysis_vars <- readRDS("analysis_variable_lists.rds")
  cat("✓ Loaded analysis_variable_lists.rds\n")
} else {
  analysis_vars <- NULL
  cat("⚠️  analysis_variable_lists.rds not found — D7 scale pairs will use\n")
  cat("    hardcoded fallback names. Re-run Chunk 5+6 if item names changed.\n")
}

# Convenience locals — single source of truth for all printed parameters.
M_IMP     <- imp_params$optimal_m
MAXIT_IMP <- imp_params$optimal_maxit
RIDGE_IMP <- imp_params$ridge_penalty

# Average predictors/model, computed from the actual predictor matrix rather
# than hard-coded, so the reported figure always matches the object in use.
AVG_PRED  <- round(sum(imp_params$predictor_matrix) /
                     nrow(imp_params$predictor_matrix), 1)

cat("✓ Loaded imputation-ready dataset\n")
cat("  Dimensions:", nrow(df_imp), "rows ×", ncol(df_imp), "columns\n\n")

cat("✓ Loaded optimized parameters from Chunk 7\n")
cat("  m     =", M_IMP,     "(Von Hippel, 2020 FMI quadratic rule)\n")
cat("  maxit =", MAXIT_IMP, "(Gelman-Rubin PSRF convergence experiment)\n")
cat("  ridge =", RIDGE_IMP, "(van Buuren §6.4.2)\n")
cat("  Variables to impute:", imp_params$n_vars_to_impute, "\n")
cat("  Avg predictors/model:", AVG_PRED, "(mincor=0.07, minpuc=0.10)\n\n")

# Sanity check: warn if the retired bzra names appear anywhere in the data.
if ("bzra_weekly_dose_eq" %in% names(df_imp) ||
    "bzra_daily_dose_eq" %in% names(df_imp)) {
  warning("Retired bzra name(s) present in df_imp — expected only ",
          "bzra_daily_diazepam_eq. Check Chunk 5+6/7 output.")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART A: RUNNING MULTIPLE IMPUTATION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART A: RUNNING MULTIPLE IMPUTATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("IMPUTATION PARAMETERS:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  Number of imputations (m):", M_IMP,
    "(Von Hippel, 2020 FMI quadratic rule; CV(SE)=5%)\n")
cat("  Iterations (maxit):       ", MAXIT_IMP,
    "(Gelman-Rubin PSRF convergence experiment;\n")
cat("                               first maxit with max PSRF < 1.1)\n")
cat("  Ridge penalty:            ", RIDGE_IMP,
    "(van Buuren §6.4.2)\n")
cat("  Variables to impute:      ", imp_params$n_vars_to_impute, "\n")
cat("  Avg predictors/model:     ", AVG_PRED, "(mincor=0.07, minpuc=0.10)\n")
cat("  Imputation methods:\n")
cat("    • PMM:     ", sum(imp_params$method == "pmm"),
    "vars (continuous + all Likert/COM-B + personality scale items)\n")
cat("    • Logreg:  ", sum(imp_params$method == "logreg"),
    "vars (sex)\n")
cat("    • Polr:    ", sum(imp_params$method == "polr"),
    "vars (education, income, employment, driving_freq, gen_health,\n")
cat("               fall2, alc_use, sleep_aids, stop_wdl_exp_combined)\n")
cat("    • Polyreg: ", sum(imp_params$method == "polyreg"),
    "vars (prov_terr)\n")
cat("    • Not imputed:", sum(imp_params$method == ""),
    "vars (derived, complete, or outcome)\n\n")

cat("JUSTIFICATION:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  m:     ", imp_params$optimal_m_justification,    "\n\n")
cat("  maxit: ", imp_params$optimal_maxit_justification, "\n\n")

cat("VARIABLE TYPE NOTES:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  All Likert belief/COM-B items (5-point) → PMM\n")
cat("    Rationale: PMM donor-matching preferred over ordered regression\n")
cat("    for items treated as continuous in downstream analyses.\n")
cat("  wdl_symptom_count (0-4 integer count) → PMM\n")
cat("  bzra_daily_diazepam_eq (mg/day) → PMM\n")
cat("  fall2 (0=none, 1=minor, 2=serious) → polr (ordered)\n")
cat("  stop_wdl_exp_combined (3-level) → polr, stored as UNORDERED factor\n")
cat("    to produce dummy-coded coefficients (levels 1 and 2 vs reference 0)\n")
cat("    rather than polynomial contrasts (.L/.Q) in downstream regression.\n")
cat("  alc_use (0=Never … 4=Very high, ordered) → polr\n")
cat("  prov_terr (unordered nominal) → polyreg\n")
cat("  n_health_conditions excluded; recalculated in Part E as:\n")
cat("    n_physical_conditions + n_ment_conditions + n_sleep_conditions\n\n")

cat("CHUNK 7 ADJUSTMENTS APPLIED TO PREDICTOR MATRIX:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

if (!is.null(imp_params$redundant_predictors_zeroed) &&
    length(imp_params$redundant_predictors_zeroed) > 0) {
  for (v in imp_params$redundant_predictors_zeroed)
    cat(sprintf("  • %-35s zeroed as predictor (r = 1)\n", v))
} else {
  cat("  • No perfectly correlated predictors zeroed\n")
}
cat("  • ridge = 1e-3 applied to all mice() calls\n\n")

# Run MICE
cat("Starting imputation (m=", M_IMP,
    ", maxit=", MAXIT_IMP,
    ", ridge=", RIDGE_IMP, ")...\n", sep = "")
cat("This may take several minutes...\n\n")

start_time <- Sys.time()

imp_final <- mice(
  data            = df_imp,
  m               = M_IMP,
  maxit           = MAXIT_IMP,
  method          = imp_params$method,
  predictorMatrix = imp_params$predictor_matrix,
  ridge           = RIDGE_IMP,
  seed            = 12345,
  printFlag       = TRUE
)

end_time     <- Sys.time()
elapsed_time <- difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins")

cat("\n✓ Imputation complete!\n")
cat("  Time elapsed:", round(as.numeric(elapsed_time), 2), "minutes\n\n")

# Logged events check
n_logged <- if (!is.null(imp_final$loggedEvents))
  nrow(imp_final$loggedEvents) else 0L

if (n_logged > 0) {
  cat("⚠️  LOGGED EVENTS DURING FINAL IMPUTATION:\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  cat("  Total events:", n_logged, "\n")
  cat("  Review each — with the weekly dose variable removed, there is no\n")
  cat("  longer an expected/benign dropped_predictor event to ignore.\n\n")
  event_summary <- table(imp_final$loggedEvents$out)
  cat("  Event types:\n")
  for (event in names(event_summary))
    cat("    •", event, ":", event_summary[event], "times\n")
  cat("\n  First 10 events:\n")
  print(head(imp_final$loggedEvents, 10))
  write.csv(imp_final$loggedEvents, "imputation_logged_events.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("  ✓ Saved: imputation_logged_events.csv\n\n")
} else {
  cat("✓ No logged events — imputation completed without issues\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART B: CONVERGENCE DIAGNOSTICS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART B: CONVERGENCE DIAGNOSTICS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat(sprintf(paste0(
  "EXPECTED: Convergence at maxit=%d was confirmed in the Chunk 7\n",
  "  experiment (Gelman-Rubin PSRF < 1.1). Full imputation chains\n",
  "  should replicate this result.\n\n"), MAXIT_IMP))

# ── B1. Gelman-Rubin PSRF ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("B1. Gelman-Rubin PSRF on final imputation\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  Computing PSRF from chainMean [vars × maxit × m]...\n")

psrf_final <- tryCatch({

  cm         <- imp_final$chainMean
  n_imp_vars <- dim(cm)[1]
  n_iter     <- dim(cm)[2]
  n_chains   <- dim(cm)[3]

  psrf_vec  <- numeric(n_imp_vars)
  var_names <- dimnames(cm)[[1]]

  for (v in seq_len(n_imp_vars)) {
    chain_list <- lapply(seq_len(n_chains), function(j) {
      vals <- cm[v, , j]
      if (all(is.na(vals)) || var(vals, na.rm = TRUE) < 1e-15) return(NULL)
      coda::mcmc(vals)
    })
    chain_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), chain_list)
    if (length(chain_list) < 2) { psrf_vec[v] <- 1.0; next }
    gd <- tryCatch(
      coda::gelman.diag(coda::mcmc.list(chain_list),
                        autoburnin = FALSE, multivariate = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL)
    psrf_vec[v] <- if (!is.null(gd)) gd$psrf[1, 1] else NA_real_
  }

  setNames(psrf_vec, var_names)

}, error = function(e) {
  cat("  ⚠️  PSRF calculation failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
  NULL
})

if (!is.null(psrf_final)) {
  psrf_clean <- psrf_final[!is.na(psrf_final) & is.finite(psrf_final)]
  max_psrf   <- max(psrf_clean)
  mean_psrf  <- mean(psrf_clean)
  n_above    <- sum(psrf_clean > 1.1)
  converged  <- max_psrf < 1.1

  cat(sprintf("  Max PSRF:    %.4f %s\n", max_psrf,
              if (max_psrf < 1.1) "✓" else "⚠️"))
  cat(sprintf("  Mean PSRF:   %.4f\n", mean_psrf))
  cat(sprintf("  N > 1.1:     %d / %d\n", n_above, length(psrf_clean)))
  cat(sprintf("  Reference:   Chunk 7 convergence experiment (maxit=%d)\n",
              MAXIT_IMP))

  if (converged) {
    cat("  ✓ CONVERGED — all chains settled (PSRF < 1.1)\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("  ⚠️  NOT FULLY CONVERGED — consider increasing maxit beyond 40\n\n")
    high_psrf_vars <- sort(psrf_clean[psrf_clean > 1.1], decreasing = TRUE)
    cat("  Variables with PSRF > 1.1:\n")
    for (v in seq_along(high_psrf_vars))
      cat(sprintf("    %2d. %-35s PSRF = %.4f\n",
                  v, names(high_psrf_vars)[v], high_psrf_vars[v]))
    cat("\n")
  }

  psrf_df <- data.frame(
    variable  = names(psrf_clean),
    psrf      = round(psrf_clean, 4),
    converged = psrf_clean < 1.1
  ) %>% arrange(desc(psrf))

  write.csv(psrf_df, "final_imputation_psrf.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("  ✓ Saved: final_imputation_psrf.csv\n\n")
}

# ── B2. Trace plots ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("B2. Trace plots\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

vars_to_plot <- c(
  "age", "education", "income",
  "phq2_score", "osss_3_score", "med_quant",
  "alc_use", "gen_health", "fall2",
  "side_effects_1", "dependence_1",
  "motivation_1", "desires_1", "capability",
  "benefit_1", "adls_1", "inf_hcp_1",
  "stop_wdl_exp_combined", "prov_terr"
)
vars_to_plot <- vars_to_plot[
  vars_to_plot %in% names(imp_params$method[imp_params$method != ""])]

cat("  Plotting", length(vars_to_plot), "representative variables...\n")
tryCatch({
  pdf("convergence_trace_plots_final.pdf", width = 14, height = 10)
  plot(imp_final, y = vars_to_plot,
       main = paste0("Final Imputation Trace Plots (m=",
                     M_IMP, ", maxit=", MAXIT_IMP, ")"))
  dev.off()
  cat("  ✓ Saved: convergence_trace_plots_final.pdf\n\n")
}, error = function(e)
  cat("  ⚠️  Trace plot failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n\n"))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART C: DISTRIBUTION DIAGNOSTICS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART C: DISTRIBUTION DIAGNOSTICS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("PURPOSE: Verify imputed values have plausible distributions.\n")
cat("  Red = observed, Blue = imputed. Distributions should be similar\n")
cat("  under MAR; systematic differences are not necessarily wrong but\n")
cat("  warrant scrutiny (van Buuren, 2018 §6.6).\n\n")

continuous_to_plot <- vars_to_plot[
  vars_to_plot %in% imp_params$variable_types$continuous]

if (length(continuous_to_plot) > 0) {
  vars_for_density <- head(continuous_to_plot, 8)
  cat("  Density plots for:", paste(vars_for_density, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  tryCatch({
    pdf("imputation_density_plots.pdf", width = 14, height = 10)
    print(densityplot(imp_final,
                      as.formula(paste("~",
                                       paste(vars_for_density,
                                             collapse = " + ")))))
    dev.off()
    cat("  ✓ Saved: imputation_density_plots.pdf\n\n")
  }, error = function(e)
    cat("  ⚠️  Density plot failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n\n"))
} else {
  cat("  No continuous variables available from plot list\n\n")
}

ordered_to_plot <- vars_to_plot[
  vars_to_plot %in% imp_params$variable_types$ordered]
if (length(ordered_to_plot) > 0) {
  vars_for_strip <- head(ordered_to_plot, 6)
  tryCatch({
    pdf("imputation_stripplots.pdf", width = 12, height = 8)
    print(stripplot(imp_final,
                    as.formula(paste("~",
                                     paste(vars_for_strip, collapse = " + "))),
                    pch = 20, cex = 0.6))
    dev.off()
    cat("  ✓ Saved: imputation_stripplots.pdf\n\n")
  }, error = function(e)
    cat("  ⚠️  Stripplot failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n\n"))
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART D: STATISTICAL VERIFICATION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART D: STATISTICAL VERIFICATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Extract all imputed datasets
all_imp_list <- lapply(seq_len(M_IMP),
                       function(i) mice::complete(imp_final, i))

# ── D1. Completeness check ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("D1. Completeness check\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  PURPOSE: Confirm every imputed variable has zero missing values\n")
cat("           in every completed dataset.\n\n")

imp_vars <- names(imp_params$method[imp_params$method != ""])

completeness_fails <- character()
for (i in seq_along(all_imp_list)) {
  d <- all_imp_list[[i]]
  for (var in imp_vars) {
    if (var %in% names(d) && anyNA(d[[var]]))
      completeness_fails <- c(completeness_fails,
                              sprintf("  Imputation %d, variable: %s", i, var))
  }
}

if (length(completeness_fails) == 0) {
  cat("  ✓ PASS — All", length(imp_vars), "imputed variables are complete",
      "across all", M_IMP, "datasets\n\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("  ✗ FAIL — %d incompleteness issues detected:\n",
              length(completeness_fails)))
  for (msg in head(completeness_fails, 20)) cat("   ", msg, "\n")
  cat("\n")
}

# ── D2. Range preservation check (PMM) ───────────────────────────────────────
cat("D2. Range preservation check (PMM variables)\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  PURPOSE: PMM imputes by matching observed donors, so imputed\n")
cat("           values MUST lie within the observed range.\n")
cat("  Applies to all continuous, Likert/COM-B, and personality scale\n")
cat("  items assigned method = 'pmm'.\n\n")

pmm_vars <- names(imp_params$method[imp_params$method == "pmm"])
pmm_vars <- pmm_vars[pmm_vars %in% names(df_imp)]
pmm_vars <- pmm_vars[sapply(df_imp[pmm_vars], is.numeric)]

range_fails   <- character()
range_summary <- data.frame()

for (var in pmm_vars) {
  if (!var %in% names(df_imp)) next
  obs_vals <- df_imp[[var]][!is.na(df_imp[[var]])]
  if (length(obs_vals) == 0) next
  obs_min <- min(obs_vals)
  obs_max <- max(obs_vals)

  all_imp_vals <- unlist(lapply(all_imp_list, function(d) {
    orig_na <- is.na(df_imp[[var]])
    if (sum(orig_na) == 0) return(NULL)
    d[[var]][orig_na]
  }))

  if (length(all_imp_vals) == 0) next
  all_imp_vals <- all_imp_vals[!is.na(all_imp_vals)]
  if (length(all_imp_vals) == 0) next

  imp_min      <- min(all_imp_vals)
  imp_max      <- max(all_imp_vals)
  out_of_range <- sum(all_imp_vals < obs_min | all_imp_vals > obs_max,
                      na.rm = TRUE)

  range_summary <- rbind(range_summary, data.frame(
    variable       = var,
    obs_min        = obs_min,
    obs_max        = obs_max,
    imp_min        = imp_min,
    imp_max        = imp_max,
    n_out_of_range = out_of_range
  ))

  if (out_of_range > 0)
    range_fails <- c(range_fails,
                     sprintf("%-35s obs [%.1f, %.1f]  imp [%.1f, %.1f]  n_OOB=%d",
                             var, obs_min, obs_max,
                             imp_min, imp_max, out_of_range))
}

if (length(range_fails) == 0) {
  cat("  ✓ PASS — All PMM imputed values lie within observed ranges\n\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  %d PMM variables have out-of-range imputed values:\n",
              length(range_fails)))
  for (msg in range_fails) cat("    ", msg, "\n")
  cat("\n")
}

# ── D3. Mean / SD comparison (observed vs imputed) ───────────────────────────
cat("D3. Observed vs imputed mean / SD comparison\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  PURPOSE: Under MAR the imputed and observed distributions\n")
cat("           should be broadly similar. Large |SMD| > 0.5 flags\n")
cat("           potential MNAR bias or miscoded variables.\n")
cat("  NOTE: Personality scale items (CISS, SURPS, DBAS, BFI) account\n")
cat("        for most of the missingness. Moderate |SMD| for these is\n")
cat("        expected if missingness is related to trait levels.\n\n")

vars_for_qc <- names(imp_params$method[imp_params$method == "pmm"])
vars_for_qc <- vars_for_qc[vars_for_qc %in% names(df_imp)]
vars_for_qc <- vars_for_qc[sapply(df_imp[vars_for_qc], is.numeric)]
vars_for_qc <- vars_for_qc[
  colSums(is.na(df_imp[, vars_for_qc, drop = FALSE])) > 0]

quality_df <- data.frame()

for (var in vars_for_qc) {
  obs_vals <- df_imp[[var]][!is.na(df_imp[[var]])]
  if (length(obs_vals) < 5) next

  orig_na <- is.na(df_imp[[var]])
  if (sum(orig_na) == 0) next

  imp_vals <- unlist(lapply(all_imp_list, function(d) d[[var]][orig_na]))
  imp_vals <- imp_vals[!is.na(imp_vals)]
  if (length(imp_vals) == 0) next

  obs_mean  <- mean(obs_vals);   obs_sd  <- sd(obs_vals)
  imp_mean  <- mean(imp_vals);   imp_sd  <- sd(imp_vals)
  pooled_sd <- sqrt((obs_sd^2 + imp_sd^2) / 2)
  smd       <- if (pooled_sd > 0) (imp_mean - obs_mean) / pooled_sd else 0

  quality_df <- rbind(quality_df, data.frame(
    variable  = var,
    n_missing = sum(orig_na),
    obs_mean  = round(obs_mean, 3),
    obs_sd    = round(obs_sd,   3),
    imp_mean  = round(imp_mean, 3),
    imp_sd    = round(imp_sd,   3),
    mean_diff = round(imp_mean - obs_mean, 3),
    sd_ratio  = round(imp_sd / obs_sd,     3),
    abs_smd   = round(abs(smd),            3),
    flag      = if (abs(smd) > 0.5) "⚠️ REVIEW" else "✓"
  ))
}

if (nrow(quality_df) > 0) {
  flagged <- quality_df[quality_df$flag == "⚠️ REVIEW", ]
  ok      <- quality_df[quality_df$flag == "✓", ]

  cat(sprintf("  Variables assessed: %d\n", nrow(quality_df)))
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ Acceptable (|SMD| ≤ 0.5): %d\n", nrow(ok)))
  cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  Review (|SMD| > 0.5):    %d\n\n", nrow(flagged)))

  if (nrow(flagged) > 0) {
    cat("  FLAGGED VARIABLES:\n")
    print(flagged[, c("variable","n_missing","obs_mean","imp_mean",
                      "obs_sd","imp_sd","abs_smd")],
          row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)
    cat("\n")
  }

  cat("  SUMMARY STATISTICS:\n")
  cat(sprintf("    Median |SMD|:    %.3f\n", median(quality_df$abs_smd)))
  cat(sprintf("    Max |SMD|:       %.3f\n", max(quality_df$abs_smd)))
  cat(sprintf("    Median SD ratio: %.3f\n", median(quality_df$sd_ratio)))
  cat(sprintf("    Max SD ratio:    %.3f\n\n", max(quality_df$sd_ratio)))

  write.csv(quality_df, "imputation_quality_assessment.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("  ✓ Saved: imputation_quality_assessment.csv\n\n")
}

# ── D4. Between-imputation variance (RIV) ─────────────────────────────────────
cat("D4. Between-imputation variance stability\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  PURPOSE: Rubin's rules decompose variance into within (W) and\n")
cat("           between (B) components. RIV = B/W. If B >> W for many\n")
cat("           variables, m may be too small or chains have not mixed.\n")
cat(sprintf("  NOTE: m=%d selected for CV(SE)=5%% (Von Hippel, 2020).\n\n",
            M_IMP))

riv_df <- data.frame()

for (var in vars_for_qc[vars_for_qc %in% names(df_imp)]) {
  orig_na <- is.na(df_imp[[var]])
  if (sum(orig_na) < 5) next

  imp_means <- sapply(all_imp_list,
                      function(d) mean(d[[var]][orig_na], na.rm = TRUE))
  imp_vars  <- sapply(all_imp_list,
                      function(d) var(d[[var]][orig_na],  na.rm = TRUE))

  W   <- mean(imp_vars)
  B   <- var(imp_means)
  RIV <- if (W > 0) B / W else NA_real_

  riv_df <- rbind(riv_df, data.frame(
    variable = var,
    W        = round(W,   4),
    B        = round(B,   4),
    RIV      = round(RIV, 4),
    flag     = if (!is.na(RIV) && RIV > 1.0) "⚠️ HIGH B" else "✓"
  ))
}

if (nrow(riv_df) > 0) {
  flagged_riv <- riv_df[!is.na(riv_df$flag) & riv_df$flag == "⚠️ HIGH B", ]
  cat(sprintf("  Variables assessed: %d\n", nrow(riv_df)))
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ Stable (RIV ≤ 1.0): %d\n",
              nrow(riv_df) - nrow(flagged_riv)))
  cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  High B/W (RIV > 1): %d\n", nrow(flagged_riv)))
  cat(sprintf("  Median RIV: %.4f\n", median(riv_df$RIV, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("  Max RIV:    %.4f\n\n", max(riv_df$RIV, na.rm = TRUE)))

  if (nrow(flagged_riv) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf(paste0(
      "  HIGH RIV VARIABLES (B > W — consider increasing m beyond %d):\n"),
      M_IMP))
    print(flagged_riv %>% arrange(desc(RIV)) %>% head(10),
          row.names = FALSE)
    cat("\n")
  }

  write.csv(riv_df %>% arrange(desc(RIV)),
            "imputation_variance_decomposition.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("  ✓ Saved: imputation_variance_decomposition.csv\n\n")
}

# ── D5. FMI per variable ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("D5. Fraction of Missing Information (FMI) per variable\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  PURPOSE: FMI quantifies how much variance is attributable\n")
cat("           to missingness. High FMI (> 0.5) means estimates\n")
cat("           are heavily influenced by the imputation model.\n\n")

fmi_df <- data.frame()

for (var in vars_for_qc[vars_for_qc %in% names(df_imp)]) {
  orig_na <- is.na(df_imp[[var]])
  if (sum(orig_na) < 5) next

  imp_means <- sapply(all_imp_list,
                      function(d) mean(d[[var]][orig_na], na.rm = TRUE))
  imp_vars  <- sapply(all_imp_list,
                      function(d) var(d[[var]][orig_na],  na.rm = TRUE))

  m     <- length(imp_means)
  W     <- mean(imp_vars)
  B     <- var(imp_means)
  T_var <- W + B + B / m
  FMI   <- if (T_var > 0) (B + B / m) / T_var else NA_real_

  fmi_df <- rbind(fmi_df, data.frame(
    variable    = var,
    pct_missing = round(100 * sum(orig_na) / nrow(df_imp), 1),
    FMI         = round(FMI, 3),
    flag        = if (!is.na(FMI) && FMI > 0.5) "⚠️ HIGH" else "✓"
  ))
}

if (nrow(fmi_df) > 0) {
  high_fmi <- fmi_df[!is.na(fmi_df$flag) & fmi_df$flag == "⚠️ HIGH", ]
  cat(sprintf("  Variables assessed: %d\n", nrow(fmi_df)))
  cat(sprintf("  Median FMI: %.3f\n", median(fmi_df$FMI, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("  Max FMI:    %.3f\n", max(fmi_df$FMI, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("  High FMI (> 0.5): %d variables\n\n", nrow(high_fmi)))

  cat("  TOP 15 VARIABLES BY FMI:\n")
  print(fmi_df %>% arrange(desc(FMI)) %>% head(15) %>%
          select(variable, pct_missing, FMI, flag),
        row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")

  write.csv(fmi_df %>% arrange(desc(FMI)),
            "imputation_fmi_per_variable.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("  ✓ Saved: imputation_fmi_per_variable.csv\n\n")
}

# ── D6. Categorical distribution preservation ─────────────────────────────────
cat("D6. Categorical distribution preservation\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  PURPOSE: For ordered variables (polr) and the nominal polr\n")
cat("           variable (stop_wdl_exp_combined), check that imputed\n")
cat("           category proportions are plausible relative to observed.\n")
cat("  Variables assessed: education, income, employment, driving_freq,\n")
cat("    gen_health, fall2, alc_use, sleep_aids items,\n")
cat("    stop_wdl_exp_combined\n")
cat("  ACTION: If max_prop_diff > 0.20 for any variable, consider\n")
cat("    switching that variable from polr to PMM (see Van Buuren\n")
cat("    2018 §6.3 — PMM preferred when ordinal regression produces\n")
cat("    implausible distributions with sparse missingness).\n")
cat("  NOTE: This is the empirical check on the stop_wdl_exp_combined\n")
cat("    polr-vs-polyreg question — read its row before finalizing.\n\n")

# All polr variables (ordered + polr_unordered)
ordered_imp_vars <- names(imp_params$method[
  imp_params$method == "polr" &
    names(imp_params$method) %in% c(
      imp_params$variable_types$ordered,
      imp_params$variable_types$polr_unordered
    )
])
ordered_imp_vars <- ordered_imp_vars[
  ordered_imp_vars %in% names(df_imp) &
    sapply(df_imp[ordered_imp_vars], function(x) sum(is.na(x))) > 0
]

cat_check_df <- data.frame()

for (var in ordered_imp_vars) {
  orig_na  <- is.na(df_imp[[var]])
  obs_vals <- df_imp[[var]][!orig_na]
  if (length(obs_vals) == 0) next

  imp_vals <- unlist(lapply(all_imp_list, function(d) d[[var]][orig_na]))

  obs_props <- prop.table(table(obs_vals))
  imp_props <- prop.table(table(imp_vals))
  all_levs  <- union(names(obs_props), names(imp_props))

  max_diff <- max(abs(
    sapply(all_levs, function(lv)
      (if (lv %in% names(imp_props)) imp_props[lv] else 0) -
        (if (lv %in% names(obs_props)) obs_props[lv] else 0))
  ))

  cat_check_df <- rbind(cat_check_df, data.frame(
    variable      = var,
    n_missing     = sum(orig_na),
    n_levels      = length(all_levs),
    max_prop_diff = round(max_diff, 3),
    flag          = if (max_diff > 0.2) "⚠️ REVIEW" else "✓"
  ))
}

if (nrow(cat_check_df) > 0) {
  flagged_cat <- cat_check_df[cat_check_df$flag == "⚠️ REVIEW", ]
  cat(sprintf("  Polr variables assessed: %d\n", nrow(cat_check_df)))
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ Proportions stable (max diff ≤ 0.20): %d\n",
              nrow(cat_check_df) - nrow(flagged_cat)))
  cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  Large proportion shift (> 0.20):      %d\n\n",
              nrow(flagged_cat)))
  if (nrow(flagged_cat) > 0) {
    cat("  FLAGGED VARIABLES (consider switching to PMM):\n")
    print(flagged_cat, row.names = FALSE)
    cat("\n")
  }
  write.csv(cat_check_df, "imputation_categorical_check.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("  ✓ Saved: imputation_categorical_check.csv\n\n")
} else {
  cat("  No polr variables with missingness to check\n\n")
}

# ── D7. Intra-scale correlation preservation ──────────────────────────────────
cat("D7. Intra-scale correlation preservation\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  PURPOSE: Items within the same scale should remain highly\n")
cat("           correlated after imputation. A large r drop (> 0.1)\n")
cat("           suggests the imputation broke the latent structure.\n")
cat("  SCALES: CISS, SURPS (with reversed items), DBAS, BFI\n\n")

if (!is.null(analysis_vars)) {
  scale_pairs <- list()
  if (!is.null(analysis_vars$ciss)  && length(analysis_vars$ciss)  > 0)
    scale_pairs[["CISS"]]  <- analysis_vars$ciss
  if (!is.null(analysis_vars$surps) && length(analysis_vars$surps) > 0)
    scale_pairs[["SURPS"]] <- analysis_vars$surps
  if (!is.null(analysis_vars$dbas)  && length(analysis_vars$dbas)  > 0)
    scale_pairs[["DBAS"]]  <- analysis_vars$dbas
  if (!is.null(analysis_vars$bfi)   && length(analysis_vars$bfi)   > 0)
    scale_pairs[["BFI"]]   <- analysis_vars$bfi
  cat("  Scale items sourced from analysis_variable_lists.rds\n\n")
} else {
  cat("  ⚠️  Falling back to hardcoded item names — verify these match\n")
  cat("      current variable names in df_imp before trusting D7 output.\n\n")
  scale_pairs <- list(
    CISS  = paste0("ciss", 1:21),
    SURPS = c("surps1_r","surps2","surps3","surps4_r","surps5","surps6",
              "surps7_r","surps8","surps9","surps10","surps11","surps12",
              "surps13_r","surps14","surps15","surps16","surps17","surps18",
              "surps19","surps20_r","surps21","surps22","surps23_r"),
    DBAS  = c("dbas1", paste0("dbas_", 2:16)),
    BFI   = c("reserved_r","trusting","lazy_r","relaxed_r","few_interests_r",
              "outgoing","find_fault_r","thorough","nervous","imagination")
  )
}

cor_check_df <- data.frame()

for (scale_name in names(scale_pairs)) {
  items <- scale_pairs[[scale_name]]
  items <- items[items %in% names(df_imp)]
  if (length(items) < 3) {
    cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  %s: fewer than 3 items found in df_imp — skipping\n",
                scale_name))
    next
  }

  obs_cc <- df_imp[complete.cases(df_imp[, items]), items]
  if (nrow(obs_cc) < 30) next
  obs_cor_mat <- cor(obs_cc, use = "complete.obs")
  obs_cor     <- mean(abs(obs_cor_mat[upper.tri(obs_cor_mat)]))

  imp_cors <- sapply(all_imp_list, function(d) {
    c_mat <- cor(d[, items], use = "complete.obs")
    mean(abs(c_mat[upper.tri(c_mat)]))
  })
  imp_cor  <- mean(imp_cors)
  cor_drop <- obs_cor - imp_cor

  cor_check_df <- rbind(cor_check_df, data.frame(
    scale      = scale_name,
    n_items    = length(items),
    obs_mean_r = round(obs_cor,  3),
    imp_mean_r = round(imp_cor,  3),
    r_drop     = round(cor_drop, 3),
    flag       = if (cor_drop > 0.1) "⚠️ DROP" else "✓"
  ))
}

if (nrow(cor_check_df) > 0) {
  cat("  Scale-level correlation summary:\n")
  print(cor_check_df, row.names = FALSE)
  flagged_cor <- cor_check_df[cor_check_df$flag == "⚠️ DROP", ]
  if (nrow(flagged_cor) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("\n  ⚠️  %d scale(s) show r drop > 0.1 — review minpuc setting\n",
                nrow(flagged_cor)))
  } else {
    cat("\n  ✓ Within-scale correlations preserved across all scales\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
  write.csv(cor_check_df, "imputation_scale_correlation_check.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("  ✓ Saved: imputation_scale_correlation_check.csv\n\n")
} else {
  cat("  ⚠️  No scales had sufficient items/observations to assess\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART E: RECALCULATE DERIVED VARIABLES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART E: RECALCULATING DERIVED VARIABLES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Recalculating for all", M_IMP, "imputed datasets...\n\n")

# ── E1. n_health_conditions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("E1. n_health_conditions\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  Formula: n_physical_conditions + n_ment_conditions + n_sleep_conditions\n")
cat("  Removed from imputation in Chunk 7 Part B4 to avoid circularity;\n")
cat("  each component imputed separately and summed here.\n\n")

for (i in seq_along(all_imp_list)) {
  d <- all_imp_list[[i]]
  if (all(c("n_physical_conditions","n_ment_conditions","n_sleep_conditions")
          %in% names(d))) {
    all_imp_list[[i]]$n_health_conditions <-
      d$n_physical_conditions + d$n_ment_conditions + d$n_sleep_conditions
  }
}

d1        <- all_imp_list[[1]]
n_correct <- sum(
  d1$n_health_conditions ==
    (d1$n_physical_conditions + d1$n_ment_conditions + d1$n_sleep_conditions),
  na.rm = TRUE)

if (n_correct == nrow(d1)) {
  cat("  ✓ n_health_conditions correct in all", nrow(d1),
      "rows (imputation 1)\n\n")
} else {
  cat("  ⚠️  Mismatch in", nrow(d1) - n_correct, "rows — investigate\n\n")
}

# ── E2. (removed) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# The former E2 recalculated bzra_weekly_dose_eq = bzra_daily_dose_eq * 7.
# Both variables are retired: the weekly dose was dropped in Chunk 5+6, and
# the daily variable is now bzra_daily_diazepam_eq (imputed directly via PMM,
# so it needs no post-imputation recalculation). No action required here.
cat("E2. (none)\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  bzra_daily_diazepam_eq is imputed directly (PMM) and needs no\n")
cat("  derived recalculation. The former weekly dose variable was dropped\n")
cat("  in Chunk 5+6 and is not reconstructed.\n\n")

# ── E-verify. bzra dose completeness ──────────────────────────────────────────
if ("bzra_daily_diazepam_eq" %in% names(all_imp_list[[1]])) {
  n_na_daily <- sum(is.na(all_imp_list[[1]]$bzra_daily_diazepam_eq))
  if (n_na_daily == 0) {
    cat("  ✓ bzra_daily_diazepam_eq: no NAs remaining (correctly imputed)\n\n")
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  %d NAs remaining in bzra_daily_diazepam_eq\n\n",
                n_na_daily))
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART F: VERIFY OUTCOME VARIABLE
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART F: VERIFYING OUTCOME VARIABLE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("  In Chunk 7 the outcome (freq_dich) was RETAINED in df_imp as a\n")
cat("  passive predictor (method = ''), so it is already present and\n")
cat("  complete in every imputed dataset. This part verifies that rather\n")
cat("  than re-attaching it. (If a future Chunk 7 variant excludes the\n")
cat("  outcome instead, re-attach it from SIMOA_analysis.rds here.)\n\n")

outcome_var <- imp_params$outcome
if (is.null(outcome_var)) outcome_var <- "freq_dich"

if (outcome_var %in% names(all_imp_list[[1]])) {
  n_na_outcome <- sum(is.na(all_imp_list[[1]][[outcome_var]]))
  cat(sprintf("✓ Outcome variable present: %s (%d NAs)\n",
              outcome_var, n_na_outcome))
  if (n_na_outcome > 0)
    cat("  ⚠️  Outcome has NAs — unexpected; it should be complete.\n")
  cat("  Distribution (0/1=stoppers, 2=continuers):\n")
  print(table(all_imp_list[[1]][[outcome_var]], useNA = "ifany"))
  cat("\n")
} else {
  # Fallback: outcome not carried through — re-attach from source.
  cat(sprintf("⚠️  %s not found in imputed data — re-attaching from source\n",
              outcome_var))
  if (file.exists("SIMOA_analysis.rds")) {
    SIMOA_original <- readRDS("SIMOA_analysis.rds")
    if (outcome_var %in% names(SIMOA_original)) {
      outcome_data <- SIMOA_original[[outcome_var]]
      for (i in seq_along(all_imp_list))
        all_imp_list[[i]][[outcome_var]] <- outcome_data
      cat("✓ Outcome re-attached from SIMOA_analysis.rds\n")
      print(table(all_imp_list[[1]][[outcome_var]], useNA = "ifany"))
      cat("\n")
    } else {
      cat("⚠️  Outcome not in SIMOA_analysis.rds either — investigate.\n\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("⚠️  SIMOA_analysis.rds not found — cannot re-attach outcome.\n\n")
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART G: SAVE OUTPUTS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART G: SAVING OUTPUTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("TWO OBJECTS SAVED — USE GUIDANCE:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  mice_imputation_object.rds  — raw mids object from mice()\n")
cat("    • n_health_conditions: not present (removed in Chunk 7 Part B4)\n")
cat("    • Only use for mice::pool() on directly imputed variables\n\n")
cat(sprintf(paste0(
  "  imputed_datasets_final.rds  — list of m=%d complete data frames\n"),
  M_IMP))
cat("    • All derived vars recalculated (Part E)\n")
cat("    • Outcome (freq_dich) present and verified (Part F)\n")
cat("    • PRIMARY object for Chunk 9 onward\n")
cat("    • To use mice::pool() in Chunk 9: convert via mice::as.mids()\n\n")

saveRDS(imp_final,    "mice_imputation_object.rds")
saveRDS(all_imp_list, "imputed_datasets_final.rds")

cat("✓ Saved: mice_imputation_object.rds\n")
cat("✓ Saved: imputed_datasets_final.rds\n")
cat("  (List of", length(all_imp_list),
    "complete datasets — PRIMARY object for Chunk 9)\n\n")

cat("VARIABLES IN EACH IMPUTED DATASET:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat(sprintf("  Total variables: %d\n",   ncol(all_imp_list[[1]])))
cat(sprintf("  Observations:    %d\n",   nrow(all_imp_list[[1]])))
cat(sprintf("  Includes: freq_dich, all imputed vars,\n"))
cat(sprintf("            n_health_conditions (recalculated)\n\n"))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART H: FINAL SUMMARY
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("IMPUTATION COMPLETE — SUMMARY\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("IMPUTATION SPECIFICATIONS:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  Observations:         ", nrow(df_imp), "\n")
cat("  Variables imputed:    ", imp_params$n_vars_to_impute, "\n")
cat("  m (imputations):      ", M_IMP,
    "(Von Hippel, 2020; CV(SE)=5%)\n")
cat("  maxit (iterations):   ", MAXIT_IMP,
    "(Gelman-Rubin PSRF convergence experiment)\n")
cat("  Ridge penalty:        ", RIDGE_IMP,
    "(van Buuren §6.4.2)\n")
cat("  Avg predictors/model: ", AVG_PRED, "(mincor=0.07, minpuc=0.10)\n")
cat("  Time elapsed:         ",
    round(as.numeric(elapsed_time), 2), "minutes\n\n")

cat("IMPUTATION METHODS:\n")
cat(sprintf("  PMM (continuous + Likert/COM-B + personality items): %d\n",
            sum(imp_params$method == "pmm")))
cat(sprintf("  Logreg (binary):                                      %d\n",
            sum(imp_params$method == "logreg")))
cat(sprintf("  Polr (ordered + nominal/unordered):                   %d\n",
            sum(imp_params$method == "polr")))
cat(sprintf("    Ordered:  education, income, employment, driving_freq,\n"))
cat(sprintf("              gen_health, fall2, alc_use, sleep_aids items\n"))
cat(sprintf("    Nominal (unordered storage): stop_wdl_exp_combined\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Polyreg (unordered categorical):                      %d\n",
            sum(imp_params$method == "polyreg")))
cat(sprintf("  Not imputed (derived/complete/outcome):               %d\n\n",
            sum(imp_params$method == "")))

cat("STATISTICAL VERIFICATION SUMMARY:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

if (!is.null(psrf_final)) {
  psrf_clean2 <- psrf_final[!is.na(psrf_final) & is.finite(psrf_final)]
  conv_status <- if (max(psrf_clean2) < 1.1) "✓ PASS" else "⚠️  FAIL"
  cat(sprintf("  B1. Convergence (PSRF):          %s  max=%.4f mean=%.4f\n",
              conv_status, max(psrf_clean2), mean(psrf_clean2)))
}

comp_status <- if (length(completeness_fails) == 0) "✓ PASS" else "⚠️  FAIL"
cat(sprintf("  D1. Completeness:                %s  (%d vars × %d datasets)\n",
            comp_status, length(imp_vars), M_IMP))

range_status <- if (length(range_fails) == 0) "✓ PASS" else "⚠️  REVIEW"
cat(sprintf("  D2. PMM range preservation:      %s  (%d PMM vars)\n",
            range_status, length(pmm_vars)))

if (nrow(quality_df) > 0) {
  smd_status <- if (sum(quality_df$flag == "⚠️ REVIEW") == 0) "✓ PASS" else
    sprintf("⚠️  %d vars flagged", sum(quality_df$flag == "⚠️ REVIEW"))
  cat(sprintf("  D3. Mean/SD (|SMD| ≤ 0.5):       %s\n", smd_status))
}

if (nrow(riv_df) > 0) {
  riv_status <- if (sum(riv_df$flag == "⚠️ HIGH B", na.rm = TRUE) == 0)
    "✓ PASS" else
    sprintf("⚠️  %d vars flagged",
            sum(riv_df$flag == "⚠️ HIGH B", na.rm = TRUE))
  cat(sprintf("  D4. Between-imputation variance: %s\n", riv_status))
}

if (nrow(fmi_df) > 0)
  cat(sprintf("  D5. FMI (median / max):          %.3f / %.3f\n",
              median(fmi_df$FMI, na.rm = TRUE),
              max(fmi_df$FMI, na.rm = TRUE)))

if (nrow(cat_check_df) > 0) {
  cat_status <- if (nrow(flagged_cat) == 0) "✓ PASS" else
    sprintf("⚠️  %d vars flagged (consider polr → PMM)", nrow(flagged_cat))
  cat(sprintf("  D6. Categorical proportions:     %s\n", cat_status))
}

if (nrow(cor_check_df) > 0) {
  cor_status <- if (nrow(cor_check_df[cor_check_df$flag == "⚠️ DROP", ]) == 0)
    "✓ PASS" else "⚠️  REVIEW"
  cat(sprintf("  D7. Intra-scale correlations:    %s  (CISS, SURPS, DBAS, BFI)\n",
              cor_status))
}

cat("\n")
cat("LOGGED EVENTS:\n")
if (n_logged == 0) {
  cat("  ✓ None — imputation completed cleanly\n\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  %d events — review imputation_logged_events.csv\n\n",
              n_logged))
}

cat("KEY CITATIONS:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat(sprintf("  Von Hippel (2020) Sociol Methods Res 49(3):699-718  [m=%d]\n",
            M_IMP))
cat("  White et al. (2011) Stat Med 30(4):377-399          [m floor]\n")
cat("  Gelman & Rubin (1992) Stat Sci 7(4):457-472         [maxit]\n")
cat("  Brooks & Gelman (1998) J Comp Graph Stat 7(4):434   [maxit]\n")
cat("  Van Buuren (2018) Flexible Imputation (2nd ed.)      [both]\n\n")

cat("OUTPUT OBJECTS:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  PRIMARY:   imputed_datasets_final.rds\n")
cat(sprintf("             → m=%d complete datasets; all derived vars correct\n",
            M_IMP))
cat("             → freq_dich included; use for all Chunk 9 analyses\n")
cat("  SECONDARY: mice_imputation_object.rds\n")
cat("             → Raw mids object; use for directly imputed variables\n\n")

cat("FILES CREATED:\n")
cat("  1.  mice_imputation_object.rds\n")
cat("  2.  imputed_datasets_final.rds\n")
cat("  3.  convergence_trace_plots_final.pdf\n")
cat("  4.  imputation_density_plots.pdf\n")
cat("  5.  imputation_stripplots.pdf\n")
cat("  6.  final_imputation_psrf.csv\n")
cat("  7.  imputation_quality_assessment.csv\n")
cat("  8.  imputation_variance_decomposition.csv\n")
cat("  9.  imputation_fmi_per_variable.csv\n")
cat("  10. imputation_categorical_check.csv\n")
cat("  11. imputation_scale_correlation_check.csv\n")
if (n_logged > 0)
  cat("  12. imputation_logged_events.csv\n")

cat("\n")
cat("NEXT STEPS:\n")
cat("  1. Review convergence_trace_plots_final.pdf\n")
cat("     → Confirm chains intermingle freely (no trends or drift)\n")
cat("  2. Review imputation_density_plots.pdf\n")
cat("     → Red (observed) and blue (imputed) should broadly overlap\n")
cat("  3. Check imputation_quality_assessment.csv\n")
cat("     → Flag any |SMD| > 0.5 for manuscript reporting\n")
cat("  4. Check imputation_categorical_check.csv\n")
cat("     → max_prop_diff > 0.20 for any polr variable → switch to PMM\n")
cat("     → In particular, read the stop_wdl_exp_combined row: this is\n")
cat("       the empirical test of the polr (ordinal) imputation choice\n")
cat("  5. Check imputation_scale_correlation_check.csv\n")
cat("     → Confirm r drop < 0.1 for CISS, SURPS, DBAS, BFI\n")
cat("  6. If all checks pass → Proceed to Chunk 9\n")
cat("     (composites + logistic regression)\n\n")

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("✓ MULTIPLE IMPUTATION COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
```



## Post-Imputation

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 9: POST-IMPUTATION PROCESSING
#==============================================================================
# Purpose:
#   1. Create validated personality subscales using already-reversed items
#   2. Create composite variables (deferred from Chunk 5+6)
#   3. Create binary outcome variable (stopped_bzra) from freq_dich
#   4. Calculate reliability metrics
#   All operations performed on EACH imputed dataset separately
#
# NOTE ON DATA SOURCE:
#   Loads imputed_datasets_final.rds (list of m complete data frames from
#   Chunk 8; m is read at run time as length(all_imputed), currently 37).
#   n_health_conditions was recalculated in Chunk 8 Part E as:
#     n_physical_conditions + n_ment_conditions + n_sleep_conditions
#   bzra_daily_diazepam_eq (mg/day, true diazepam-mg equivalent) was imputed
#     directly (PMM) in Chunk 8 — it needs no re-derivation here. The old
#     weekly dose variable was dropped in Chunk 5+6 and does not exist.
#   freq_dich (outcome) was retained as a passive predictor through
#     imputation (Chunk 7) and verified present in Chunk 8 Part F.
#   None of the above requires re-derivation here.
#
# NOTE ON REVERSED ITEMS:
#   All reversals were performed in Chunk 6 and are present in the imputed
#   data under their _r names:
#     BFI:   reserved_r, lazy_r, relaxed_r, few_interests_r, find_fault_r
#     SURPS: surps1_r, surps4_r, surps7_r, surps13_r, surps20_r, surps23_r
#   Subscale definitions below use these _r names directly.
#
# NOTE ON DBAS NAMING:
#   First item has no underscore: dbas1
#   Remaining items use underscore: dbas_2 through dbas_16
#
# NOTE ON COMPOSITE VARIABLES (deferred from Chunk 5+6):
#   benefitsC     = mean(benefit_1, benefit_4, benefit_5, benefit_6)
#   side_effectsC = mean(side_effects_1:4)
#   adlsC         = mean(adls_1, adls_2)
#   dependenceC   = mean(dependence_1:3)
#   motivationC   = mean(motivation_1:3)
#   capabilityC   = mean(capability_1, 6-capability)   ← discontinuation self-efficacy
#   pharmacistC   = mean(desires_2, 6-inf_hcp_3)
#   prescriberC   = mean(desires_1, 6-inf_hcp_1)
#
# NOTE ON RELIABILITY REPORTING:
#   Two-item scales (all BFI-10 subscales, plus composites adlsC,
#   capabilityC, pharmacistC, prescriberC) report the Spearman-Brown
#   coefficient [ 2r / (1 + r) ] as the headline reliability, alongside the
#   inter-item correlation r. Cronbach's alpha understates reliability for
#   two-item scales (Eisinga et al., 2013), so it is NOT the headline for
#   these; raw alpha is retained in the output table for transparency only.
#   Scales with 3+ items report Cronbach's alpha as headline. Mean inter-item
#   r is reported for every scale. capabilityC is discontinuation
#   self-efficacy — the composite defended on theoretical/reliability grounds
#   (see Stewart correspondence); its Spearman-Brown value is the number to
#   report in the manuscript.
#
# NOTE ON OUTCOME:
#   freq_dich original coding:
#     0 = No longer uses BZRAs
#     1 = Uses BZRAs < 1 time per month
#     2 = Uses BZRAs > 1 time per month (regular use)
#   freq_dich was retained as a passive predictor in Chunk 7 and verified
#   present in Chunk 8 Part F. It must not be modified here.
#
#   Binary outcome created in Part B3:
#     stopped_bzra = 1 → Stoppers/rare users (freq_dich 0 or 1)
#     stopped_bzra = 0 → Continuers          (freq_dich 2)
#   freq_dich is retained for sensitivity analyses.
#
# NOTE ON IMPUTATION METHODS (from Chunk 8):
#   PMM:     All continuous variables (incl. bzra_daily_diazepam_eq) +
#            all Likert/COM-B items + personality scale items
#            (DBAS, BFI, SURPS, CISS)
#   Logreg:  sex
#   Polr:    education, income, employment, driving_freq, gen_health,
#            fall2, alc_use, sleep_aids items,
#            stop_wdl_exp_combined (3-level factor collapsed in Chunk 5+6:
#              "No withdrawal" | "Insomnia only" | "Other withdrawal symptoms";
#              stored UNORDERED so downstream regression uses dummy coding,
#              but IMPUTED with polr under a monotone burden gradient —
#              none < insomnia only < other/multiple symptoms — chosen for
#              numerical stability given the sparse "Other" cell. The polr
#              imputation choice does not impose an ordinal structure on the
#              substantive analyses.)
#   Polyreg: prov_terr
#   Not imputed: n_health_conditions (recalculated in Chunk 8 Part E),
#                freq_dich (outcome — passive predictor, verified Chunk 8 F)
#==============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(psych)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("POST-IMPUTATION PROCESSING\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if (!file.exists("imputed_datasets_final.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: imputed_datasets_final.rds not found. Please run Chunk 8 first.")
}

all_imputed <- readRDS("imputed_datasets_final.rds")
m           <- length(all_imputed)

cat("✓ Loaded imputed_datasets_final.rds\n")
cat("  Imputations:", m, "\n")
cat("  Variables per dataset:", ncol(all_imputed[[1]]), "\n")
cat("  Observations:", nrow(all_imputed[[1]]), "\n\n")

cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

)

  cat("    Distribution:\n")
  cat("      0 = No longer uses:     n =",
      sum(all_imputed[[1]]$freq_dich == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("      1 = < 1 time per month: n =",
      sum(all_imputed[[1]]$freq_dich == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("      2 = > 1 time per month: n =",
      sum(all_imputed[[1]]$freq_dich == 2, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
} else {
  cat("  ⚠️  freq_dich NOT present — check Chunk 8 Part F output\n")
}
cat("\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# VERIFICATION: Polr/polyreg-imputed categorical variables from Chunk 8
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("VERIFICATION: Checking polr/polyreg-imputed variables from Chunk 8\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  Polr:    education, income, employment, driving_freq, gen_health,\n")

} else {

# =============================================================================
# SUBSCALE DEFINITIONS
# =============================================================================
# Each entry: list(items = character vector, reversed = which _r names)
# All items listed here are the FINAL variable names as they exist in
# the imputed data. Reversed items use their _r suffix from Chunk 6, so no
# further reversal is applied when scoring or computing reliability.
# =============================================================================

subscale_defs <- list(

  # ── BFI-10 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 2 items per trait. Reversed items stored as _r (Chunk 6).
  BFI_Extraversion      = list(items    = c("reserved_r", "outgoing"),
                                reversed = "reserved_r"),
  BFI_Agreeableness     = list(items    = c("find_fault_r", "trusting"),
                                reversed = "find_fault_r"),
  BFI_Conscientiousness = list(items    = c("lazy_r", "thorough"),
                                reversed = "lazy_r"),
  BFI_Neuroticism       = list(items    = c("relaxed_r", "nervous"),
                                reversed = "relaxed_r"),
  BFI_Openness          = list(items    = c("few_interests_r", "imagination"),
                                reversed = "few_interests_r"),

  # ── SURPS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Hopelessness items 1,4,7,13,20,23 were reversed in Chunk 6 → _r names.
  # Item 17 was NOT reversed — kept as surps17.
  SURPS_Hopelessness        = list(
    items    = c("surps1_r", "surps4_r", "surps7_r", "surps13_r",
                 "surps17", "surps20_r", "surps23_r"),
    reversed = c("surps1_r", "surps4_r", "surps7_r", "surps13_r",
                 "surps20_r", "surps23_r")),
  SURPS_Impulsivity         = list(
    items    = paste0("surps", c(2, 5, 11, 15, 22)),
    reversed = character(0)),
  SURPS_Sensation_Seeking   = list(
    items    = paste0("surps", c(3, 6, 9, 12, 16, 19)),
    reversed = character(0)),
  SURPS_Anxiety_Sensitivity = list(
    items    = paste0("surps", c(8, 10, 14, 18, 21)),
    reversed = character(0)),

  # ── DBAS-16 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # dbas1 has no underscore; dbas_2 through dbas_16 have underscore.
  # No reverse coding for DBAS.
  #
  # Variable mapping derived from Morin et al. second-order CFA (DBAS-30 item
  # numbers in parentheses):
  #   Consequences (7):       dbas_3(5), dbas_4(8), dbas_5(10), dbas_7(12),
  #                           dbas_9(18), dbas_12(21), dbas_16(30)
  #   Worry/Helplessness (4): dbas_8(17), dbas_10(19), dbas_11(20), dbas_14(25)
  #   Expectations (2):       dbas1(1), dbas_2(2)
  #   Medication (3):         dbas_6(11), dbas_13(24), dbas_15(27)
  #
  # NOTE: DBAS_Total is created here for reliability reporting only.
  #   It is excluded from VSURF (Chunk 11B) and descriptive analysis
  #   (Chunk 10) due to collinearity with subscales.
  DBAS_Consequences       = list(
    items    = c("dbas_3", "dbas_4", "dbas_5", "dbas_7",
                 "dbas_9", "dbas_12", "dbas_16"),
    reversed = character(0)),
  DBAS_Worry_Helplessness = list(
    items    = c("dbas_8", "dbas_10", "dbas_11", "dbas_14"),
    reversed = character(0)),
  DBAS_Expectations       = list(
    items    = c("dbas1", "dbas_2"),
    reversed = character(0)),
  DBAS_Medications        = list(
    items    = c("dbas_6", "dbas_13", "dbas_15"),
    reversed = character(0)),
  DBAS_Total              = list(
    items    = c("dbas1", paste0("dbas_", 2:16)),
    reversed = character(0)),

  # ── CISS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # No reverse coding for CISS.
  CISS_Task      = list(items    = paste0("ciss", c(2, 6, 8, 11, 13, 16, 19)),
                         reversed = character(0)),
  CISS_Emotion   = list(items    = paste0("ciss", c(3, 5, 10, 12, 14, 17, 20)),
                         reversed = character(0)),
  CISS_Avoidance = list(items    = paste0("ciss", c(1, 4, 7, 9, 15, 18, 21)),
                         reversed = character(0))
)

# =============================================================================
# COMPOSITE DEFINITIONS (for reliability assessment)
# =============================================================================
# Mirrors the composites built in Part B2. `reverse` lists the RAW item(s)
# that must be flipped (scale_max + 1 - x) before computing reliability, so
# the inter-item correlation is positive and Spearman-Brown is meaningful.
# All items are 5-point Likert (scale_max = 5 → reversal is 6 - x), matching
# the inline "6 - x" reversal used when the composites are scored.
# =============================================================================

composite_defs <- list(
  benefitsC     = list(items = c("benefit_1","benefit_4","benefit_5","benefit_6"),
                       reverse = character(0), scale_max = 5),
  side_effectsC = list(items = paste0("side_effects_", 1:4),
                       reverse = character(0), scale_max = 5),
  adlsC         = list(items = c("adls_1","adls_2"),
                       reverse = character(0), scale_max = 5),
  dependenceC   = list(items = paste0("dependence_", 1:3),
                       reverse = character(0), scale_max = 5),
  motivationC   = list(items = paste0("motivation_", 1:3),
                       reverse = character(0), scale_max = 5),
  capabilityC   = list(items = c("capability_1","capability"),
                       reverse = "capability", scale_max = 5),   # disc self-efficacy
  pharmacistC   = list(items = c("desires_2","inf_hcp_3"),
                       reverse = "inf_hcp_3",  scale_max = 5),
  prescriberC   = list(items = c("desires_1","inf_hcp_1"),
                       reverse = "inf_hcp_1",  scale_max = 5)
)

# =============================================================================
# HELPER: Reliability assessment
# =============================================================================
# Headline coefficient:
#   n_items == 2 → Spearman-Brown = 2r / (1 + r)  (r = single inter-item cor)
#   n_items >= 3 → Cronbach's alpha
# Raw Cronbach's alpha is computed and retained for ALL scales for
# transparency, but is not the headline for 2-item scales.
# `reverse` names RAW items to flip inline (scale_max + 1 - x) before scoring
# — used for composites whose keying is applied at scoring time, not stored.
# =============================================================================

assess_reliability <- function(data, items, name,
                               reverse = character(0), scale_max = NULL) {

  na_result <- function(status, missing = character(0)) {
    list(name = name, n_items = length(items), coef_type = NA_character_,
         reliability = NA_real_, rel_ci_lower = NA_real_, rel_ci_upper = NA_real_,
         raw_alpha = NA_real_, mean_r = NA_real_, spearman_brown = NA_real_,
         mean = NA_real_, sd = NA_real_, status = status, missing = missing)
  }

  missing_items <- items[!items %in% names(data)]
  if (length(missing_items) > 0) return(na_result("MISSING ITEMS", missing_items))

  if (length(reverse) > 0 && is.null(scale_max))
    stop(sprintf("assess_reliability(%s): reverse items given but scale_max is NULL",
                 name))

  item_data <- data[, items, drop = FALSE]
  item_data <- item_data[complete.cases(item_data), ]
  if (nrow(item_data) < 10) return(na_result("INSUFFICIENT DATA"))

  item_matrix <- as.data.frame(lapply(item_data, as.numeric))

  # Inline reversal so items are correctly keyed to the construct
  for (rv in reverse)
    if (rv %in% names(item_matrix))
      item_matrix[[rv]] <- (scale_max + 1) - item_matrix[[rv]]

  if (any(sapply(item_matrix, sd, na.rm = TRUE) == 0))
    return(na_result("ZERO VARIANCE"))

  cor_mat <- cor(item_matrix, use = "complete.obs")
  mean_r  <- mean(cor_mat[lower.tri(cor_mat)], na.rm = TRUE)
  scores  <- rowMeans(item_matrix)
  n_it    <- length(items)

  # Cronbach's alpha — computed for all scales (reference), headline for 3+ items
  alpha_result <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(psych::alpha(item_matrix, check.keys = FALSE)),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  raw_alpha      <- if (!is.null(alpha_result)) alpha_result$total$raw_alpha else NA_real_
  alpha_ci_lower <- if (!is.null(alpha_result)) alpha_result$feldt$lower.ci  else NA_real_
  alpha_ci_upper <- if (!is.null(alpha_result)) alpha_result$feldt$upper.ci  else NA_real_

  if (n_it == 2) {
    # Spearman-Brown is the appropriate reliability coefficient for 2 items.
    sb             <- (2 * mean_r) / (1 + mean_r)
    coef_type      <- "Spearman-Brown"
    reliability    <- sb
    rel_ci_lower   <- NA_real_   # no simple analytic CI; report inter-item r
    rel_ci_upper   <- NA_real_
    spearman_brown <- sb
  } else {
    coef_type      <- "Cronbach alpha"
    reliability    <- raw_alpha
    rel_ci_lower   <- alpha_ci_lower
    rel_ci_upper   <- alpha_ci_upper
    spearman_brown <- NA_real_
  }

  status <- dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(reliability)  ~ "UNCOMPUTED",
    reliability >= 0.70 ~ "GOOD",
    reliability >= 0.60 ~ "ACCEPTABLE",
    TRUE                ~ "POOR")

  list(
    name           = name,
    n_items        = n_it,
    coef_type      = coef_type,
    reliability    = reliability,
    rel_ci_lower   = rel_ci_lower,
    rel_ci_upper   = rel_ci_upper,
    raw_alpha      = raw_alpha,
    mean_r         = mean_r,
    spearman_brown = spearman_brown,
    mean           = mean(scores, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd             = sd(scores,   na.rm = TRUE),
    status         = status,
    missing        = character(0)
  )
}

# =============================================================================
# PART A: VALIDATE ITEM NAMES BEFORE CREATING SUBSCALES
# =============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART A: VALIDATING ITEM NAMES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

all_item_names <- unique(unlist(lapply(subscale_defs, `[[`, "items")))
missing_items  <- all_item_names[!all_item_names %in% names(all_imputed[[1]])]
present_items  <- all_item_names[ all_item_names %in% names(all_imputed[[1]])]

cat(sprintf("  Total unique items across all subscales: %d\n",
            length(all_item_names)))
cat(sprintf("  ✓ Present in data: %d\n", length(present_items)))

if (length(missing_items) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("  ✗ MISSING from data: %d\n", length(missing_items)))
  for (v in missing_items) cat("    •", v, "\n")
  cat("\n  ⚠️  Missing items will cause those subscales to be skipped.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("  ✓ All items present — subscale creation can proceed\n\n")
}

# =============================================================================
# PART B: CREATE SUBSCALES ACROSS ALL IMPUTED DATASETS
# =============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART B: CREATING SUBSCALES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Scoring method: MEAN of items (interpretable on original scale)\n")
cat("Applied to all", m, "imputed datasets\n\n")

subscales_created <- character(0)
subscales_skipped <- character(0)

all_imputed <- lapply(all_imputed, function(d) {
  for (scale_name in names(subscale_defs)) {
    items <- subscale_defs[[scale_name]]$items
    if (all(items %in% names(d))) {
      item_mat        <- as.data.frame(
        lapply(d[, items, drop = FALSE], as.numeric))
      d[[scale_name]] <- rowMeans(item_mat, na.rm = FALSE)
    }
  }
  d
})

# Determine which subscales were actually created
for (scale_name in names(subscale_defs)) {
  if (scale_name %in% names(all_imputed[[1]])) {
    subscales_created <- c(subscales_created, scale_name)
  } else {
    subscales_skipped <- c(subscales_skipped, scale_name)
  }
}

# Report by scale family
families <- list(
  "BFI-10"  = grep("^BFI_",   subscales_created, value = TRUE),
  "SURPS"   = grep("^SURPS_", subscales_created, value = TRUE),
  "DBAS-16" = grep("^DBAS_",  subscales_created, value = TRUE),
  "CISS"    = grep("^CISS_",  subscales_created, value = TRUE)
)

for (fam in names(families)) {
  cat(sprintf("%s (%d subscales):\n", fam, length(families[[fam]])))
  for (s in families[[fam]]) {
    n_rev    <- length(subscale_defs[[s]]$reversed)
    rev_note <- if (n_rev > 0)
      sprintf(" [%d item(s) reversed in Chunk 6]", n_rev) else ""
    cat(sprintf("  ✓ %-30s  items: %s%s\n",
                s,
                paste(subscale_defs[[s]]$items, collapse = ", "),
                rev_note))
  }
  cat("\n")
}

if (length(subscales_skipped) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("⚠️  SKIPPED (%d) — missing items:\n", length(subscales_skipped)))
  for (s in subscales_skipped) cat("  •", s, "\n")
  cat("\n")
}

cat(sprintf("Total subscales created: %d\n\n", length(subscales_created)))
cat("NOTE: DBAS_Total created here for reliability reporting only.\n")
cat("  It is excluded from Chunk 10 descriptives and Chunk 11B VSURF\n")
cat("  due to collinearity with DBAS subscales.\n\n")

# =============================================================================
# PART B2: COMPOSITE VARIABLES (deferred from Chunk 5+6)
# =============================================================================
# Inline reversals (scale_max + 1 - x):
#   capabilityC:  capability is reversed inline (6 - capability)
#   pharmacistC:  inf_hcp_3 is reversed inline (6 - inf_hcp_3)
#   prescriberC:  inf_hcp_1 is reversed inline (6 - inf_hcp_1)
# All other composites are simple means with no reversal.
# =============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART B2: CREATING COMPOSITE VARIABLES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Method: mean of items, with inline reversal where needed\n")
cat("  capabilityC:  capability reversed (6 - capability)  [disc self-efficacy]\n")
cat("  pharmacistC:  inf_hcp_3 reversed (6 - inf_hcp_3)\n")
cat("  prescriberC:  inf_hcp_1 reversed (6 - inf_hcp_1)\n\n")

composites_created <- character(0)

all_imputed <- lapply(all_imputed, function(d) {

  # benefitsC — mean of 4 benefit items (no reversal)
  if (all(c("benefit_1","benefit_4","benefit_5","benefit_6") %in% names(d))) {
    d$benefitsC <- rowMeans(
      d[, c("benefit_1","benefit_4","benefit_5","benefit_6")],
      na.rm = FALSE)
  }

  # side_effectsC — mean of 4 side effect items (no reversal)
  se_items <- paste0("side_effects_", 1:4)
  if (all(se_items %in% names(d))) {
    d$side_effectsC <- rowMeans(d[, se_items], na.rm = FALSE)
  }

  # adlsC — mean of 2 ADL items (no reversal)
  if (all(c("adls_1","adls_2") %in% names(d))) {
    d$adlsC <- rowMeans(d[, c("adls_1","adls_2")], na.rm = FALSE)
  }

  # dependenceC — mean of 3 dependence items (no reversal)
  dep_items <- paste0("dependence_", 1:3)
  if (all(dep_items %in% names(d))) {
    d$dependenceC <- rowMeans(d[, dep_items], na.rm = FALSE)
  }

  # motivationC — mean of 3 motivation items (no reversal)
  mot_items <- paste0("motivation_", 1:3)
  if (all(mot_items %in% names(d))) {
    d$motivationC <- rowMeans(d[, mot_items], na.rm = FALSE)
  }

  # capabilityC — capability reversed inline, then mean with capability_1
  if (all(c("capability_1","capability") %in% names(d))) {
    d$capabilityC <- rowMeans(
      data.frame(
        cap1  = as.numeric(d$capability_1),
        cap_r = 6 - as.numeric(d$capability)
      ),
      na.rm = FALSE)
  }

  # pharmacistC — inf_hcp_3 reversed inline, then mean with desires_2
  if (all(c("desires_2","inf_hcp_3") %in% names(d))) {
    d$pharmacistC <- rowMeans(
      data.frame(
        des2   = as.numeric(d$desires_2),
        hcp3_r = 6 - as.numeric(d$inf_hcp_3)
      ),
      na.rm = FALSE)
  }

  # prescriberC — inf_hcp_1 reversed inline, then mean with desires_1
  if (all(c("desires_1","inf_hcp_1") %in% names(d))) {
    d$prescriberC <- rowMeans(
      data.frame(
        des1   = as.numeric(d$desires_1),
        hcp1_r = 6 - as.numeric(d$inf_hcp_1)
      ),
      na.rm = FALSE)
  }

  d
})

# =============================================================================
# PART B3: CREATE BINARY OUTCOME VARIABLE
# =============================================================================
# freq_dich original coding:
#   0 = No longer uses BZRAs
#   1 = Uses BZRAs < 1 time per month
#   2 = Uses BZRAs > 1 time per month (regular use)
#
# Binary recoding:
#   stopped_bzra = 1 → Stoppers/rare users (freq_dich 0 or 1)
#   stopped_bzra = 0 → Continuers          (freq_dich 2)
#
# Rationale: Both freq_dich 0 and 1 represent meaningful reduction from
# regular use — either complete cessation or clinically insignificant
# residual use (< 1x/month). freq_dich 2 represents ongoing regular use.
# This binary variable is the primary outcome for logistic regression
# in Chunk 10. freq_dich is retained for sensitivity analyses.
# =============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART B3: CREATING BINARY OUTCOME VARIABLE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("ORIGINAL CODING (freq_dich):\n")
cat("  0 = No longer uses BZRAs\n")
cat("  1 = Uses BZRAs < 1 time per month\n")
cat("  2 = Uses BZRAs > 1 time per month (regular use)\n\n")
cat("BINARY RECODING (stopped_bzra):\n")
cat("  freq_dich 0 (no longer uses)     → stopped_bzra = 1 (Stopper)\n")
cat("  freq_dich 1 (< 1x/month)         → stopped_bzra = 1 (Rare user)\n")
cat("  freq_dich 2 (> 1x/month regular) → stopped_bzra = 0 (Continuer)\n\n")
cat("RATIONALE:\n")
cat("  freq_dich 0 and 1 both represent meaningful reduction from regular\n")
cat("  BZRA use — either complete cessation or clinically insignificant\n")
cat("  residual use (< 1x/month). freq_dich 2 represents ongoing regular\n")
cat("  use and constitutes the comparison group (continuers).\n\n")

all_imputed <- lapply(all_imputed, function(d) {
  d$stopped_bzra <- dplyr::case_when(
    d$freq_dich %in% c(0, 1) ~ 1L,
    d$freq_dich == 2          ~ 0L,
    TRUE                      ~ NA_integer_
  )
  d
})

cat("Using first imputed dataset (reliability is stable across imputations\n")
cat("given low FMI; van Buuren, 2018 §6.6).\n\n")
cat("HEADLINE COEFFICIENT:\n")
cat("  • 2-item scales → Spearman-Brown  [ 2r / (1 + r) ], with inter-item r.\n")
cat("    Cronbach's alpha understates reliability for 2-item scales\n")
cat("    (Eisinga et al., 2013); raw alpha is shown for reference only.\n")
cat("  • 3+ item scales → Cronbach's alpha (with Feldt 95% CI).\n")
cat("  • Mean inter-item r is reported for every scale.\n")
cat("  Applies to BFI-10 subscales (all 2-item) and composites adlsC,\n")
cat("  capabilityC, pharmacistC, prescriberC (all 2-item). capabilityC is\n")
cat("  discontinuation self-efficacy — its Spearman-Brown value is the\n")
cat("  reliability figure to report in the manuscript.\n")

cat("  subscales are the unit of analysis in Chunks 10 and 11B.\n\n")

data_imp1 <- all_imputed[[1]]

# Print helper for a reliability result
print_rel <- function(result) {
  if (!is.na(result$reliability)) {
    status_sym <- switch(result$status,
                         "GOOD"       = "✓",
                         "ACCEPTABLE" = "~",
                         "POOR"       = "⚠️",
                         "?")
    ci_txt <- if (!is.na(result$rel_ci_lower))
      sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", result$rel_ci_lower, result$rel_ci_upper) else
      "[CI n/a]"
    alpha_note <- if (result$coef_type == "Spearman-Brown" && !is.na(result$raw_alpha))
      sprintf("  (raw α = %.3f)", result$raw_alpha) else ""
    cat(sprintf(
      "  %s %-27s %-15s = %.3f %s  mean-r = %.3f  M = %.2f (SD = %.2f)  [%s]%s\n",
      status_sym, result$name, result$coef_type, result$reliability, ci_txt,
      result$mean_r, result$mean, result$sd, result$status, alpha_note))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  ✗ %-27s STATUS: %s\n", result$name, result$status))
    if (length(result$missing) > 0)
      cat("    Missing:", paste(result$missing, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
}

# ── C1. Personality subscales ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
reliability_list <- list()

for (fam in names(families)) {
  cat(sprintf("%s:\n", fam))
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  for (scale_name in families[[fam]]) {
    items  <- subscale_defs[[scale_name]]$items
    result <- assess_reliability(data_imp1, items, scale_name)
    reliability_list[[scale_name]] <- result
    print_rel(result)
  }
  cat("\n")
}

# ── C2. Composite variables (incl. discontinuation self-efficacy) ─────────────

composite_reliability_list <- list()
for (comp in composite_names) {
  cd     <- composite_defs[[comp]]
  result <- assess_reliability(data_imp1, cd$items, comp,
                               reverse = cd$reverse, scale_max = cd$scale_max)
  composite_reliability_list[[comp]] <- result
  print_rel(result)
}
cat("\n")

# ── Combined reliability table ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# scalar(): coerce any field to a guaranteed length-1 value. Reliability
# results contain a `missing` field that is character(0) on success, and
# assorted fields could in principle be NULL/zero-length on an edge-case
# result; forcing every column to length 1 guarantees rbind-compatible rows.
scalar <- function(x, fallback = NA) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return(fallback)
  x[[1]]
}

result_to_row <- function(r, type, n_reversed) {
  data.frame(
    scale          = scalar(r$name,      NA_character_),
    type           = type,
    n_items        = scalar(r$n_items,   NA_integer_),
    n_reversed     = n_reversed,
    coef_type      = scalar(r$coef_type, NA_character_),
    reliability    = round(scalar(r$reliability),  3),
    rel_ci_lower   = round(scalar(r$rel_ci_lower), 3),
    rel_ci_upper   = round(scalar(r$rel_ci_upper), 3),
    raw_alpha      = round(scalar(r$raw_alpha),    3),
    mean_inter_r   = round(scalar(r$mean_r),       3),
    mean           = round(scalar(r$mean),         2),
    sd             = round(scalar(r$sd),           2),
    status         = scalar(r$status,    NA_character_),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# NOTE: loop variable is `nm`, not `c` — `c` would shadow base::c().
rel_rows <- c(
  lapply(names(reliability_list), function(nm)
    result_to_row(reliability_list[[nm]], "subscale",
                  length(subscale_defs[[nm]]$reversed))),
  lapply(names(composite_reliability_list), function(nm)
    result_to_row(composite_reliability_list[[nm]], "composite",
                  length(composite_defs[[nm]]$reverse)))
)
# bind_rows fills any mismatched columns with NA instead of erroring, and
# binds by name rather than position — robust to any future field changes.
rel_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(rel_rows)

write.csv(rel_table, "subscale_reliability_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: subscale_reliability_summary.csv\n")
cat("  (headline 'reliability' column = Spearman-Brown for 2-item scales,\n")
cat("   Cronbach alpha for 3+; raw_alpha retained for all as reference)\n\n")
```
