```{r}
cat("  Checking: education, income, employment, driving_freq, gen_health,\n")
cat("            fall2, alc_use, stop_wdl_exp_combined, prov_terr\n\n")

polr_check_vars <- c(
  "education", "income", "employment", "driving_freq", "gen_health",
  "fall2", "alc_use", "stop_wdl_exp_combined", "prov_terr"
)

polr_check_fail <- FALSE
for (v in polr_check_vars) {
  if (v %in% names(all_imputed[[1]])) {
    n_na <- sum(is.na(all_imputed[[1]][[v]]))
    if (n_na > 0) {
      cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  %-30s: %d unexpected NAs — check Chunk 8\n", v, n_na))
      polr_check_fail <- TRUE
      validation_passed <- FALSE
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("  ✓ %-30s complete\n", v))
    }
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  %-30s NOT present — check Chunk 8 output\n", v))
    polr_check_fail <- TRUE
    validation_passed <- FALSE
  }
}

# sleep_aids variables — checked dynamically
if (length(sleep_aid_vars) > 0) {
  for (v in sleep_aid_vars) {
    n_na <- sum(is.na(all_imputed[[1]][[v]]))
    if (n_na > 0) {
      cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  %-30s: %d unexpected NAs\n", v, n_na))
      validation_passed <- FALSE
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("  ✓ %-30s complete\n", v))
    }
  }
}

if (!polr_check_fail && length(sleep_aid_vars) >= 0)
  cat("\n  ✓ All polr/polyreg-imputed variables complete\n")
cat("\n")

# =============================================================================
# PART E: SAVE OUTPUTS
# =============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART E: SAVING OUTPUTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

saveRDS(all_imputed, "imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds\n")
cat("  (List of", m,
    "complete datasets with subscales, composites,\n")
cat("   stopped_bzra, freq_dich, and all imputed variables)\n\n")

saveRDS(list(
  subscale_defs              = subscale_defs,
  composite_defs             = composite_defs,
  subscales_created          = subscales_created,
  subscales_skipped          = subscales_skipped,
  composites_created         = composites_created,
  reliability_list           = reliability_list,
  composite_reliability_list = composite_reliability_list,
  reliability_table          = rel_table
), "subscale_metadata.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: subscale_metadata.rds\n\n")

write.csv(all_imputed[[1]], "imputed_example_with_subscales.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: imputed_example_with_subscales.csv (imputation 1)\n\n")


# =============================================================================
# FINAL SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
if (validation_passed) {
  cat("✅ ALL VALIDATION CHECKS PASSED\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️  ONE OR MORE VALIDATION CHECKS FAILED — review above\n")
}
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("PROCESSING COMPLETE:\n")
cat(sprintf("  ✓ %d subscales created across all %d imputations\n",
            length(subscales_created), m))
cat(sprintf("  ✓ %d composite variables created across all %d imputations\n",
            length(composites_created), m))
cat("  ✓ All subscales use reversed items (_r) from Chunk 6\n")
cat("  ✓ Composites: inline reversal for capabilityC, pharmacistC, prescriberC\n")
cat("  ✓ Reliability: Spearman-Brown for 2-item scales, alpha for 3+;\n")
cat("    mean inter-item r for all; all 8 composites assessed\n")
cat("  ✓ Binary outcome stopped_bzra created from freq_dich (Part B3)\n")
cat("  ✓ Reliability assessed on imputation 1\n")
cat("  ✓ DBAS_Total created for reliability only — excluded from\n")
cat("    Chunk 10 descriptives and Chunk 11B VSURF\n")
cat("  ✓ freq_dich, n_health_conditions, bzra_daily_diazepam_eq present\n\n")

cat("RELIABILITY OVERVIEW (subscales + composites):\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
n_good <- sum(rel_table$status == "GOOD",       na.rm = TRUE)
n_acc  <- sum(rel_table$status == "ACCEPTABLE", na.rm = TRUE)
n_poor <- sum(rel_table$status == "POOR",       na.rm = TRUE)
n_fail <- sum(!rel_table$status %in% c("GOOD","ACCEPTABLE","POOR"))
cat(sprintf("  ✓ Good (≥ 0.70):          %d scales\n", n_good))
cat(sprintf("  ~ Acceptable (0.60-0.69): %d scales\n", n_acc))
cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  Poor (< 0.60):          %d scales\n", n_poor))
if (n_fail > 0)
  cat(sprintf("  ✗ Uncomputed:             %d scales\n", n_fail))
cat("  (headline coefficient: Spearman-Brown for 2-item, alpha for 3+)\n\n")

# Spotlight the disc self-efficacy number for convenience
if (!is.null(composite_reliability_list$capabilityC) &&
    !is.na(composite_reliability_list$capabilityC$reliability)) {
  cc <- composite_reliability_list$capabilityC
  cat(sprintf(
    "  → Discontinuation self-efficacy (capabilityC): Spearman-Brown = %.3f, inter-item r = %.3f\n\n",
    cc$reliability, cc$mean_r))
}

cat("COMPOSITE VARIABLES CREATED:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
composite_labels <- list(
  benefitsC     = "mean(benefit_1, benefit_4, benefit_5, benefit_6)",
  side_effectsC = "mean(side_effects_1:4)",
  adlsC         = "mean(adls_1, adls_2)",
  dependenceC   = "mean(dependence_1:3)",
  motivationC   = "mean(motivation_1:3)",
  capabilityC   = "mean(capability_1, 6-capability)  [disc self-efficacy]",
  pharmacistC   = "mean(desires_2, 6-inf_hcp_3)",
  prescriberC   = "mean(desires_1, 6-inf_hcp_1)"
)
for (comp in composite_names) {
  status_sym <- if (comp %in% composites_created) "✓" else "✗"
  cat(sprintf("  %s %-15s = %s\n",
              status_sym, comp, composite_labels[[comp]]))
}
cat("\n")

cat("OUTCOME VARIABLES:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  Primary (binary): stopped_bzra\n")
cat("    1 = Stoppers/rare users (freq_dich 0 or 1):", n_stoppers, "\n")
cat("      of which no longer uses (freq_dich 0):   ",
    sum(all_imputed[[1]]$freq_dich == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

cat("FILES CREATED:\n")

cat("NEXT STEPS:\n")
```

## Psychological VSURF

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 11A: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (PERSONALITY PREDICTORS)
#==============================================================================
# Purpose:
#   Select important personality variables for BZRA discontinuation using
#   VSURF applied separately to each imputed dataset.
#   Variables are retained if selected in ≥ 10 runs (≥ 25% of imputations),
#   applied uniformly to threshold, interpretation, and prediction sets.
#
# Alignment with Chunk 9 and Chunk 10:
#   - Outcome: stopped_bzra (created in Chunk 9, Part B3)
#       stopped_bzra = 1 : freq_dich 0 (stopped) or 1 (rare use)  → STOPPERS
#       stopped_bzra = 0 : freq_dich 2 (continues regular use)     → CONTINUERS
#   - stopped_bzra is used directly — NOT re-derived from freq_dich here.
#   - Personality variable set: identical to Chunk 10 personality block,
#     with DBAS_Total explicitly excluded (collinear with subscales).
#   - Labels: "Stoppers" vs "Continuers" consistent with Chunks 10.
#
# Strategy (MI-appropriate):
#   Run VSURF independently on each imputed dataset.
#   Apply majority vote (≥ 10 / m runs) separately for threshold,
#   interpretation, and prediction sets.
#   Use the PREDICTION set for downstream logistic regression.
#
# Rationale for prediction set (not interpretation set):
#   The interpretation set maximises explanatory coverage; the prediction set
#   is the minimal subset that preserves predictive accuracy. With limited
#   events-per-variable headroom, parsimony is required.
#
# Majority-vote threshold:
#   ≥ 10 runs (≥ 25% of imputations), applied to all three VSURF sets.
#   m is read from the RDS file — threshold is computed as ceiling(m * 0.25).
#
# References:
#   Genuer R, Poggi J-M, Tuleau-Malot C (2015). VSURF: An R Package for
#     Variable Selection Using Random Forests. R Journal, 7(2):19-33.
#   Rubin, D.B. (1987). Multiple Imputation for Nonresponse in Surveys.
#==============================================================================

library(VSURF)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CHUNK 11A: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (PERSONALITY)\n")
cat("MI-appropriate: majority vote across all imputations\n")
cat("Outcome: stopped_bzra (from Chunk 9 Part B3)\n")
cat("Threshold: >= 25% of imputations (applied to all VSURF sets)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LOAD DATA
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists("imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds"))
  stop("ERROR: imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds not found. Run Chunk 9 first.")

all_imputed <- readRDS("imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds")
m           <- length(all_imputed)
N           <- nrow(all_imputed[[1]])

cat(sprintf("✓ Loaded imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Imputations (m): %d\n", m))
cat(sprintf("  Observations (N): %d\n\n", N))

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# VERIFY OUTCOME VARIABLE FROM CHUNK 9
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!"stopped_bzra" %in% names(all_imputed[[1]]))
  stop("ERROR: 'stopped_bzra' not found — check Chunk 9 Part B3 ran successfully.")

if (!"freq_dich" %in% names(all_imputed[[1]]))
  stop("ERROR: 'freq_dich' not found — check Chunk 8 Part F ran successfully.")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# RECODE FUNCTION
# stopped_bzra is used directly from Chunk 9 — no re-derivation.
# Factor labels and groupings below applied for display/consistency only.
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

recode_dataset <- function(df) {

  # ── stopped_bzra: already present from Chunk 9, just verify ─────────────────
  if (!"stopped_bzra" %in% names(df))
    stop("ERROR: 'stopped_bzra' missing from imputed dataset — check Chunk 9.")

  # ── Sex ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if ("sex" %in% names(df))
    df$sex <- factor(df$sex, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Female", "Male"))

  # ── Province/Territory ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if ("prov_terr" %in% names(df)) {
    df$prov_terr <- dplyr::case_when(
      df$prov_terr %in% c(1, 2, 3, 12)  ~ "Western Canada",
      df$prov_terr %in% c(9, 11)        ~ "Central Canada",
      df$prov_terr %in% c(4, 5, 7, 10) ~ "Atlantic Canada",
      df$prov_terr %in% c(6, 8, 13)  ~ "Territories",
      TRUE                              ~ NA_character_
    )
    df$prov_terr <- factor(df$prov_terr,
      levels = c("Western Canada", "Central Canada",
                 "Atlantic Canada", "Territories"))
  }

  # ── Employment ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if ("employment" %in% names(df)) {
    df$employment <- dplyr::case_when(
      df$employment %in% c(0, 3, 4) ~ "Not in Workforce",
      df$employment %in% c(1, 2)   ~ "Full- or Part-Time Work",
      TRUE                          ~ NA_character_
    )
    df$employment <- factor(df$employment,
      levels = c("Full- or Part-Time Work", "Not in Workforce"))
  }

  # ── Education ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if ("education" %in% names(df)) {
    df$education <- dplyr::case_when(
      df$education %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ "High School or Less",
      df$education %in% c(4, 5)   ~ "Trade School/University Degree",
      TRUE                          ~ NA_character_
    )
    df$education <- factor(df$education,
      levels = c("High School or Less", "Trade School/University Degree"))
  }

  # ── Income ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if ("income" %in% names(df))
    df$income <- factor(df$income, levels = 1:5,
      labels = c("$15,000 or less", "$15,000 to $30,000", "$30,000 to $50,000",
                 "$50,000 to $80,000", "$80,000 or more"))

  # ── Driving frequency ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if ("driving_freq" %in% names(df))
    df$driving_freq <- factor(df$driving_freq, levels = 0:3,
      labels = c("Do not drive", "Less than 1 day/week",
                 "1-3 days/week", "4-7 days/week"))

  # ── General health ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if ("gen_health" %in% names(df))
    df$gen_health <- factor(as.numeric(df$gen_health), levels = 1:5,
      labels = c("Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Very good", "Excellent"))

  # ── Alcohol use ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if ("alc_use" %in% names(df))
    df$alc_use <- factor(df$alc_use, levels = 0:4,
      labels = c("Never", "Low (<1 drink/wk)", "Moderate (1-7 drinks/wk)",
                 "High (8-14 drinks/wk)", "Very high (>14 drinks/wk)"))

  # ── Withdrawal experience ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if ("stop_wdl_exp_combined" %in% names(df))
    df$stop_wdl_exp_combined <- factor(df$stop_wdl_exp_combined, levels = 0:5,
      labels = c("No withdrawal", "Insomnia only", "Anxiety only",
                 "Other MH symptoms only", "Physical symptoms only",
                 "Multiple symptoms"))

  # ── Fall injury severity ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if ("fall2" %in% names(df))
    df$fall2 <- factor(df$fall2, levels = 0:2,
      labels = c("No fall / not injured", "Minor injury", "Serious injury"))

  # ── Ensure personality subscales are numeric ─────────────────────────────────
  personality_numeric_vars <- c(
    "BFI_Extraversion", "BFI_Agreeableness", "BFI_Conscientiousness",
    "BFI_Neuroticism", "BFI_Openness",
    "SURPS_Impulsivity", "SURPS_Sensation_Seeking",
    "SURPS_Hopelessness", "SURPS_Anxiety_Sensitivity",
    "DBAS_Consequences", "DBAS_Worry_Helplessness",
    "DBAS_Expectations", "DBAS_Medications",
    "CISS_Task", "CISS_Emotion", "CISS_Avoidance"
  )
  for (var in personality_numeric_vars)
    if (var %in% names(df) && !is.numeric(df[[var]]))
      df[[var]] <- as.numeric(as.character(df[[var]]))

  df
}

# Apply recoding to every imputed dataset
all_datasets <- lapply(all_imputed, recode_dataset)
cat(sprintf("✓ Recoded all %d imputed datasets\n\n", m))

d1 <- all_datasets[[1]]

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# OUTCOME SUMMARY
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

n_stoppers   <- sum(d1$stopped_bzra == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_continuers <- sum(d1$stopped_bzra == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n_outcome_na <- sum(is.na(d1$stopped_bzra))

cat("OUTCOME: stopped_bzra (from Chunk 9 Part B3)\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  stopped_bzra = 1 : freq_dich 0 (stopped) or 1 (rare use)  → STOPPERS\n")
cat("  stopped_bzra = 0 : freq_dich 2 (continues regular use)     → CONTINUERS\n\n")
cat(sprintf("  Stoppers   (stopped_bzra = 1): n = %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            n_stoppers,   100 * n_stoppers   / N))
cat(sprintf("  Continuers (stopped_bzra = 0): n = %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            n_continuers, 100 * n_continuers / N))
if (n_outcome_na > 0)
  cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  Missing stopped_bzra: n = %d\n", n_outcome_na))
cat("\n")

# Verify stopped_bzra is consistent across imputations (it should be,
# since freq_dich was never imputed)
ref_outcome   <- all_imputed[[1]]$stopped_bzra
out_consistent <- all(sapply(all_imputed, function(d)
  identical(d$stopped_bzra, ref_outcome)))
if (out_consistent) {
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ stopped_bzra identical across all %d imputations (as expected)\n\n", m))
} else {
  cat("  ⚠️  stopped_bzra differs across imputations — investigate before proceeding\n\n")
}

n_events <- n_stoppers
cat(sprintf("Events for EPV calculations: %d (stoppers)\n\n", n_events))

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PERSONALITY VARIABLE SET
# Identical to Chunk 10 personality block.
# DBAS_Total explicitly excluded: collinear with subscales.
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PERSONALITY VARIABLE SET\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

personality_vars <- c(
  # BFI-10 (Big Five Inventory — 2 items per trait, Spearman-Brown reliability)
  "BFI_Extraversion", "BFI_Agreeableness", "BFI_Conscientiousness",
  "BFI_Neuroticism", "BFI_Openness",

  # SURPS (Substance Use Risk Profile Scale — 4 subscales)
  "SURPS_Impulsivity", "SURPS_Sensation_Seeking",
  "SURPS_Hopelessness", "SURPS_Anxiety_Sensitivity",

  # DBAS-16 subscales (dysfunctional beliefs about sleep — 4 subscales)
  # DBAS_Total excluded: collinear with subscales
  "DBAS_Consequences", "DBAS_Worry_Helplessness",
  "DBAS_Expectations", "DBAS_Medications",

  # CISS (Coping Inventory for Stressful Situations — 3 subscales)
  "CISS_Task", "CISS_Emotion", "CISS_Avoidance"
)

cat(sprintf("Total personality variables: %d\n", length(personality_vars)))
cat("  BFI-10 (5): Extraversion, Agreeableness, Conscientiousness, Neuroticism, Openness\n")
cat("  SURPS  (4): Impulsivity, Sensation_Seeking, Hopelessness, Anxiety_Sensitivity\n")
cat("  DBAS   (4): Consequences, Worry_Helplessness, Expectations, Medications\n")
cat("  CISS   (3): Task, Emotion, Avoidance\n")
cat("  DBAS_Total excluded (collinear with subscales)\n\n")

missing_vars <- personality_vars[!personality_vars %in% names(d1)]
if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  cat("✗ MISSING variables (check Chunk 9):\n")
  for (v in missing_vars) cat("  •", v, "\n")
  stop("Cannot proceed — personality subscales missing from imputed data.")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("✓ All %d personality variables confirmed in imputed data\n\n",
              length(personality_vars)))
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MAJORITY-VOTE THRESHOLD
# ≥ 25% of imputations, applied uniformly to all three VSURF sets.
# Computed from m so it scales automatically regardless of how many
# imputations are in the RDS file.
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

majority_threshold <- ceiling(m * 0.25)

cat("MAJORITY-VOTE THRESHOLD:\n")
cat(sprintf("  >= 25%% of %d imputations = >= %d runs\n", m, majority_threshold))
cat("  Applied uniformly to threshold, interpretation, and prediction sets.\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# EVENTS-PER-VARIABLE CHECK
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

epv <- round(n_events / length(personality_vars), 1)

cat("EPV CHECK (full input set):\n")
cat(sprintf("  Stoppers (events): %d\n", n_events))
cat(sprintf("  Continuers:        %d\n", n_continuers))
cat(sprintf("  Input variables:   %d\n", length(personality_vars)))
cat(sprintf("  EPV:               %.1f\n", epv))
if (epv < 5) {
  cat("  ⚠️  EPV < 5 — interpret VSURF results cautiously\n")
} else if (epv < 10) {
  cat("  ~  EPV < 10 — moderate risk of overfitting\n")
} else {
  cat("  ✓ EPV >= 10 — acceptable for modeling\n")
}
cat("\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MAJORITY-VOTE VSURF ACROSS ALL IMPUTATIONS
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat(sprintf("RUNNING VSURF ON ALL %d IMPUTATIONS\n", m))
cat("(this will take several minutes)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Storage
thres_list  <- vector("list", m)
interp_list <- vector("list", m)
pred_list   <- vector("list", m)
imp_list    <- vector("list", m)
failed_runs <- integer(0)

start_time <- Sys.time()

for (i in seq_len(m)) {

  cat(sprintf("  Imputation %2d / %d ... ", i, m))

  df <- all_datasets[[i]]

  # Predictor matrix — personality vars only, all numeric
  X <- as.data.frame(lapply(df[, personality_vars, drop = FALSE], as.numeric))

  # Outcome — stopped_bzra as factor, from Chunk 9 directly
  y <- factor(df[["stopped_bzra"]], levels = c(0, 1),
              labels = c("Continuer", "Stopper"))

  # Drop any rows with NA outcome (should be none post-imputation)
  ok <- !is.na(y)
  X  <- X[ok, , drop = FALSE]
  y  <- droplevels(y[ok])

  set.seed(12345 + i)   # reproducible but distinct per imputation

  vsurf_i <- tryCatch(
    VSURF(
      x        = X,
      y        = y,
      ntree    = 2000,
      mtry     = max(floor(ncol(X) / 3), 1),
      parallel = FALSE,
      verbose  = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      cat(sprintf("FAILED (%s)\n", e$message))
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (is.null(vsurf_i)) {
    failed_runs      <- c(failed_runs, i)
    thres_list[[i]]  <- character(0)
    interp_list[[i]] <- character(0)
    pred_list[[i]]   <- character(0)
    imp_list[[i]]    <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(personality_vars)),
                                  personality_vars)
    next
  }

  thres_list[[i]]  <- personality_vars[vsurf_i$varselect.thres]
  interp_list[[i]] <- personality_vars[vsurf_i$varselect.interp]
  pred_list[[i]]   <- personality_vars[vsurf_i$varselect.pred]

  # Store mean importance across all variables
  imp_vec <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(personality_vars)), personality_vars)
  imp_vec[personality_vars] <- vsurf_i$imp.mean.dec
  imp_list[[i]] <- imp_vec

  cat(sprintf("thres=%d, interp=%d, pred=%d\n",
              length(thres_list[[i]]),
              length(interp_list[[i]]),
              length(pred_list[[i]])))
}

end_time   <- Sys.time()
time_taken <- round(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"), 2)
cat(sprintf("\n✓ VSURF completed in %.1f minutes\n", time_taken))
if (length(failed_runs) > 0)
  cat(sprintf("⚠️  Failed runs: %s\n", paste(failed_runs, collapse = ", ")))
cat("\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MAJORITY VOTE
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("MAJORITY-VOTE RESULTS\n")
cat(sprintf("Threshold: >= %d / %d runs (>= 25%% of imputations)\n",
            majority_threshold, m))
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

count_selections <- function(sel_list, varnames) {
  counts <- setNames(integer(length(varnames)), varnames)
  for (s in sel_list)
    counts[intersect(s, varnames)] <- counts[intersect(s, varnames)] + 1L
  sort(counts, decreasing = TRUE)
}

thres_counts  <- count_selections(thres_list,  personality_vars)
interp_counts <- count_selections(interp_list, personality_vars)
pred_counts   <- count_selections(pred_list,   personality_vars)

# Variables meeting the unified majority threshold
majority_thres  <- names(thres_counts[ thres_counts  >= majority_threshold])
majority_interp <- names(interp_counts[interp_counts >= majority_threshold])
majority_pred   <- names(pred_counts[  pred_counts   >= majority_threshold])

# Average importance across successful runs
valid_imp <- imp_list[!sapply(imp_list, function(x) all(is.na(x)))]
mean_imp  <- if (length(valid_imp) > 0) {
  imp_mat <- do.call(rbind, valid_imp)
  colMeans(imp_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
} else setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(personality_vars)), personality_vars)

importance_df <- data.frame(
  Variable        = personality_vars,
  Mean_Importance = mean_imp[personality_vars],
  Thres_Count     = thres_counts[personality_vars],
  Interp_Count    = interp_counts[personality_vars],
  Pred_Count      = pred_counts[personality_vars],
  Majority_Thres  = personality_vars %in% majority_thres,
  Majority_Interp = personality_vars %in% majority_interp,
  Majority_Pred   = personality_vars %in% majority_pred,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>% arrange(desc(Mean_Importance))

cat("SELECTION COUNTS (out of", m, "runs):\n\n")
print(importance_df %>%
        select(Variable, Mean_Importance, Thres_Count, Interp_Count, Pred_Count),
      row.names = FALSE, digits = 4)
cat("\n")

# Report majority sets
cat(sprintf("MAJORITY THRESHOLD SET  (>=%d/%d): %d variables\n",
            majority_threshold, m, length(majority_thres)))
for (v in majority_thres)
  cat(sprintf("  • %s  (%d/%d)\n", v, thres_counts[v], m))
cat("\n")

cat(sprintf("MAJORITY INTERPRETATION SET (>=%d/%d): %d variables\n",
            majority_threshold, m, length(majority_interp)))
for (v in majority_interp)
  cat(sprintf("  • %s  (%d/%d)\n", v, interp_counts[v], m))
cat("\n")

cat(sprintf("MAJORITY PREDICTION SET (>=%d/%d): %d variables\n",
            majority_threshold, m, length(majority_pred)))
cat("  -> USE THESE FOR LOGISTIC REGRESSION\n")
for (v in majority_pred)
  cat(sprintf("  • %s  (%d/%d)\n", v, pred_counts[v], m))
cat("\n")

# EPV check on prediction set
if (length(majority_pred) > 0) {
  epv_pred <- round(n_events / length(majority_pred), 1)
  cat(sprintf("EPV with prediction set: %d stoppers / %d predictors = %.1f\n",
              n_events, length(majority_pred), epv_pred))
  if (epv_pred >= 10)
    cat("✓ EPV >= 10 — adequate for logistic regression\n\n")
  else if (epv_pred >= 5)
    cat("~  EPV 5-9 — acceptable; interpret with caution\n\n")
  else
    cat("⚠️  EPV < 5 — consider further reduction before regression\n\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️  No variables met the majority threshold in prediction set.\n")
  cat(sprintf("   Review pred_counts above — consider lowering threshold below %d.\n\n",
              majority_threshold))
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DOMAIN BREAKDOWN
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SELECTION BY PERSONALITY DOMAIN\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

get_domain <- function(vars) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("^BFI_",   vars) ~ "BFI",
    grepl("^SURPS_", vars) ~ "SURPS",
    grepl("^DBAS_",  vars) ~ "DBAS",
    grepl("^CISS_",  vars) ~ "CISS",
    TRUE                   ~ "Other"
  )
}

domain_totals <- c(BFI = 5, SURPS = 4, DBAS = 4, CISS = 3)

if (length(majority_pred) > 0) {
  pred_domain_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = majority_pred,
    Domain   = get_domain(majority_pred),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  domain_summary <- pred_domain_df %>%
    count(Domain, name = "N_Selected") %>%
    mutate(N_Total = domain_totals[Domain],
           Pct     = round(100 * N_Selected / N_Total, 1))

  cat("Prediction set — by domain:\n")
  print(domain_summary, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️  No variables in prediction set to summarise by domain.\n\n")
  domain_summary <- data.frame()
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# VISUALIZATION
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("Creating visualizations...\n")

# Plot 1: Mean importance with selection counts
plot_data <- importance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Domain    = get_domain(Variable),
    In_Pred   = Majority_Pred
  )

p1 <- ggplot(plot_data,
             aes(x     = reorder(Variable, Mean_Importance),
                 y     = Mean_Importance,
                 fill  = Domain,
                 alpha = In_Pred)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%d/%d", Pred_Count, m)),
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3.2) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1.0, "FALSE" = 0.35),
                     labels = c("TRUE" = "In majority prediction set",
                                "FALSE" = "Not selected"),
                     name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Domain") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Variable Importance — Personality Predictors of BZRA Discontinuation",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "VSURF majority vote across %d imputations  |  Stoppers (n=%d) vs Continuers (n=%d)  |  Prediction set: %d variable(s)",
      m, n_stoppers, n_continuers, length(majority_pred)),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean Variable Importance (averaged across imputations)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

ggsave("VSURF_personality_importance.png", p1, width = 11, height = 8, dpi = 300)
cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_personality_importance.png\n")

# Plot 2: Selection stability heatmap across VSURF steps
stability_data <- importance_df %>%
  select(Variable, Thres_Count, Interp_Count, Pred_Count) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols      = -Variable,
               names_to  = "Step",
               values_to = "Count") %>%
  mutate(
    Step = factor(Step,
                  levels = c("Thres_Count", "Interp_Count", "Pred_Count"),
                  labels = c("Threshold", "Interpretation", "Prediction")),
    Variable = factor(Variable,
                      levels = importance_df$Variable[order(importance_df$Mean_Importance)])
  )

p2 <- ggplot(stability_data, aes(x = Step, y = Variable, fill = Count)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count), size = 3.2, colour = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = length(personality_vars) - length(majority_pred) + 0.5,
    colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#d9f0d3", high = "#1a7340",
                      limits = c(0, m), name = "Times\nselected") +
  labs(
    title    = sprintf("VSURF Selection Stability Across %d Imputations", m),
    subtitle = sprintf("Dashed line = majority threshold (%d/%d, >= 25%% of imputations)",
                       majority_threshold, m),
    x = "VSURF Step",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 10)
  )

ggsave("VSURF_personality_stability.png", p2, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)
cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_personality_stability.png\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SAVE RESULTS
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SAVING RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

vsurf_personality_output <- list(

  # FINAL SELECTIONS (majority vote)
  majority_pred    = majority_pred,      # <- USE FOR REGRESSION
  majority_interp  = majority_interp,
  majority_thres   = majority_thres,

  # Per-imputation raw selections
  pred_list        = pred_list,
  interp_list      = interp_list,
  thres_list       = thres_list,

  # Selection counts and importance
  importance_df    = importance_df,
  pred_counts      = pred_counts,
  interp_counts    = interp_counts,

  # Domain summary
  domain_summary   = domain_summary,

  # Metadata
  metadata = list(
    input_vars          = personality_vars,
    outcome             = "stopped_bzra",
    outcome_source      = "Chunk 9 Part B3 — not re-derived here",
    outcome_coding      = "1=stopper (freq_dich 0 or 1), 0=continuer (freq_dich 2)",
    m                   = m,
    N                   = N,
    n_stoppers          = n_stoppers,
    n_continuers        = n_continuers,
    majority_threshold  = majority_threshold,
    pct_threshold       = 25,
    n_pred_selected     = length(majority_pred),
    n_interp_selected   = length(majority_interp),
    n_thres_selected    = length(majority_thres),
    failed_runs         = failed_runs,
    time_minutes        = as.numeric(time_taken),
    seed_base           = 12345
  )
)

saveRDS(vsurf_personality_output, "VSURF_personality_results.rds")
saveRDS(majority_pred,            "VSURF_personality_selected.rds")

cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_personality_results.rds\n")
cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_personality_selected.rds\n\n")

write.csv(importance_df, "VSURF_personality_importance_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_personality_importance_table.csv\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FINAL SUMMARY
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CHUNK 11A COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat(sprintf("VSURF ran on %d imputations (%d failed)\n",
            m, length(failed_runs)))
cat("Outcome: stopped_bzra (from Chunk 9 Part B3 — used directly)\n")
cat(sprintf("  1 = Stoppers (freq_dich 0 or 1): n = %d\n", n_stoppers))
cat(sprintf("  0 = Continuers (freq_dich 2):    n = %d\n\n", n_continuers))

cat(sprintf("Majority-vote threshold: >= %d / %d runs (>= 25%% of imputations)\n",
            majority_threshold, m))
cat("Applied uniformly to threshold, interpretation, and prediction sets.\n\n")

cat("FINAL SELECTIONS:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Threshold set:      %d variables\n", length(majority_thres)))
cat(sprintf("  Interpretation set: %d variables\n", length(majority_interp)))

            length(majority_pred)))

if (length(majority_pred) > 0) {
  cat("PREDICTION SET VARIABLES:\n")
  for (i in seq_along(majority_pred))
    cat(sprintf("  %d. %s  (selected in %d/%d runs)\n",
                i, majority_pred[i], pred_counts[majority_pred[i]], m))
  cat(sprintf("\n  EPV: %d stoppers / %d predictors = %.1f\n",
              n_events, length(majority_pred),
              n_events / length(majority_pred)))
} else {
  cat("⚠️  No variables selected in prediction set.\n")
  cat("   Load VSURF_personality_results.rds and review pred_counts\n")
  cat(sprintf("   to decide on a lower threshold (e.g., >= %d runs).\n",
              max(majority_threshold - 2L, 1L)))
}

cat("\n✓ Ready for Chunk 12A: logistic regression (personality model)\n\n")

cat("NOTES:\n")

cat("  - Stoppers   = freq_dich 0 (stopped completely) or 1 (rare use)\n")
cat("  - Continuers = freq_dich 2 (continues regular use)\n")
cat("  - stopped_bzra is identical across all imputations (freq_dich never imputed)\n")
cat("  - DBAS_Total excluded (collinear with subscales)\n")
cat("  - BFI subscales: 2-item Spearman-Brown reliability\n")
cat("  - VSURF factor labels: 'Stopper' / 'Continuer'\n")
cat("  - Majority threshold computed as ceiling(m * 0.25) — auto-scales with m\n\n")

cat("REFERENCES:\n")

```

## Full VSURF w/ Factors

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 11B: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (ALL PREDICTORS — FULL MODEL)
#==============================================================================
# Purpose:
#   Select important predictors of BZRA discontinuation from the full candidate
#   set, covering demographics, clinical, sleep/adverse effects, behavioural,
#   and personality domains.
#
# Alignment with Chunk 10:
#   - Outcome: stopped_bzra (loaded directly from Chunk 9 via imputed datasets,
#       identical to Chunk 10 — NOT re-derived here)
#       stopped_bzra = 1 : Stoppers/rare users (freq_dich 0 or 1)
#       stopped_bzra = 0 : Continuers (freq_dich 2, regular use)
#   - Variable sets: identical to Chunk 10 domain definitions
#       demographics, clinical, sleep_adverse, beliefs_comob, personality
#   - stop_wdl_exp_combined included in sleep_adverse (matches Chunk 10);
#       wdl_symptom_count also retained.
#   - COM-B composites (benefitsC, side_effectsC, adlsC, dependenceC,
#       motivationC, capabilityC, pharmacistC, prescriberC) included.
#   - DBAS_Total excluded (consistent with Chunk 10 and Chunk 11A)
#   - Labels: "Stoppers" vs "Continuers" consistent with Chunk 10
#
# Strategy (Option 1 — MI-appropriate):
#   Run VSURF independently on each of the m imputed datasets.
#   Majority-vote: >=25% of imputations (ceiling(m * 0.25)), applied
#                  uniformly to threshold, interpretation, and prediction sets.
#   Use the PREDICTION set for downstream logistic regression.
#
# VSURF settings:
#   ntree       = 2000  (trees per random forest)
#   nfor.thres  = 20    (iterations for threshold step)
#   nfor.interp = 20    (iterations for interpretation step)
#   nfor.pred   = 20    (iterations for prediction step)
#   mtry        = floor(sqrt(p))  (sqrt rule for classification)
#
# On withdrawal variables:
#   stop_wdl_exp_combined included as categorical predictor (consistent with
#   Chunk 10). Now 3-level unordered factor:
#     "No withdrawal" | "Insomnia only" | "Other withdrawal symptoms"
#   wdl_symptom_count also retained as continuous predictor.
#
# On fall2:
#   Levels 0-3 observed in data:
#     0 = No fall / not injured
#     1 = Minor injury
#     2 = Serious injury
#     3 = Fall but no injury (separate from level 0)
#   All four levels coded in recode_dataset() to prevent NAs.
#
# On BZRA dose variable:
#   Named bzra_daily_dose_eq (renamed from bzra_daily_diazepam_eq in
#   Chunk 5+6). Clinical vector updated accordingly.
#
# On DBAS_Total:
#   Excluded — collinear with subscales; consistent with Chunk 10 and 11A.
#
# References:
#   Genuer R, Poggi J-M, Tuleau-Malot C (2015). VSURF: An R Package for
#     Variable Selection Using Random Forests. R Journal, 7(2):19-33.
#   Rubin, D.B. (1987). Multiple Imputation for Nonresponse in Surveys.
#==============================================================================

library(VSURF)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CHUNK 11B: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (FULL MODEL)\n")
# FIX: majority vote line now uses the dynamic m value loaded below,
# so it correctly reflects m=24 (or whatever m is in the loaded data)
# rather than the previously hardcoded 42.
cat("MI-appropriate: majority vote across all imputations\n")
cat("Outcome: stopped_bzra (from Chunk 9 — aligned with Chunk 10)\n")
cat("Threshold: >= 25% of imputations (applied to all VSURF sets)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LOAD DATA
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists("imputed_datasets_efa_scales.rds"))
  stop("ERROR: imputed_datasets_efa_scales.rds not found. Run the EFA chunk first.")

all_imputed <- readRDS("imputed_datasets_efa_scales.rds")
m           <- length(all_imputed)
N           <- nrow(all_imputed[[1]])

efa_factors_check <- c("EFA_F1", "EFA_F2", "EFA_F3", "EFA_F4")
missing_efa <- efa_factors_check[!efa_factors_check %in% names(all_imputed[[1]])]
if (length(missing_efa) > 0)
  stop("ERROR: EFA factors missing (", paste(missing_efa, collapse = ", "),
       ") — run the EFA chunk first.")

cat(sprintf("✓ Loaded imputed_datasets_efa_scales.rds\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Imputations (m): %d\n", m))
cat(sprintf("  Observations (N): %d\n\n", N))

# FIX: removed hardcoded check for m == 42; warning now fires for any
# unexpected m so the threshold calculation (ceiling(m * 0.25)) is always
# correct regardless of how many imputations were run.
if (m != 24)
  warning(sprintf("Expected 24 imputations but found %d — thresholds scale to m.", m))

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# VERIFY OUTCOME VARIABLE FROM CHUNK 9
# stopped_bzra is used directly — NOT re-derived here.
# This is identical to the approach in Chunk 10.
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!"stopped_bzra" %in% names(all_imputed[[1]]))
  stop("ERROR: 'stopped_bzra' not found — check Chunk 9 Part B3 ran successfully.")

if (!"freq_dich" %in% names(all_imputed[[1]]))
  stop("ERROR: 'freq_dich' not found — check Chunk 8 Part F ran successfully.")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# RECODE FUNCTION — identical to Chunk 10
# stopped_bzra is already present from Chunk 9; no re-derivation needed.
# Factor labels and groupings applied for VSURF compatibility.
#
# FIX 1: stop_wdl_exp_combined now has 3 levels with text labels
#   (collapsed from 6 in Chunk 5+6). Recode matches on existing labels
#   rather than numeric levels to prevent NAs.
#
# FIX 2: bzra_daily_dose_eq (renamed from bzra_daily_diazepam_eq in
#   Chunk 5+6). Clinical vector updated to match.
#
# fall2 fix: levels 0-3 all observed in data; all four levels coded
#   explicitly to prevent NAs in VSURF.
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

recode_dataset <- function(df) {

  # ── Sex ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if ("sex" %in% names(df))
    df$sex <- factor(df$sex, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Female", "Male"))

  # ── Province/Territory ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if ("prov_terr" %in% names(df)) {
    df$prov_terr <- dplyr::case_when(
      df$prov_terr %in% c(1, 2, 3, 12)  ~ "Western Canada",
      df$prov_terr %in% c(9, 11)        ~ "Central Canada",
      df$prov_terr %in% c(4, 5, 7, 10)  ~ "Atlantic Canada",
      df$prov_terr %in% c(6, 8, 13)     ~ "Territories",
      TRUE                               ~ NA_character_
    )
    df$prov_terr <- factor(df$prov_terr,
      levels = c("Western Canada", "Central Canada",
                 "Atlantic Canada", "Territories"))
  }

  # ── Employment ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if ("employment" %in% names(df)) {
    df$employment <- dplyr::case_when(
      df$employment %in% c(0, 3, 4) ~ "Not in Workforce",
      df$employment %in% c(1, 2)    ~ "Full- or Part-Time Work",
      TRUE                           ~ NA_character_
    )
    df$employment <- factor(df$employment,
      levels = c("Full- or Part-Time Work", "Not in Workforce"))
  }

  # ── Education ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if ("education" %in% names(df)) {
    df$education <- dplyr::case_when(
      df$education %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ "High School or Less",
      df$education %in% c(4, 5)    ~ "Trade School/University Degree",
      TRUE                           ~ NA_character_
    )
    df$education <- factor(df$education,
      levels = c("High School or Less", "Trade School/University Degree"))
  }

  # ── Income ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if ("income" %in% names(df))
    df$income <- factor(df$income, levels = 1:5,
      labels = c("$15,000 or less", "$15,000 to $30,000", "$30,000 to $50,000",
                 "$50,000 to $80,000", "$80,000 or more"))

  # ── Driving frequency ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if ("driving_freq" %in% names(df))
    df$driving_freq <- factor(df$driving_freq, levels = 0:3,
      labels = c("Do not drive", "Less than 1 day/week",
                 "1-3 days/week", "4-7 days/week"))

  # ── General health ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if ("gen_health" %in% names(df))
    df$gen_health <- factor(as.numeric(df$gen_health), levels = 1:5,
      labels = c("Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Very good", "Excellent"))

  # ── Alcohol use (combined ordinal 0-4) ──────────────────────────────────────
  if ("alc_use" %in% names(df))
    df$alc_use <- factor(df$alc_use, levels = 0:4,
      labels = c("Never", "Low (<1 drink/wk)", "Moderate (1-7 drinks/wk)",
                 "High (8-14 drinks/wk)", "Very high (>14 drinks/wk)"))

  # ── Withdrawal experience ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # FIX 1: Now 3-level unordered factor (collapsed in Chunk 5+6 Part B).
  # Labels match exactly what is stored in the imputed data.
  # Do NOT recode by numeric levels — the variable is already a labelled
  # factor; re-factoring by existing labels preserves values without NAs.
  if ("stop_wdl_exp_combined" %in% names(df))
    df$stop_wdl_exp_combined <- factor(
      df$stop_wdl_exp_combined,
      levels = c("No withdrawal", "Insomnia only", "Other withdrawal symptoms")
    )

  # ── Fall injury severity — levels 0-3 ───────────────────────────────────────
  if ("fall2" %in% names(df))
    df$fall2 <- factor(df$fall2, levels = 0:3,
      labels = c("No fall / not injured", "Minor injury",
                 "Serious injury", "Fall but no injury"))

 # ── Ensure EFA factor scales are numeric ────────────────────────────────────
  efa_factor_vars <- c("EFA_F1", "EFA_F2", "EFA_F3", "EFA_F4")
  for (var in efa_factor_vars)
    if (var %in% names(df) && !is.numeric(df[[var]]))
      df[[var]] <- as.numeric(as.character(df[[var]]))

  # ── Personality subscales ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  personality_numeric_vars <- c(
    "BFI_Extraversion", "BFI_Agreeableness", "BFI_Conscientiousness",
    "BFI_Neuroticism", "BFI_Openness",
    "SURPS_Impulsivity", "SURPS_Sensation_Seeking",
    "SURPS_Hopelessness", "SURPS_Anxiety_Sensitivity",
    "DBAS_Consequences", "DBAS_Worry_Helplessness",
    "DBAS_Expectations", "DBAS_Medications",
    "CISS_Task", "CISS_Emotion", "CISS_Avoidance"
  )
  for (var in personality_numeric_vars)
    if (var %in% names(df) && !is.numeric(df[[var]]))
      df[[var]] <- as.numeric(as.character(df[[var]]))

  df
}

# Apply recoding to every imputed dataset
all_datasets <- lapply(all_imputed, recode_dataset)

n_stoppers   <- sum(all_imputed[[1]]$stopped_bzra == 1, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

cat("(Identical to Chunk 10 variable families)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

demographics <- c(

)

)

sleep_adverse <- c(
  "alc_sleep", "can_sleep", "melatonin_use", "op_sleep",

)

# ── EFA-derived discontinuation-cognition factors (replace the 8 composites) ─
# Four unit-weighted factor scales from the publication EFA, in place of the
# eight de novo composites. Membership and scoring per the EFA chunk.
efa_factors <- c("EFA_F1", "EFA_F2", "EFA_F3", "EFA_F4")


# ── Personality subscales — identical to Chunk 10 ────────────────────────────

personality <- c(

  "BFI_Neuroticism", "BFI_Openness",
  "SURPS_Impulsivity", "SURPS_Sensation_Seeking",

  "DBAS_Expectations", "DBAS_Medications",
  "CISS_Task", "CISS_Emotion", "CISS_Avoidance"
)

all_vars_declared <- unique(c(demographics, clinical, sleep_adverse,
                               efa_factors, personality))
all_vars          <- all_vars_declared[all_vars_declared %in% names(d1)]

# Domain lookup — mirrors Chunk 10 get_family()
get_family <- function(var) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    var %in% demographics  ~ "Demographics",
    var %in% clinical      ~ "Clinical",
    var %in% sleep_adverse ~ "Sleep_Adverse",
    var %in% efa_factors   ~ "EFA_Factors",
    var %in% personality   ~ "Personality",
    TRUE                   ~ "Other"
  )
}

cat(sprintf("Demographics   (%2d): %s\n",
            sum(all_vars %in% demographics),
            paste(all_vars[all_vars %in% demographics], collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Clinical       (%2d): %s\n",
            sum(all_vars %in% clinical),
            paste(all_vars[all_vars %in% clinical], collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Sleep/Adverse  (%2d): %s\n",
            sum(all_vars %in% sleep_adverse),
            paste(all_vars[all_vars %in% sleep_adverse], collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("EFA Factors    (%2d): %s\n",
            sum(all_vars %in% efa_factors),
            paste(all_vars[all_vars %in% efa_factors], collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Personality    (%2d): %s\n",
            sum(all_vars %in% personality),
            paste(all_vars[all_vars %in% personality], collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("\nTotal candidate predictors (after availability check): %d\n",
            length(all_vars)))
cat("DBAS_Total excluded (collinear with subscales)\n")
cat("stop_wdl_exp_combined included (3-level unordered factor — consistent with Chunk 10)\n")
cat("wdl_symptom_count included (continuous withdrawal symptom count)\n")
cat("bzra_daily_dose_eq used (renamed from bzra_daily_diazepam_eq in Chunk 5+6)\n\n")

missing_vars <- all_vars_declared[!all_vars_declared %in% names(d1)]
if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("⚠️  %d declared variables not found in data (excluded):\n",
              length(missing_vars)))
  for (v in missing_vars) cat("  •", v, "\n")
  cat("\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("✓ All %d declared variables confirmed in imputed data\n\n",
              length(all_vars_declared)))
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CATEGORICAL vs CONTINUOUS VARIABLE LISTS — aligned with Chunk 10
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat_vars <- c(
  "sex", "education", "income", "employment", "driving_freq",
  "prov_terr", "gen_health", "alc_use",
  "stop_wdl_exp_combined", "fall2"
)
cat_vars  <- cat_vars[cat_vars %in% all_vars]
cont_vars <- all_vars[!all_vars %in% cat_vars]

cat(sprintf("Categorical variables (kept as factors): %d\n", length(cat_vars)))
cat(sprintf("  %s\n", paste(cat_vars, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Continuous/ordinal variables:            %d\n\n", length(cont_vars)))

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# EVENTS-PER-VARIABLE CHECK
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

epv_input <- round(n_events / length(all_vars), 1)

cat("EPV CHECK (input variables):\n")
cat(sprintf("  Stoppers (events): %d\n", n_events))
cat(sprintf("  Continuers:        %d\n", n_continuers))
cat(sprintf("  Input variables:   %d\n", length(all_vars)))
cat(sprintf("  EPV at input:      %.1f\n", epv_input))
cat("  Note: EPV constraint applies to the FINAL regression model,\n")
cat("  not to VSURF input. VSURF will reduce this to a feasible set.\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PRE-LOOP NA DIAGNOSTIC
# Runs on d1 (already recoded imputation 1). Any NAs here signal a recode
# mismatch — the data are fully imputed so NAs should be zero.
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PRE-LOOP NA DIAGNOSTIC (imputation 1)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

diag_X    <- d1[, all_vars, drop = FALSE]
na_report <- sapply(diag_X, function(col) sum(is.na(col)))
na_report <- na_report[na_report > 0]

if (length(na_report) == 0) {
  cat("✓ No NAs after recoding — data are clean.\n\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("⚠️  %d variable(s) have NAs after recoding:\n\n", length(na_report)))
  for (v in names(na_report)) {
    raw_vals <- sort(unique(all_imputed[[1]][[v]]))
    cat(sprintf("  %-30s  NAs: %d   Raw values in data: %s\n",
                v, na_report[v], paste(head(raw_vals, 20), collapse = ", ")))
  }
  cat("\n")
  cat("ACTION REQUIRED: Update recode_dataset() so all observed values\n")
  cat("are matched. Then re-run this chunk.\n\n")
  stop("Stopping — fix NA-producing recodes before running VSURF.")
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MAJORITY-VOTE VSURF ACROSS ALL m IMPUTATIONS
#
# FIX: majority_threshold now correctly derived from the loaded m value
# (ceiling(m * 0.25)) rather than being computed from a hardcoded 42.
# With m=24: ceiling(24 * 0.25) = 6.
# With m=42: ceiling(42 * 0.25) = 11.
# The threshold scales automatically regardless of how many imputations
# were run.
#
# VSURF settings:
#   ntree       = 2000  trees per forest
#   nfor.thres  = 20    iterations for threshold step
#   nfor.interp = 20    iterations for interpretation step
#   nfor.pred   = 20    iterations for prediction step
#   mtry        = floor(sqrt(p))
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat(sprintf("RUNNING VSURF ON ALL %d IMPUTATIONS\n", m))
cat("(expect 30-60 minutes)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

majority_threshold <- ceiling(m * 0.25)

cat(sprintf("Majority-vote threshold (all VSURF sets): ≥ %d / %d runs (≥ 25%% of imputations)\n\n",
            majority_threshold, m))

thres_list  <- vector("list", m)
interp_list <- vector("list", m)
pred_list   <- vector("list", m)
imp_list    <- vector("list", m)
failed_runs <- integer(0)

start_time <- Sys.time()

for (i in seq_len(m)) {

  cat(sprintf("  Imputation %2d / %d ... ", i, m))

  df <- all_datasets[[i]]

  X <- df[, all_vars, drop = FALSE]

  for (v in cat_vars)
    if (v %in% names(X) && is.factor(X[[v]]))
      X[[v]] <- droplevels(X[[v]])

  for (v in names(X))
    if (!is.factor(X[[v]]) && !is.numeric(X[[v]]))
      X[[v]] <- as.numeric(as.character(X[[v]]))

  X <- as.data.frame(X)

  # Use stopped_bzra directly from Chunk 9 — consistent with Chunk 10
  y  <- factor(df[["stopped_bzra"]], levels = c(0, 1),
               labels = c("Continuer", "Stopper"))
  ok <- !is.na(y)
  X  <- X[ok, , drop = FALSE]
  y  <- droplevels(y[ok])

  set.seed(12345 + i)

  vsurf_i <- tryCatch(
    VSURF(
      x           = X,
      y           = y,
      ntree       = 2000,
      nfor.thres  = 20,
      nfor.interp = 20,
      nfor.pred   = 20,
      mtry        = max(floor(sqrt(ncol(X))), 1),
      parallel    = FALSE,
      verbose     = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      cat(sprintf("FAILED (%s)\n", e$message))
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (is.null(vsurf_i)) {
    failed_runs      <- c(failed_runs, i)
    thres_list[[i]]  <- character(0)
    interp_list[[i]] <- character(0)
    pred_list[[i]]   <- character(0)
    imp_list[[i]]    <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(all_vars)), all_vars)
    next
  }

  thres_list[[i]]  <- all_vars[vsurf_i$varselect.thres]
  interp_list[[i]] <- all_vars[vsurf_i$varselect.interp]
  pred_list[[i]]   <- all_vars[vsurf_i$varselect.pred]

  imp_vec <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(all_vars)), all_vars)
  imp_vec[all_vars] <- vsurf_i$imp.mean.dec
  imp_list[[i]] <- imp_vec

  cat(sprintf("thres=%d, pred=%d\n",
              length(thres_list[[i]]), length(pred_list[[i]])))
}

end_time   <- Sys.time()
time_taken <- round(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"), 2)
cat(sprintf("\n✓ VSURF completed in %.1f minutes\n", time_taken))
if (length(failed_runs) > 0)
  cat(sprintf("⚠️  Failed runs: %s\n", paste(failed_runs, collapse = ", ")))
cat("\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MAJORITY VOTE
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("MAJORITY-VOTE RESULTS\n")
cat(sprintf("Threshold: >= %d / %d runs (>= 25%% of imputations)\n",
            majority_threshold, m))
cat("Applied uniformly to threshold, interpretation, and prediction sets.\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

count_selections <- function(sel_list, varnames) {
  counts <- setNames(integer(length(varnames)), varnames)
  for (s in sel_list)
    counts[intersect(s, varnames)] <- counts[intersect(s, varnames)] + 1L
  sort(counts, decreasing = TRUE)
}

thres_counts  <- count_selections(thres_list,  all_vars)
interp_counts <- count_selections(interp_list, all_vars)
pred_counts   <- count_selections(pred_list,   all_vars)

majority_thres  <- names(thres_counts[ thres_counts  >= majority_threshold])
majority_interp <- names(interp_counts[interp_counts >= majority_threshold])
majority_pred   <- names(pred_counts[  pred_counts   >= majority_threshold])

valid_imp <- imp_list[!sapply(imp_list, function(x) all(is.na(x)))]
mean_imp  <- if (length(valid_imp) > 0) {
  colMeans(do.call(rbind, valid_imp), na.rm = TRUE)
} else setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(all_vars)), all_vars)

importance_df <- data.frame(
  Variable        = all_vars,
  Domain          = get_family(all_vars),
  Mean_Importance = mean_imp[all_vars],
  Thres_Count     = as.integer(thres_counts[all_vars]),
  Interp_Count    = as.integer(interp_counts[all_vars]),
  Pred_Count      = as.integer(pred_counts[all_vars]),
  Majority_Thres  = all_vars %in% majority_thres,
  Majority_Interp = all_vars %in% majority_interp,
  Majority_Pred   = all_vars %in% majority_pred,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>% arrange(desc(Mean_Importance))

cat("SELECTION COUNTS (out of", m, "runs) — sorted by mean importance:\n\n")
print(importance_df %>%
        select(Variable, Domain, Mean_Importance,
               Thres_Count, Interp_Count, Pred_Count),
      row.names = FALSE, digits = 4)
cat("\n")

cat(sprintf("MAJORITY THRESHOLD SET  (≥%d/%d, ≥25%%): %d variables\n",
            majority_threshold, m, length(majority_thres)))
for (v in majority_thres)
  cat(sprintf("  • %-35s (%d/%d)  [%s]\n", v, thres_counts[v], m, get_family(v)))
cat("\n")

cat(sprintf("MAJORITY INTERPRETATION SET (≥%d/%d, ≥25%%): %d variables\n",
            majority_threshold, m, length(majority_interp)))
for (v in majority_interp)
  cat(sprintf("  • %-35s (%d/%d)  [%s]\n", v, interp_counts[v], m, get_family(v)))
cat("\n")

cat(sprintf("MAJORITY PREDICTION SET (≥%d/%d, ≥25%%): %d variables\n",
            majority_threshold, m, length(majority_pred)))
cat("→ USE THESE FOR LOGISTIC REGRESSION\n")
for (v in majority_pred)
  cat(sprintf("  • %-35s (%d/%d)  [%s]\n", v, pred_counts[v], m, get_family(v)))
cat("\n")

if (length(majority_pred) > 0) {
  epv_pred <- round(n_events / length(majority_pred), 1)
  cat(sprintf("EPV with prediction set: %d stoppers / %d predictors = %.1f\n",
              n_events, length(majority_pred), epv_pred))
  if (epv_pred >= 10)
    cat("✓ EPV ≥ 10 — adequate for logistic regression\n\n")
  else if (epv_pred >= 5)
    cat("~  EPV 5-9 — acceptable; interpret with caution\n\n")
  else
    cat("⚠️  EPV < 5 — consider raising the threshold before regression\n\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️  No variables met the prediction threshold.\n")
  cat("   Review pred_counts in the saved RDS.\n\n")
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DOMAIN BREAKDOWN OF PREDICTION SET
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PREDICTION SET — BY DOMAIN\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

domain_totals <- c(
  Demographics  = sum(all_vars %in% demographics),
  Clinical      = sum(all_vars %in% clinical),
  Sleep_Adverse = sum(all_vars %in% sleep_adverse),
  EFA_Factors   = sum(all_vars %in% efa_factors),
  Personality   = sum(all_vars %in% personality)
)

if (length(majority_pred) > 0) {
  pred_domain_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = majority_pred,
    Domain   = get_family(majority_pred),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  domain_summary <- pred_domain_df %>%
    count(Domain, name = "N_Selected") %>%
    mutate(N_Total = domain_totals[Domain],
           Pct     = round(100 * N_Selected / N_Total, 1)) %>%
    arrange(desc(N_Selected))

  print(domain_summary, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")

  cat("Prediction set variables by domain:\n\n")
  for (dom in domain_summary$Domain) {
    vars_in <- pred_domain_df$Variable[pred_domain_df$Domain == dom]
    cat(sprintf("%s (%d):\n", dom, length(vars_in)))
    for (v in vars_in)
      cat(sprintf("  • %-35s (%d/%d)\n", v, pred_counts[v], m))
    cat("\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("⚠️  Prediction set is empty.\n\n")
  domain_summary <- data.frame()
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# COMPARE WITH PERSONALITY-ONLY MODEL (11A)
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("COMPARISON WITH PERSONALITY-ONLY MODEL (CHUNK 11A)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if (file.exists("VSURF_personality_selected.rds")) {
  pers_pred <- readRDS("VSURF_personality_selected.rds")

  in_both   <- intersect(majority_pred, pers_pred)
  only_full <- setdiff(majority_pred,   pers_pred)
  only_pers <- setdiff(pers_pred,       majority_pred)

  cat(sprintf("Personality model prediction set (11A): %d variables\n", length(pers_pred)))
  cat(sprintf("Full model prediction set (11B):        %d variables\n", length(majority_pred)))
  cat(sprintf("In both:                                %d variables\n", length(in_both)))
  cat(sprintf("Only in full model:                     %d variables\n", length(only_full)))
  cat(sprintf("Only in personality model:              %d variables\n\n", length(only_pers)))

  if (length(in_both) > 0) {
    cat("Shared variables:\n")
    for (v in in_both) cat(sprintf("  • %-35s [%s]\n", v, get_family(v)))
    cat("\n")
  }
  if (length(only_full) > 0) {
    cat("Added by full model:\n")
    for (v in only_full) cat(sprintf("  • %-35s [%s]\n", v, get_family(v)))
    cat("\n")
  }
  if (length(only_pers) > 0) {
    cat("In personality model but dropped by full model:\n")
    for (v in only_pers) cat(sprintf("  • %-35s [%s]\n", v, get_family(v)))
    cat("\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("VSURF_personality_selected.rds not found — skipping comparison.\n\n")
}

  )

ggsave("VSURF_full_importance_top20.png", p1, width = 12, height = 9, dpi = 300)
cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_full_importance_top20.png\n")

stab_vars <- importance_df %>%
  filter(Majority_Thres | Thres_Count >= 5) %>%
  arrange(Mean_Importance) %>%
  pull(Variable)

if (length(stab_vars) == 0) {
  cat("⚠️  No variables reached threshold in any run — skipping stability heatmap.\n\n")
} else {

  stability_data <- importance_df %>%
    filter(Variable %in% stab_vars) %>%
    select(Variable, Domain, Thres_Count, Interp_Count, Pred_Count) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols      = c(Thres_Count, Interp_Count, Pred_Count),
                 names_to  = "Step",
                 values_to = "Count") %>%
    mutate(
      Step = factor(Step,
                    levels = c("Thres_Count", "Interp_Count", "Pred_Count"),
                    labels = c("Threshold", "Interpretation", "Prediction")),
      Variable = factor(Variable, levels = stab_vars)
    )

  p2 <- ggplot(stability_data, aes(x = Step, y = Variable, fill = Count)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(aes(label = Count), size = 2.8, colour = "white", fontface = "bold") +
    facet_grid(Domain ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#d9edf7", high = "#1a5276",
                        limits = c(0, m),
                        name  = sprintf("Times\nselected\n(max %d)", m)) +
    labs(
      title    = "VSURF Selection Stability — Full Model",
      subtitle = sprintf(
        "Majority threshold: ≥%d/%d (≥25%% of imputations), all VSURF steps  |  Stoppers (n=%d) vs Continuers (n=%d)",
        majority_threshold, m, n_stoppers, n_continuers),
      x = "VSURF Step",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
      strip.text.y    = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold", size = 9),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 8),
      panel.spacing.y = unit(0.3, "lines")
    )

  ggsave("VSURF_full_stability.png", p2,
         width  = 9,
         height = max(8, length(stab_vars) * 0.35 + 3),
         dpi    = 300)
  cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_full_stability.png\n\n")
}
```

## Logistic Regression

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 12: LOGISTIC REGRESSION — PERSONALITY vs FULL MODEL + DELONG'S TEST
#==============================================================================
# Purpose:
#   Fit two logistic regression models using VSURF interpretation sets:
#     Model A — Personality-only predictors (from Chunk 11A)
#     Model B — Full predictor set (from Chunk 11B)
#   Compare discriminative ability using DeLong's test.
#   Both raw and standardized (mean=0, SD=1) versions are fitted for
#   continuous predictors so that coefficient magnitudes are comparable
#   across variables and scales.
#
# Variable sets:
#   Both models use the VSURF INTERPRETATION set (Step 2), which retains all
#   variables useful for understanding the outcome. This is appropriate when
#   the goal is both explanation and prediction, and ensures the models are
#   a meaningful representation of their respective predictor domains.
#   The prediction set (Step 3) is noted for reference but not used here.
#
# Standardization:
#   Only continuous predictors are standardized (z-scored: subtract mean,
#   divide by SD, pooled across imputations). Factors (categorical variables)
#   are left untouched in both versions. Standardization is applied to each
#   imputed dataset independently using its own mean and SD (the variation
#   across imputations is negligible for fully imputed data). Coefficients
#   from the standardized model represent the change in log-odds per 1 SD
#   increase in the predictor, making effect sizes directly comparable across
#   variables with different scales (e.g. DBAS subscales vs age vs dose).
#   Raw-score models retain the original units for interpretability.
#   AUC, DeLong's test, and diagnostics use the raw models (standardization
#   does not affect predicted probabilities or model fit).
#
# Outcome:
#   stopped_bzra (from Chunk 9 Part B3 — used directly, not re-derived)
#     1 = Stoppers (freq_dich 0 or 1)
#     0 = Continuers (freq_dich 2)
#
# AUC:
#   Calculated per imputation via pROC; bootstrap CIs (B = 2000) within each
#   imputation. Mean AUC and mean CI bounds reported across imputations
#   (Rubin's rules are not directly applicable to AUC).
#
# DeLong's test (MI pooling):
#   DeLong's test is applied per imputation. ΔAUC and its DeLong SE are
#   extracted per imputation, then pooled using Rubin's rules applied to
#   ΔAUC directly (not to z-statistics). This follows Li & Fine (2010):
#
#     Q_bar  = mean(ΔAUC_i)                         — pooled ΔAUC
#     U_bar  = mean(SE_i^2)                         — within-imputation variance
#     B      = var(ΔAUC_i)                          — between-imputation variance
#     T      = U_bar + (1 + 1/m) * B               — total variance
#     z_pool = Q_bar / sqrt(T)                      — pooled z-statistic
#     df     = (m-1) * (1 + U_bar/((1+1/m)*B))^2   — Barnard & Rubin df
#
#   Pooling ΔAUC (not z) is correct because ΔAUC is the estimand of interest.
#   The SE is extracted as |ΔAUC / z| from each pROC roc.test() call.
#
# BZRA dose variable:
#   bzra_daily_dose_eq (renamed from bzra_daily_diazepam_eq in Chunk 5+6).
#   Chunk 11B saves this correct name directly into VSURF_full_results.rds,
#   so no name remapping is needed in this chunk.
#
# References:
#   DeLong ER, DeLong DM, Clarke-Pearson DL (1988). Biometrics, 44:837–845.
#   Li J, Fine JP (2010). Comparing two AUCs with MI data. Biostatistics.
#   Rubin DB (1987). Multiple Imputation for Nonresponse in Surveys.
#   Barnard J, Rubin DB (1999). Degrees of freedom. Biometrika, 86:948–955.
#==============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(pROC)
library(broom)
library(car)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CHUNK 12: LOGISTIC REGRESSION + DELONG'S TEST\n")
cat("Personality (11A) vs Full model (11B)\n")
cat("Both models use VSURF INTERPRETATION set (Step 2)\n")
cat("Both RAW and STANDARDIZED coefficient versions fitted\n")
cat("Outcome: stopped_bzra (from Chunk 9 Part B3)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART A: LOAD DATA AND VSURF RESULTS
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("PART A: Loading data and VSURF results\n")
cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

if (!file.exists("imputed_datasets_efa_scales.rds"))
  stop("ERROR: imputed_datasets_efa_scales.rds not found. Run the EFA chunk first.")

imputed_list <- readRDS("imputed_datasets_efa_scales.rds")
m            <- length(imputed_list)
N            <- nrow(imputed_list[[1]])

cat(sprintf("✓ Loaded imputed_datasets_efa_scales.rds\n"))
m            <- length(imputed_list)
N            <- nrow(imputed_list[[1]])

cat(sprintf("✓ Loaded imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Imputations (m): %d\n", m))
cat(sprintf("  Observations (N): %d\n\n", N))

if (!file.exists("VSURF_personality_results.rds"))
  stop("ERROR: VSURF_personality_results.rds not found. Run Chunk 11A first.")
vsurf_pers <- readRDS("VSURF_personality_results.rds")

if (!file.exists("VSURF_full_results.rds"))
  stop("ERROR: VSURF_full_results.rds not found. Run Chunk 11B first.")
vsurf_full <- readRDS("VSURF_full_results.rds")

outcome_var <- "stopped_bzra"

if (!outcome_var %in% names(imputed_list[[1]]))
  stop(sprintf("ERROR: '%s' not found in imputed data — check Chunk 9 Part B3.", outcome_var))

n_stoppers   <- sum(imputed_list[[1]][[outcome_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_continuers <- sum(imputed_list[[1]][[outcome_var]] == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n_events     <- n_stoppers

cat(sprintf("Outcome: %s\n", outcome_var))
cat(sprintf("  Stoppers   (= 1): %d (%.1f%%)\n", n_stoppers,   100 * n_stoppers / N))
cat(sprintf("  Continuers (= 0): %d (%.1f%%)\n", n_continuers, 100 * n_continuers / N))
cat(sprintf("  Events for EPV:   %d\n\n", n_events))

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART B: DEFINE VARIABLE SETS
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("PART B: Defining variable sets\n")
cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

vars_A      <- vsurf_pers$majority_interp
vars_B      <- vsurf_full$majority_interp
vars_A_pred <- vsurf_pers$majority_pred
vars_B_pred <- vsurf_full$majority_pred

if (length(vars_A) == 0)
  stop("Model A: VSURF interpretation set is empty. Review Chunk 11A.")
if (length(vars_B) == 0)
  stop("Model B: VSURF interpretation set is empty. Review Chunk 11B.")

cat(sprintf("Model A — Personality VSURF interpretation set (%d variables):\n",
            length(vars_A)))
for (v in vars_A) cat(sprintf("  • %s\n", v))
cat(sprintf("  [Prediction set (%d): %s]\n\n",
            length(vars_A_pred),
            if (length(vars_A_pred) == 0) "(none)" else paste(vars_A_pred, collapse = ", ")))

cat(sprintf("Model B — Full VSURF interpretation set (%d variables):\n",
            length(vars_B)))
for (v in vars_B) cat(sprintf("  • %s\n", v))
cat(sprintf("  [Prediction set (%d): %s]\n\n",
            length(vars_B_pred),
            if (length(vars_B_pred) == 0) "(none)" else paste(vars_B_pred, collapse = ", ")))

check_vars <- function(vars, label) {
  missing <- vars[!vars %in% names(imputed_list[[1]])]
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("⚠️  %s: %d variables not found:\n", label, length(missing)))
    for (v in missing) cat(sprintf("     • %s\n", v))
    stop("Fix missing variables before proceeding.")
  }
}
check_vars(vars_A, "Model A")
check_vars(vars_B, "Model B")
cat("✓ All predictor variables confirmed in imputed data\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART C: EPV CHECK
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("PART C: EPV check\n")
cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

epv_status <- function(epv) {
  if (epv >= 10) "✓ Adequate (≥10)"
  else if (epv >= 5) "~ Borderline (5–9)"
  else "⚠️  Low (<5) — interpret with caution"
}

epv_A <- round(n_events / length(vars_A), 1)
epv_B <- round(n_events / length(vars_B), 1)

cat(sprintf("Model A: %d events / %d predictors = EPV %.1f  %s\n",
            n_events, length(vars_A), epv_A, epv_status(epv_A)))
cat(sprintf("Model B: %d events / %d predictors = EPV %.1f  %s\n\n",
            n_events, length(vars_B), epv_B, epv_status(epv_B)))

if (epv_A < 5 || epv_B < 5)
  cat("NOTE: EPV < 5 increases risk of overfitting. Report results cautiously.\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART D: STANDARDIZATION HELPER
#
# Continuous predictors are z-scored within each imputed dataset.
# Factors are left untouched. Standardization is applied independently per
# imputation (variation in means/SDs across fully imputed datasets is
# negligible). Returns the modified dataset and a log of what was scaled.
#
# Only applied to the standardized model list; raw list is unchanged.
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("PART D: Standardization setup\n")
cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Identify which variables in a given set are continuous (not factor)
# in the first imputed dataset, to determine what gets standardized.
get_continuous_vars <- function(vars, data) {
  vars[sapply(vars, function(v) is.numeric(data[[v]]))]
}

cont_A <- get_continuous_vars(vars_A, imputed_list[[1]])
cont_B <- get_continuous_vars(vars_B, imputed_list[[1]])

cat(sprintf("Model A — continuous predictors to standardize (%d):\n", length(cont_A)))
for (v in cont_A) cat(sprintf("  • %s\n", v))
cat(sprintf("Model A — factors left on original scale (%d):\n",
            length(vars_A) - length(cont_A)))
for (v in vars_A[!vars_A %in% cont_A]) cat(sprintf("  • %s\n", v))
cat("\n")

cat(sprintf("Model B — continuous predictors to standardize (%d):\n", length(cont_B)))
for (v in cont_B) cat(sprintf("  • %s\n", v))
cat(sprintf("Model B — factors left on original scale (%d):\n",
            length(vars_B) - length(cont_B)))
for (v in vars_B[!vars_B %in% cont_B]) cat(sprintf("  • %s\n", v))
cat("\n")

# Function: standardize continuous predictors in a single dataset
standardize_dataset <- function(df, cont_vars) {
  for (v in cont_vars) {
    m_v  <- mean(df[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_v <- sd(df[[v]],   na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!is.na(sd_v) && sd_v > 0)
      df[[v]] <- (df[[v]] - m_v) / sd_v
  }
  df
}

# Build standardized imputed lists for A and B
# (each list standardizes only the variables used in that model)
all_cont_to_std <- unique(c(cont_A, cont_B))

imputed_std_A <- lapply(imputed_list, standardize_dataset, cont_vars = cont_A)
imputed_std_B <- lapply(imputed_list, standardize_dataset, cont_vars = cont_B)

cat("✓ Standardized imputed lists created for Model A and Model B\n")
cat("  (Factors untouched; continuous vars z-scored per imputation)\n\n")

# Spot-check: mean and SD of first continuous variable in imputation 1
if (length(cont_A) > 0) {
  v_chk <- cont_A[1]
  cat(sprintf("Spot-check standardization (Model A, imputation 1, '%s'):\n", v_chk))
  cat(sprintf("  Raw:  mean=%.4f  SD=%.4f\n",
              mean(imputed_list[[1]][[v_chk]],     na.rm = TRUE),
              sd(imputed_list[[1]][[v_chk]],       na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("  Std:  mean=%.4f  SD=%.4f  (expect ≈0 and ≈1)\n\n",
              mean(imputed_std_A[[1]][[v_chk]],   na.rm = TRUE),
              sd(imputed_std_A[[1]][[v_chk]],     na.rm = TRUE)))
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART E: FIT MODELS — RAW AND STANDARDIZED
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART E: Fitting models (raw and standardized)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

formula_A <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(vars_A, collapse = " + ")))
formula_B <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(vars_B, collapse = " + ")))

cat(sprintf("Formula A: %s\n\n", deparse(formula_A)))
cat(sprintf("Formula B: %s\n\n", deparse(formula_B)))

fit_models <- function(data_list, formula_obj, label) {
  mm    <- length(data_list)
  fits  <- vector("list", mm)
  fails <- integer(0)
  for (i in seq_len(mm)) {
    fits[[i]] <- tryCatch(
      glm(formula_obj, data = data_list[[i]], family = binomial()),
      error = function(e) {
        cat(sprintf("  %s imputation %d FAILED: %s\n", label, i, e$message))
        fails <<- c(fails, i)
        NULL
      }
    )
  }
  if (length(fails) > 0)
    cat(sprintf("⚠️  %s: %d failed: %s\n",
                label, length(fails), paste(fails, collapse = ", ")))
  structure(fits, failed = fails)
}

cat("Fitting Model A — raw...\n")
fits_A_raw <- fit_models(imputed_list,  formula_A, "Model A raw")
cat("Fitting Model A — standardized...\n")
fits_A_std <- fit_models(imputed_std_A, formula_A, "Model A std")
cat("Fitting Model B — raw...\n")
fits_B_raw <- fit_models(imputed_list,  formula_B, "Model B raw")
cat("Fitting Model B — standardized...\n")
fits_B_std <- fit_models(imputed_std_B, formula_B, "Model B std")
cat("✓ All models fitted\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART F: POOL COEFFICIENTS (RUBIN'S RULES)
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART F: Pooling coefficients (Rubin's rules)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

pool_and_summarise <- function(fits_list, model_label) {
  valid_fits <- Filter(Negate(is.null), fits_list)
  if (length(valid_fits) == 0)
    stop(sprintf("%s: all imputations failed — cannot pool.", model_label))
  if (length(valid_fits) < length(fits_list))
    cat(sprintf("  ℹ️  %s: %d failed excluded from pooling\n",
                model_label, length(fits_list) - length(valid_fits)))

  mira_obj <- mice::as.mira(valid_fits)
  pooled   <- pool(mira_obj)

  smry <- summary(pooled, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(
      OR       = exp(estimate),
      OR_lower = exp(`2.5 %`),
      OR_upper = exp(`97.5 %`),
      OR_CI    = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", OR, OR_lower, OR_upper),
      sig      = case_when(
        p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        p.value < 0.10  ~ ".",
        TRUE            ~ ""
      ),
      model = model_label
    ) %>%
    select(model, term, estimate, std.error, OR, OR_lower, OR_upper,
           OR_CI, statistic, p.value, sig)

  list(pooled = pooled, summary = smry)
}

results_A_raw <- pool_and_summarise(fits_A_raw, "Model A — Personality (raw)")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART G: AUC WITH BOOTSTRAP CIs (raw models only — fit is identical)
```
